records.description:
**Plant Manager**
**Why Byrne**
At Byrne, we foster a culture built on teamwork, excellence, and professionalism. Our greatest strength lies in the exceptional talent and dedication of our team members across every part of the organization. We value their contributions and ensure they’re recognized, rewarded, and compensated in ways that reflect their impact and expertise.
 
 
**Pay And Benefits**

* Salary Range – $125,000 - $152,500 per year
* Competitive bonus programs
* Medical, Dental, Vision benefits available day 1 of employment
* Supplemental benefits available on day 30 of employment
* Eligible for 401 (k) with a company match available on day 90 of employment
* Educational Support via tuition reimbursement and scholarship program

**Work Shift and Location**
3156 Byrne Hollow Crossing Cortland, NY 13045
 
 
Monday – Friday normal business hours. This may require evening, night and weekend availability based on business needs.
 
 
**Job Overview**
The Plant Manager plays a key role in executing assigned Production tasks. This includes leading various teams in production efforts in addition to performing the duties as needed to efficiently facilitate plant operations. The Plant Manager is also responsible for ensuring that the plant products manufactured conform to company-defined product quality standards, as well as Federal, State, and local standards of product identity, safety, and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs).
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of the plant; coordinate and direct plant operations in the achievement of production, cost, quality, and safety objectives.
* Ensure an appropriate volume of production and raw inventories for each product produced to maximize machine efficiencies and minimize down time and stock outs.
* Manage plant budget and expenses to fall within, or better than plan. Manage all plant variances to meet or exceed plan including, but not limited to, headcount, overtime, and spending.
* Ensure that the quality of products produced at the facility is consistent with intended design and desired image.
* Coordinate with Plant Production Scheduler, Warehouse Management and Supply Management to ensure needed dry goods are on-hand as required.
* Establish and administer mechanisms for being alerted when suppliers are going to be late for delivery or cut items on a delivery. Take action to minimize impact on production schedules and alert appropriate sales and logistics personnel.
* Provide planning assistance with physical inventories and provide staffing to perform these activities; ensure accuracy of all inventories at all times.
* Ensure reporting mechanism regarding KPI are in-place and functioning; ensure monthly reporting of critical KPI to company leadership and plant staff.
* Monitor intake procedures of raw dairy products to assure quality standards are met and production shortages are avoided.
* Contributes to the development of budgets and cost controls. Ensure direct reports analyze, budget, and control spending for their respective line accounts.
* Facilitate the development of strategies and corrective actions to resolve quality issues as necessary.
* Implements and maintains manufacturing policies, procedures, and production control programs.
* Must ensure full compliance with all quality assurance standards.
* Provide for the development, prioritization, and execution of capital improvement projects within the facility.
* Provide leadership for effective employee relations through positive communication, coaching, training, problem resolution/corrective actions, and floor time, work cooperatively with Human Resources.
* Coordinate production activities with purchasing, sales, warehousing, distribution, maintenance, and quality control activities to obtain optimum production and utilization of staff and equipment.
* Provide for the personal and professional growth of team through coaching, feedback, and opportunity.
* Foster participation of the workforce to enhance awareness and cooperation.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and all government regulations; Ensure compliance and enforcement of all work rules and regulations to plant operations and all applicable employees.
* Ensure proper GMP and sanitation procedures are followed plant-wide in collaboration with the quality unit.
* Communicate with Human Resource Department on needs of the facility.
* Rigorously assess your leadership and technical team in terms of values, adherence to SOPs/GMPs, and actual results.
* Foster an “open door” policy for all employees to maintain an open line of communication between direct reports and management staff.
* Promote and provide excellent customer service for all customers.
* Promote a safe and harmonious work environment and adherence to company policy and procedures.
* Responsible for ensuring direct reports assigned duties and responsibilities are covered during planned and unplanned absence from work, including acting as a backup as necessary.

**Min. Qualifications**

* BA/BS in Business Administration or related field, with an MBA preferred.
* Minimum 5-7 years in the role of Managing a Production facility.
* Related experience in the dairy food industry.
* Certifications to include but not limited to CPT, HACCP, OSHA 10-hour, First Aid, CPR and AED.

**Byrne**
Headquartered in LaFayette, Byrne is a Central New York-based dairy company with a legacy spanning over 90 years. Its operations include an extended shelf-life (ESL) and ultra-high temperature (UHT) pasteurization plant in DeWitt, as well as an ESL manufacturing facility in Cortlandville. Byrne also maintains warehouse facilities in Syracuse and East Syracuse, along with a dedicated ice cream center in Syracuse. As a recognized industry leader, Byrne continues to drive innovation at the forefront of dairy processing and product development.

records.description:
**Welcome to Cascades!**
Bring your expertise to a people-first, dynamic environment where your ideas come to life and excellence shapes everything we do.
 
 
Join CHRIS MARTIN EVERETT's team as a
**Plant Manager**
in
**Rockingham**
and help build a more sustainable future.
 
 
**What’s In It For You**
Taking care of our people is in our nature - so you’ll enjoy:
 
 

* Annual salary starting at $160,000
* Profit sharing and an employee share purchase plan
* A full range of benefits: group insurance, telemedicine, and an employer-supported retirement plan
* An annual allowance to spend on goods and services of your choice
* A yearly wellness program and employee assistance program
* A collaborative, respectful, and people-centered workplace

**Your Role**
As
**Plant Manager**
, you’ll take on real challenges that bring out your full potential.
 
 
**Your Scope Includes**

* Lead all plant operations to achieve safety, quality, production, and financial objectives.
* Drive a strong safety culture through visible leadership and accountability.
* Improve reliability through preventive/predictive maintenance, planning, scheduling, and root cause analysis.
* Optimize paper machine performance, equipment uptime, productivity, and product quality.
* Manage plant financial performance, including cost per ton, labor, maintenance, fiber, chemical, and energy costs.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives using data-driven problem-solving methods.
* Develop and strengthen leadership, technical, and hourly teams.
* Build and execute recovery plans for underperforming operations with measurable business impact

**What You Bring**
You're a natural fit for
**Plant Manager**
if you have:
 
 

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing, or related field preferred.
* 15+ years of manufacturing leadership experience in tissue, paper, pulp, or related process industries.
* Proven experience leading paper machine operations and driving performance improvements.
* Demonstrated success managing operational turnarounds and improving underperforming facilities.
* Strong knowledge of papermaking processes, maintenance and reliability systems, continuous improvement, and plant financial management.
* Proven ability to lead large teams, develop talent, and drive organizational change.
* Tissue manufacturing experience strongly preferred.
* Progressive leadership experience from Operations/Production Management into Plant or Mill Leadership.
* Track record of improving safety, OEE, uptime, quality, productivity, and cost performance.

If you bring the same care to who you are as to what you do, we’d love to meet you!
 
 
Apply now and join our team as
**Plant Manager**
in
**Rockingham.**
*Cascades values diversity and inclusion and considers all applications equitably. This posting is for an active vacancy within our organization.*

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
**SUMMARY:**
Directs production, distribution, maintenance, receiving, and supervision operations for the Plant, by performing the following duties personally or through subordinate supervisors.
 
 
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Leads all departments in the plant with department supervisors (or production manager) to maintain safety, quality, and efficient production.
* Coordinates production, distribution, and warehousing in accordance with policies, principles, and established procedures.
* Develops and implements plans for efficient use of materials, machines, and employees.
* Reviews production costs and product quality and modifies production and inventory control programs to maintain and enhance profitable operation of plant.
* Directs preparation of production, human resources, and labor/costs records.
* Recommends budgets to management. Assists management in negotiation of employee contracts.
* Maintains positive working relationship with sales management and customer service management.
* Systematically reviews financial performance of the plant to recommend to management opportunities for sales growth and cost savings.
* Coordinates plant safety, environmental and training activities in cooperation with the Human Resources Department.
* Comply with company policies and procedures.
* Additional duties as assigned by management.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* Manages subordinate supervisors and/or production manager who supervise all plant employees. Is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of these units.
* Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws.
* Responsibilities include training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

**Qualifications**
**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE**
:
 
 

* High school diploma or GED plus college and/or appropriate technical courses.
* Five years experience as a proven manager
* Ten years corrugated manufacturing experience
* Candidates are PREFERRED who offer the following:
* College degree

**Language Skills**

* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
* Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.

**Mathematical Skills**

* Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry.
* Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

**Reasoning Ability**

* Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
* Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

**Technical Skills**
The individual must have a working knowledge of the following:
 
 

* Equipment design and capabilities that can be translated into efficient operation. This also supports the supervisor's role of teacher and trainer for his/her personnel.
* Cost issues in order to make daily decisions that will reduce overall costs and will help the supervisor find areas that require improvement.
* Budget development, adherence and analysis.
* Quality standards.
* Regulatory requirements including but not limited to wage and hour requirements, environmental and waste minimization, company policies, and personnel requirements including OSHA, DEQ and EEO.

**Physical Demands**

* The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the functions of this job.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear.
* The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, and sit.
* The employee is occasionally required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl.
* The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

**Work Environment**

* The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the functions of this job.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts.
* The employee is frequently exposed to wet and/or humid conditions.
* The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; and vibration.
* The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

**Leadership Attributes**
The individual must posses the following:
 
 

* Superior time management skills including the ability to manage multiple issues concurrently and the ability to lead an effective and efficient meeting.
* Teaching skills in order to function effectively as a teacher for his personnel both in the technical and administrative parts of the position.
* Excellent crisis manager who demonstrates that he/she has a high emotional control under adverse conditions and can lead his/her personnel to a successful resolution.
* Excellent employee relations skills including being an active listener, understanding how to appraise personnel, applying both positive and corrective feedback, being able to resolve conflicts either involving the supervisor directly or as a third party, understands and demonstrates positive motivational skills including coaching and delegation techniques.
* Demonstrated confidence including providing a consistent leadership style with an acceptable level of professional assertiveness.
* Professional appearance to support his/her role as a managerial representative of the company.

**Performance Measurements**
The performance of the supervisor will be measured as follows:
 
 

* Operating standards - the Plant Manager will need to see that all reporting staff meet or exceed the Operating Standards in the areas of quality, cost, safety, customer satisfaction and productivity. Such standards will be set annually and communicated to the supervisor.
* Personal growth - while the company will provide the tools to assist the supervisor to grow professionally the responsibility for moving forward lies with the individual. Each year there will be goals developed and agreed to by the supervisor and his/her superior.

**Employee relations**
- through observations the Plant Manager will be evaluated regarding his/her and his/her reporting staff's skills and advancements in the areas of motivational techniques and results, positive and corrective/constructive feedback, subordinate development and creating a positive work environment.
 
 
**Carolina Container Company is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.**

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
**Job Description**
Plant Manager Job Description
 
 
New Factory Launch and Steel Products Production
 
 
**Position**
Plant Manager
 
 
**Location**
Texas
 
 
**Focus**
New factory launch
 
 
**Production**
Steel products and roll forming
 
 
**Operating model**
Lean Manufacturing
 
 
**Language**
Bilingual, EnglishChinese speaking preferred
 
 
Position Summary
 
 
At FrameworX, we are accelerating the world’s transition to renewable energy through breakthrough engineering. The Plant Manager will lead the launch and ongoing operation of a new steel products factory in Texas, with an emphasis on roll forming. This leader will build the plant team, establish safe and reliable production, and ramp capacity to meet customer requirements. Lean Manufacturing principles will drive daily decisions, employee engagement, and continuous improvement across safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people development.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 
 
New Factory Launch
 
 

* Own the integrated factory launch plan, including milestones, staffing, capital spending, operational readiness, and risk mitigation.
* Coordinate facility readiness, equipment installation, commissioning, and production trials with engineering, contractors, and equipment suppliers.
* Establish plant layouts, material flow, production controls, work instructions, and training before production begins.
* Lead readiness reviews and capacity validation; resolve launch issues and transition the factory from startup to stable production.

Steel Production and Roll Forming
 
 

* Direct daily steel products production, with responsibility for roll forming throughput, quality, schedule attainment, and conversion cost.
* Work with engineering and quality to control coil specifications, tooling alignment, line setup, dimensional tolerances, cut length, and surface condition.
* Improve material yield, reduce scrap and changeover time, and eliminate recurring defects and equipment losses.
* Align production schedules, steel coil inventory, maintenance, and shipping with customer demand; establish preventive maintenance and critical spare parts plans.

Lean Manufacturing and Daily Management
 
 

* Make Lean Manufacturing the daily operating system through tiered accountability meetings, visual performance boards, gemba walks, and leader standard work.
* Review safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people metrics each day; assign countermeasures, owners, and due dates and verify sustained results.
* Apply 5S, standard work, value stream mapping, flow and pull systems, mistake proofing, and quick changeover methods where appropriate.
* Coach employees in structured root cause problem solving and kaizen; build a culture in which teams identify waste and improve their own processes.

Safety People and Business Leadership
 
 

* Set clear safety expectations and ensure effective training, machine guarding, hazardous energy control, and safe coil handling practices.
* Lead production, maintenance, quality, materials, and supporting teams; recruit and develop supervisors and establish clear performance expectations.
* Own plant budgets, labor planning, operating expenses, and capital priorities; use operating data to improve productivity and cost performance.
* Partner with HR, finance, engineering, supply chain, and suppliers to remove constraints and maintain effective communication throughout launch and ongoing operations.

**Required Qualifications**

* Demonstrated manufacturing leadership experience with accountability for plant or major production operations, people, budgets, and performance.
* Experience launching a new factory or leading a major manufacturing startup, including commissioning, workforce readiness, and production ramp-up.
* Strong steel products manufacturing experience, including practical knowledge of roll forming equipment, tooling, process controls, and troubleshooting.
* Proven ability to apply Lean Manufacturing principles through daily management and deliver sustained improvements in safety, quality, delivery, and cost.
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams, interpret production and financial data, and communicate clearly with employees and business leaders.
* Minimum 10 years in Plant Leadership role with P&L responsibility
* Posses or ability to get Chinese VISA
* International travel required

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Chinese speaking ability is preferred to support communication with Chinese-speaking equipment suppliers and technical partners.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, operations, business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience; Lean or Six Sigma training.

Work Location
 
 
This position is based onsite at the factory in Texas and requires active leadership on the production floor during launch and ongoing operations.
 
 
At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure.
 
 
Nextpower is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
 
 
**We are Nextpower**

records.title: Head of Plant Production Engineering
records.description:
Your Contribution
 
 
The Head of Plant Production Engineering is responsible for leading all Production Engineering activities associated with customer projects, product acquisitions, new product launches, industrialization, and production readiness within the plant. This position serves as the plant's primary owner for Production Engineering processes, ensuring successful execution of the Product Development Process (PDP) from acquisition through Start of Production (SOP) and ramp-up. The role provides leadership to Production Engineers, drives standardization and deployment of manufacturing concepts, ensures manufacturability of product designs, manages capital investments, and represents Operations within project core teams. The Plant Head of Production Engineering ensures project launches meet safety, quality, delivery, cost, and operational performance objectives.
 
 

* Lead, develop, coach, & manage the plant Production Engineering organization.
* Build organizational capability to support current and future product launches.
* Own industrialization activities for all customer projects within the plant. Ensure successful execution of product launches from acquisition and business transfer through SOP and stabilization.
* Lead development of manufacturing concepts, production processes, line layouts, and assembly strategies.
* Ensure product designs are manufacturable and meet operational standards.
* Coordinate launch readiness across Manufacturing Engineering, Tooling Engineering, Quality, Logistics, Purchasing, and Operations Support acquisition reviews and participate in PAC, PRC, and pre-development activities.
* Ensure implementation of Design-for-Manufacturing principles throughout project development. Ensure compliance with MAHLE PDP milestones, gates, deliverables, and timing requirements. Oversee completion of all Production Engineering deliverables throughout all quality gates.
* Monitor project status, risks, cost performance, capacity requirements, and launch readiness. Lead escalation activities when project risks threaten timing, quality, or cost objectives. Review project dashboards and launch metrics with plant leadership and program teams.
* Approve and govern: Manufacturing concepts, Process flows, Plant layouts, Assembly concepts, Material flow strategies, Value stream integration.
* Ensure application of Lean Manufacturing and Manufacturing Optimization Process (MOP) methodologies in alignment with Operations Excellence Manager.
* Drive takt-time analysis, line balancing, ergonomic studies, and capacity planning. Validate cycle times using MTM or equivalent engineering methods. Ensure implementation of standardized manufacturing processes across the region.
* Ensure development, completion, and approval of Process FMEA (P-FMEA), Control Plans, Special Characteristics, Process Capability Studies, Validation Plans. Support flawless launch activities and manufacturing risk reduction. Lead readiness reviews for installation checks, internal process approval, internal run at rate, customer run at rate, PPAP readiness. Ensure production systems consistently achieve quality and operational KPI’s.
* Lead capital expenditure planning and approval activities. Validate business cases and investment requirements. Ensure optimal utilization of existing equipment before requesting new capital. Support supplier selection through PDC and SDC processes. Approve manufacturing equipment specifications. Participate in procurement and acceptance of production equipment, tooling, fixtures, and test systems.
* Chair Production Engineering project meetings, and lead the plant Production Engineering Extended Team, ensuring effective communication between Project Core Teams and Plant Extended Teams.

**Your Experience & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree required, B.S. in Engineering, or related technical discipline required. Master’s Degree preferred.
* 8+ years’ experience in manufacturing, launch, industrialization, or production engineering.
* 5+ years’ progressive leadership responsibility regarding engineering or manufacturing operations.
* Demonstrated success in leading complex product launches and PDP projects.
* Experience in an automotive manufacturing facility required; high volume, medium to large campus experience preferred.
* Demonstrated knowledge in IATF16949, ISO14001 and 45001 Audits and processes.
* Excellent diagnostic abilities / root cause analysis required; Lean Six Sigma and Black Belt certification strongly preferred.

Our Offer
 
 
We will provide a collaborative environment working on exciting assignments, along with ongoing personal & career development opportunities. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles! After receiving your online application, the interview process will typically be, a screening call followed by Personal Interview(s).
 
 
For more information about MAHLE and what a career with us looks like for you, click here. and to learn more about our foundation owned technology group click here.
 
 
#DiversityMatters with our inclusive culture, we welcome applications from all social, religious & ethnical backgrounds, disabilities both mental and physical, identities (gender) and neurodivergent people.
 
 
MAHLE is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment based non-immigrant and immigrant visas. However, as a global company, MAHLE offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. which can be found through our employment website www.jobs.mahle.com
 
 
MAHLE Jobs & Career | Jobs With Opportunity to Advance MAHLE Careers
 
 
Find your job at MAHLE. Get to know this leading international supplier to the automotive industry as an employer. Shape the future, with us.
 
 
**Do you have any questions?**
SHEILA.HOOVER@MAHLE.COM

records.title: Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering
records.description:
White Bear Lake, MN
 
 
**About Heraeus**
Making displays foldable? Help hearts beat with micro-particles? Work on solutions involving precious metals? As a family-owned global technology group we help our customers to always being one step ahead.
 
 
**About Heraeus Medevio**
Heraeus Medevio combines medical technology expertise with collaborative partnerships. Together with medical device manufacturers, we develop and implement solutions for defined applications. As part of the Heraeus Group, we support the professional development of our employees and offer opportunities for career development, depending on the role, location and operational conditions.
 
 
To reach our vision of improving 100 million lives every year, we foster a culture of curiosity that thrives on challenge, continuous learning, growth, and the opportunity to try new things. With sites in the United States, European Union, and Asia, and over 2,200 employees worldwide, together, we will meet tomorrow's challenges today.
 
 
**Position Summary**
The Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering leads the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of advanced manufacturing technology across the Americas manufacturing network, including automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing. This role owns the design, development, validation, implementation, and maintenance of automated manufacturing equipment, assembly systems, robotics, vision inspection technologies, digital manufacturing solutions, and additive manufacturing processes and equipment that support the production of medical devices. The Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering role builds and leads a team of engineering professionals across these disciplines, sets technical direction and standards, and partners closely with Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, and Supply Chain to advance productivity, quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence across multiple sites.
 
 
**This is an onsite position at the White Bear Lake, MN location with travel to other global manufacturing sites.**
**What You’ll Do Every Day**

* Develop and execute the advanced manufacturing engineering roadmap (including automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing) aligned with business objectives.
* Establish long-term technology strategies to support manufacturing capacity expansion, cost reduction, and product quality improvement across the manufacturing network.
* Identify emerging technologies and evaluate opportunities for implementation, including robotics, AI-enabled inspection systems, Industry 4.0/digital manufacturing applications, advanced controls, and additive manufacturing processes and equipment.
* Lead capital equipment planning and investment strategy across automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing initiatives.
* Collaborate with Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Supply Chain, and external technology partners to enhance productivity, quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence.
* Direct a team responsible for automation engineering, controls engineering, robotics, machine vision, electrical engineering, digital manufacturing/manufacturing systems integration, and additive manufacturing.
* Build and mentor high-performing engineering teams through coaching, performance management, and talent development, while establishing engineering standards, best practices, and design methodologies across advanced manufacturing disciplines.
* Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with company policies and applicable laws, including selection, training and development, assigning work, and performance management of employees.
* Manage complex, multidisciplinary engineering projects from concept through implementation, delivering on time and within budget while meeting technical and quality requirements, and communicate progress and issues clearly to leadership to support project and site objectives.
* Manage external automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing integrators, contractors, and equipment suppliers.
* Develop and control departmental operating and capital budgets; establish project schedules, resource plans, and cost controls.
* Other duties may be assigned as required.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, or Industrial Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field required; Master’s degree in Engineering, MBA, or related discipline preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in automated manufacturing environments; experience in digital manufacturing and/or additive manufacturing strongly preferred.
* Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing engineering teams.
* Experience within medical device, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or other highly regulated manufacturing industries.
* Proven success leading large-scale automation, digital manufacturing, and/or additive manufacturing projects and capital equipment installations.
* Experience with equipment validation and regulatory compliance in FDA-regulated environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams across multiple sites and drive continuous improvement and digitalization initiatives.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, project management, and organizational skills.
* Ability and willingness to travel across the Americas manufacturing network (White Bear Lake, MN; Costa Rica; Puerto Rico), approximately 25-50% of the time.

*Medevio is committed to providing competitive total compensation and benefits packages. The expected hiring range for this position is between $160,000 and $190,000 based upon a full-time schedule. This is a good faith estimate on the applicable range. Base salaries are determined by taking a variety of factors in account, including, but not limited to, candidate qualifications, geographic locations, market conditions and internal equity. This position is bonus eligible, with a target bonus of 20%. Our total compensation package includes eligibility for comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with company match, education reimbursement, paid parental leave and paid time off.*
**Curious? Apply now!**
Heraeus is proud to be an employer that provides equal access to opportunities for all its employees. We provide fair and equal consideration to all qualified applicants, regardless of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other legally protected characteristic. A diverse and inclusive culture is at the heart of our Vision, Mission, and Values. We are dedicated to cultivating a workforce that reflects a broad spectrum of cultures, backgrounds, and perspectives.
 
 
We participate in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility after hire. Learn more at www.e-verify.gov
 
 
**Any further questions?**
If you need any assistance or have questions, please contact hrdirect-americas@heraeus.com or visit our website at jobs.heraeus.com.

records.title: Director, Turnkey Projects and Manufacturing Operations
records.description:
We are looking for someone to join our growing team to lead the planning, execution, and delivery of complex, CNC manufacturing turn-key machine tool solutions. This role combines technical leadership, project management, customer engagement, and team development. The ideal candidate will be responsible for taking large, turnkey manufacturing projects from initial customer requirements through engineering development, testing, implementation, and final acceptance. You will lead projects involving a wide range of CNC technologies. You will coordinate internal engineering resources, customers, machine-tool and tooling vendors, partners, and other suppliers to ensure projects are delivered on schedule, within scope, and to the required technical and quality standards. The Director of Turnkey Projects and Manufacturing Operations will be responsible for establishing project priorities, managing expectations, identifying risks, resolving technical and organizational issues, and ensuring successful project outcomes. While this is a leadership and project-management position, a strong understanding of CNC programming, CAM, manufacturing processes, machine tools, and controls is required. The successful candidate should be comfortable engaging deeply with technical teams and making informed decisions on complex manufacturing challenges when required.

**About Empire Dynamics Machinery, LLC**

Empire Dynamics was founded in 2015 in Albany, New York. Starting as a single-person consulting company serving the machine tool industry, Empire has grown into a well-recognized 10-person manufacturing engineering team serving all sectors of the CNC machining industry. Primarily through the deployment of NX CAM, Siemens Motion Control Software, and turnkey CNC solutions, we bring real world manufacturing experience to the production of real parts.

We are now recognized around the world for creating NX Productivity Environments, which are machine- and customer-specific NX CAM environments designed to streamline the development of CNC manufacturing processes. We take pride in the CNC technology we have developed and our ability to put it to use in a practical manufacturing setting.

Our team is a motivated group of critical thinkers that collectively wants to see change where change is due, and we spend our days working to realize that for ourselves and our customers.

**Description**

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

The Director will be accountable for ensuring these responsibilities are fulfilled, whether through direct involvement, delegation to existing team members, or the development of additional team capabilities as the business grows. The role requires both hands-on leadership and the ability to build scalable processes, teams, and organizational capabilities.

**Project Management**

* Lead complex, multi-disciplinary CNC manufacturing projects from project initiation through customer acceptance.
* Establish project scope, objectives, deliverables, schedules, milestones, and priorities.
* Develop and maintain project plans, resource requirements, budgets, and delivery schedules.
* Coordinate engineering resources across multiple concurrent customer projects.
* Monitor project progress, identify risks and constraints, and implement corrective actions.
* Establish project priorities and ensure engineering activities remain aligned with customer and business objectives.
* Lead regular project status meetings and communicate project health to customers and internal leadership.
* Manage project changes, scope adjustments, technical issues, and customer requests.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time and meet defined technical and customer requirements.
* Develop project documentation, status reports, action plans, and lesson-learned documentation.
* Establish and improve project management processes, standards, and best practices across the organization.

**CNC Process Engineering Leadership**

* Provide technical direction for the development of comprehensive CNC manufacturing processes.
* Oversee development of CAM programming, tooling strategies, fixturing, workholding, process parameters, and setup documentation.
* Review and approve process plans and CAM development strategies.
* Guide engineers in analyzing critical machining operations for feasibility, efficiency, and optimization.
* Oversee development of stage models, setup sheets, work instructions, and related manufacturing documentation.
* Coordinate tooling suppliers and manufacturing partners.
* Support development of process outlines to distribute engineering work effectively across the team.
* Provide technical leadership during machine setup, program verification, and customer program runoff.
* Maintain awareness of current CNC machining technologies and manufacturing practices.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop CNC manufacturing engineers and technical staff.
* Assign project responsibilities based on team capabilities, project requirements, and priorities.
* Establish clear expectations for technical quality, project execution, documentation, and communication.
* Provide technical and professional mentorship to developing engineers.
* Identify training and development opportunities for team members.
* Encourage knowledge sharing and standardization across projects.
* Help establish career-development paths and technical competency expectations for the engineering team.
* Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, curiosity, and continuous improvement.

**Vendor & Partner Management**

* Oversee the development of relationships with tooling manufacturers, machine-tool builders, software providers, and other technical partners.
* Manage vendor activities associated with project tooling, fixturing, machine capabilities, and software requirements.
* Establish technical requirements and deliverables for external suppliers.
* Monitor vendor performance against project schedules and requirements.
* Serve as an escalation point for technical or project-related vendor issues.

**TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE**

The successful candidate should have sufficient technical knowledge to effectively lead highly specialized CNC engineering projects. Experience with the following is highly desirable:

* NX CAM and CNC programming
* CAM programming and toolpath development
* CNC machine tools, including milling, turning, mill-turn, HMC, VTC, grinding, and specialty machines
* CNC machine controls, macros, probing, and advanced machine functions
* CAD modeling
* Cutting tools, feeds, speeds, and machining strategies
* Fixture design and workholding
* Manufacturing process development
* CNC machine commissioning and runoff
* NX CAM templates and productivity environments
* Teamcenter, MRL, and machining data libraries
* Software development or scripting
* Manufacturing engineering and machine-shop operations

The Director is not expected to personally perform every technical task. Rather, the position requires the ability to understand complex technical issues, establish direction, evaluate solutions, allocate resources, and ensure the engineering team delivers the appropriate solution.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, science, mathematics, manufacturing, or another relevant technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Significant experience in CNC programming, CAM, manufacturing engineering, or a related technical field.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical projects or engineering teams.
* Strong project planning, organization, and prioritization skills.
* Excellent written, verbal, analytical, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Ability to understand engineering drawings, specifications, and customer requirements.
* Willingness and ability to travel to customer sites as required.

**Preferred**

Experience with:

* Managing complex, customer-facing manufacturing projects.
* Using NX CAM and Siemens manufacturing software.
* Post-processors and CNC controls.
* Leading engineering or technical teams.
* Software development or technical product development.
* Working directly with machine-tool builders, tooling manufacturers, or manufacturing suppliers.
* Developing manufacturing processes for multiple CNC machine types.
* Project management methodologies, scheduling, budgeting, and resource planning.
* Customer acceptance testing and technical implementation projects.

Knowledge of:

* Variety of CNC controllers and willing to learn new controller types
* CNC programming techniques and process
* Feeds, speeds, and cutting tool applications
* Geometry and trigonometry
* Fixture specifications, design, and work holding.

A strong sense of curiosity and problem-solving skills

Demonstrated proficiency interpreting drawing and specification requirements

**Leadership Characteristics**

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

* Ownership: Takes responsibility for project outcomes from initiation through completion.
* Leadership: Provides clear direction while empowering technical experts to perform their best work.
* Customer focus: Understands customer objectives and translates them into practical engineering solutions.
* Technical curiosity: Enjoys learning new technologies, machines, software, and manufacturing processes.
* Communication: Clearly communicates priorities, risks, decisions, and expectations.
* Organization: Can manage complex projects involving multiple stakeholders and parallel workstreams.
* Problem solving: Approaches difficult technical and organizational challenges systematically.
* Continuous improvement: Looks for opportunities to improve both customer solutions and internal processes.
* Accountability: Establishes measurable expectations and follows through on commitments.

**Location**

Albany, New York or Remote.

**Travel Requirements**

20% travel to customer sites, partners, or other business-related travel.

**About Empire Dynamics**

Empire Dynamics was founded in 2015 in Albany, New York. Starting as a single-person consulting company serving the machine tool industry, Empire has grown into a well-recognized 13-person manufacturing engineering team serving all sectors of the CNC machining industry. Primarily through the deployment of NX CAM, Siemens Motion Control Software, and turnkey CNC solutions, we bring real world manufacturing experience to the production of real parts.

We are now recognized around the world for creating NX Productivity Environments, which are machine- and customer-specific NX CAM environments designed to streamline the development of CNC manufacturing processes. We take pride in the CNC technology we have developed and our ability to put it to use in a practical manufacturing setting.

Our team is a motivated group of critical thinkers with a collective goal to pursue change where change is due, and we spend our days working to realize that for ourselves and our customers.

**BENEFITS**

* Medical Insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Retirement
* Disability Insurance
* Generous Paid LeaveThe Role

records.title: Director of Operations and Engineering
records.description:
**About SSI**
SS Industries is a Collegeville, PA-based manufacturer of premium Spiral and Floating Stairs. Stairs are designed and manufactured in-house using steel, aluminum, and wood, and shipped directly to customers across the U.S. and Canada. SSI is part of the MBP Group, a family of home-building products companies.
 
 
**Position Summary**
The Director of Operations leads all day-to-day engineering and manufacturing responsibilities at SSI. This person owns product design/execution, safety, quality, efficiency, on-time delivery, and cost. They build a strong team, keep production running smoothly through busy seasons, and drive continuous improvement.
 
 
In addition, the Director of Operations works with the SSI Leadership Team to develop and implement key company strategic efforts. They work cross-functionally with the other directors to ensure strong business performance.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead a strong safety culture where associates look out for each other and return to their homes safely.
* Own OSHA compliance, safety training, incident investigations, and corrective actions.
* Work with the Production Manager to ensure maximized capacity, labor, fabrication, welding, and powder coating to achieve communicated lead times, especially during peak seasons.
* Drive the Quality Team to reduce defects, rework, and customer complaints through root cause problem solving.
* Work with Customer Service and Engineering to resolve product issues quickly.
* Identify and lead projects that reduce waste and cost.
* Partner with the Purchasing Team to maintain appropriate inventory levels on raw materials like steel, aluminum, and wood to support production levels.
* Build and manage the Operations Annual Operating Plan and budget.
* Control labor, overtime, materials, and maintenance costs.
* Identify, recommend, and justify capital investments.
* Work closely with the President, Finance and the Commercial teams on forecasts, priorities, and customer commitments.
* Partner with Engineering and Marketing on the development and execution of new products and custom orders.
* Work closely with external vendors and partners to ensure consistent progress.
* Share best practices with operations leaders across the MBP Group.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Operations, Engineering, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years in operations, with experience leading several departments, such as engineering, quality, production, or supply chain.
* 8+ years of manufacturing experience, with at least 5 years leading plant teams.
* Experience in metal fabrication, welding, or building products manufacturing.
* Strong track record improving safety, quality, delivery, and cost.
* Hands-on experience with Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement.
* Proven ability to lead and develop supervisors and hourly teams, alike.
* Comfortable developing, reporting, presenting, and leading with data, KPIs, and budgets.
* Strong communication skills at every level of the organization (both internal and external).
* Can scale operations as the company grows.
* Onsite presence in Collegeville, PA

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with engineer-to-order fabrication (architectural metals, stairs and railings, millwork, structural steel or similar) and/or direct-to-consumer manufacturing.
* Has run a P&L or departmental budget and capital projects and has managed through supervisors and managers.
* Experience in a private equity-backed or multi-site company.
* Lean manufacturing experience (5S, value-stream mapping, kaizen). Lean or Six Sigma certification.
* Hands-on approach and comfortability on the shop floor.
* ERP or MRP system experience.
* OSHA 30 certification.

records.title: Director of Engineering, Global Manufacturing Engineering & NPI
records.description:
The Director of Engineering leads Manufacturing Engineering, Process Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Test Engineering, Test Automation, NPI Engineering, and Customer TPM teams for a global data center rack manufacturing business. This role is responsible for engineering execution at the New Jersey manufacturing campus and for establishing global engineering standards, processes, and best practices across all manufacturing locations.
 
 
The Director drives manufacturing readiness, automation, operational excellence, quality, productivity, and successful new product introductions while partnering closely with customers and Platform Engineering. Platform Engineering retains ownership of product design, architecture, DFM approval, and Level 3 technical solutioning.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**
**Manufacturing Engineering Leadership**

* Lead Manufacturing Engineering, Test Engineering, Test Automation, NPI Engineering, Industrial Engineering, and Customer TPM organizations.
* Establish and deploy global engineering standards, SOPs, governance, and best practices.
* Develop engineering talent, succession plans, and organizational capability.

**Manufacturing Excellence**

* Own engineering performance for the New Jersey campus and drive global engineering consistency.
* Optimize manufacturing flows, capacity, labor efficiency, throughput, and cycle time.
* Deliver improvements in FPY, RTPY, DPPM, OEE, cost, quality, and delivery performance.
* Drive KPI management systems and operational review rigor.

**Automation & Test Strategy**

* Define and execute factory automation and smart manufacturing roadmaps.
* Lead deployment of robotics, vision systems, automated assembly, digital manufacturing, and Industry 4.0 solutions.
* Own manufacturing test strategy, test automation, diagnostics, traceability, and test system scalability.

**New Product Introduction (NPI)**

* Own manufacturing readiness throughout all NPI phase gates.
* Ensure readiness of processes, tooling, automation, test systems, capacity, and staffing.
* Lead pilot builds, manufacturing validation, launch readiness reviews, and production ramps.
* Identify and mitigate manufacturing risks to schedule, quality, and scalability.

**Customer & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Lead customer-facing TPM teams and serve as executive engineering interface for strategic customers.

* Product requirements

records.description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.
 
 
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
 
 
**Job Function**
Supply Chain Engineering
 
 
**Job Sub Function**
Process Engineering
 
 
**Job Category**
People Leader
 
 
**All Job Posting Locations:**
Wilson, North Carolina, United States of America
 
 
**Job Description**
**About Innovative Medicine**
Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.
 
 
Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.
 
 
Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/innovative-medicine
 
 
Learn more and apply to this exciting new role!
 
 
As part of the Global Process Engineering team, the Director, Aseptic DP Process Engineering, is the technical expert and will provide overall E2E process engineering leadership to equipment and facility design of a new DP aseptic manufacturing node. They will be accountable for all technical aspects of process engineering areas (warehouse, laboratories, clean utilities, preparation, compounding/filling, optical inspection, and device assembly and packaging) ensuring the efficient design and operational readiness and start-up of the new site in compliance to cGMP and industry standards.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Development and delivery of all process engineering specifications (user requirements, data sheets, technical specifications
* Assess vendor competency and capabilities, review and discuss bid documents, and be held accountable for project development and execution, including performance of the process systems
* Technical issue resolution on the system during C&Q testing and the readiness of the system to start C&Q activities
* Helping to identify and expedite key activities across multiple business functions (Manufacturing, Facilities, MSAT, Quality, Procurement, E&PS (Engineering & Property Services), and EHS
* Ensure alignment across evolving business needs and require strong partner management and leadership skills to collaborate across these multiple business partners.
* Maintaining a solid understanding of industry trends and benchmarking against internal/external practices
* Actively participate in inclusion initiatives to build a well-rounded, high performing engineering team
* Cultivate a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and innovation to enable multi-functional learning and standard methodology sharing
* Develop and mentor engineering team members to ensure a strong talent pipeline
* Apply data-driven insights and market intelligence to advise future decision making, stay informed on industry and regulatory trends, and adapt strategies accordingly to achieve excellent portfolio performance.
* Ensure compliance with policies, procedures, government regulations, and customer specifications
* Collaborate with an engineering firm to advance the facility design

**Qualifications**
**Education:**

* Minimum of a Bachelor's Degree in engineering required (Mechanical or Chemical Engineering preferred), MS or MBA preferred.

**Experience And Skills**
**Required:**

* A minimum 15 plus years in drug product experience in a biotherapeutics cGMP environment (preferably in process engineering or capital project execution)
* A minimum 5 plus years of people leadership experience
* Shown success in building and developing high performing team
* Track record of developing and maintaining strong partnerships at all levels within the organization, including key stakeholders
* Ability to lead and motivate multicultural teams and remote customers
* Excellent problem-solving skills when handling potential conflicts
* Understanding sophisticated technical/regulatory issues impacting facility/equipment design

**Solid Understanding Of The Following**

* cGMP’s for aseptic manufacturing of multiple regulatory bodies (EU, FDA), including fluency in the understanding of new EU Annex 1 guidelines and its impact on facility/equipment design
* EHS requirements, with particular focus on EHS by design and construction safety
* Start-up processes and Commissioning & Qualification
* Principles for Engineering Design for drug products in the Biotherapeutic industry
* Construction & Procurement process
* Project Controls processes
* Project scheduling
* Strong technical process engineering knowledge and experience and has a great passion for solving highly complex technical problems
* Strong problem solving, communication, and decision-making skills to drive impact in a fast-paced evolving business landscape
* Ability to drive process engineering innovation for equipment and facilities ensuring technical knowledge is maintained and expanded throughout the team

**Preferred**

* Consistent track record on leading capital projects in the range of 250 – 500 MM$ (preferred)
* Strong process engineering expertise in conceptual design through C&Q (commissioning & qualification) to ensure efficient operational readiness within a biotherapeutic drug product environment.
* Leadership experience in a greenfield project(s)

**Other**

* This position will be located in Wilson, North Carolina, and will require full time on-site support. However, the design of the facility will occur at an Engineering firm with frequent travel (> 75%) required until the project shifts to the plant site of Wilson, NC

If you are under 18 years of age, you (the candidate) may need to obtain the necessary working papers or other documentation required by state law to start the assignment, as well as get a parent’s consent for the background check.

records.title: Manufacturing Engineering Director
records.description:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available
 
 
CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: No
 
 
CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret
 
 
TRAVEL: Yes, 10% of the Time
 
 
**Description**
At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.
 
 
The
**Director, Manufacturing Engineering**
provides functional and strategic leadership for the manufacturing engineering organization, accountable for process capability, producibility, and product quality across production programs. This role leads a team of managers and engineers responsible for developing, deploying, and continuously improving manufacturing, test, and related industrial engineering processes to meet safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people objectives in
**Baltimore, MD**
.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 
 

* Functional & People Leadership

+ Lead and develop a high‑performing manufacturing engineering organization, including managers, engineers, and supporting staff.
+ Define and maintain functional standards, methods, tools, and best practices for manufacturing engineering across the site or business.
+ Recruit, develop, and retain talent; drive succession planning, leadership development, and engagement/inclusion activities.
+ Provide regular coaching, performance feedback, and career development for managers and engineers.

* Manufacturing Engineering Ownership

+ Own manufacturing engineering processes from new product introduction through sustainment, ensuring robust process controls, standard work, and documented work instructions.
+ Direct the creation and maintenance of MBOMs, routings, work instructions, tooling, and strategies that enable safe, efficient, and high‑quality production.
+ Drive producibility into designs by partnering with Design Engineering early in the lifecycle; ensure effective transition to production and rate readiness.
+ Establish and manage key performance indicators (yields, scrap, rework, cycle time, labor efficiency) and drive continuous improvement using data‑driven methods.

* Operations, Quality, and Continuous Improvement

+ Partner closely with Operations, Quality & Mission Excellence, and Supply Chain to ensure stable processes and timely resolution of production issues.
+ Oversee manufacturing engineering participation in MRB and nonconformance disposition; ensure effective root‑cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions.
+ Champion initiatives to improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost.
+ Lead manufacturing engineering support to factory readiness, capacity planning, and rate ramp‑ups.

* Program, Financial, and Strategic Management

+ Align functional objectives, resources, and priorities with program and business needs; balance near‑term execution with long‑term capability development.
+ Partner with Program Management and Business Management to support bids, proposals, and program execution, including manufacturing scope, risk, and cost/schedule inputs.
+ Own manufacturing engineering budgets (labor, capital, and expense) and apply sound financial management.
+ Develop and execute technology roadmaps and capital investment plans for manufacturing processes, equipment, and facilities.

* Compliance, Governance, and Stakeholder Management

+ Ensure manufacturing engineering processes comply with regulatory requirements, customer standards, and internal procedures.
+ Represent manufacturing engineering in internal and external reviews, audits, and customer engagements.
+ Build strong relationships with sector/site leadership, program teams, and functional peers to drive alignment and resolve cross‑functional constraints.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related discipline with 10 or more years of relevant experience; OR a Master’s degree in Engineering or a related discipline with 8 or more years of relevant experience.
* 3 or more years of functional management experience leading organizations of at least 100 employees.
* Progressive leadership experience in manufacturing/production, operations, program management, testing, or a related area, including direct leadership of engineers and/or first‑line managers.
* Demonstrated experience in manufacturing or production engineering supporting complex hardware (e.g., aerospace, defense, electronics, or similar).
* Proven track record of improving manufacturing and test processes, yields, cycle times, and product quality using data and metrics.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing process controls, quality systems, and relevant industry/regulatory standards.
* Demonstrated financial acumen including budgets, rates, and cost management
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly present technical and operational content to leadership and customers.
* U.S. citizenship and an ability to obtain U.S. Government Secret security clearance or greater; OR DoE equivalent or greater

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Engineering, Engineering Management, Business Administration, or related field.
* Experience in a Director or senior manager role leading a manufacturing engineering or test engineering organization in an aerospace/defense or similarly regulated environment.
* Experience working across multiple disciplines (design, manufacturing, and test engineering) with a strong focus on product development, producibility, and transition to production.
* Hands‑on experience with continuous improvement frameworks
* Experience managing capital equipment roadmaps and facilities upgrades to support long‑term manufacturing capacity and capability.
* Proven ability to build and develop high‑performing teams, including succession planning, leadership development, and engagement initiatives.
* Experience supporting proposals and customer reviews, including articulation of manufacturing engineering approaches, risks, and mitigations.
* Experience working in a matrixed organization, balancing program demands with functional standards and development needs.

Primary Level Salary Range: $194,600.00 - $292,000.00
 
 
The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.
 
 
Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.
 
 
The application period for the job is estimated to be 20 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.
 
 
Northrop Grumman is an Equal Opportunity Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class. For our complete EEO and pay transparency statement, please visit http://www.northropgrumman.com/EEO. U.S. Citizenship is required for all positions with a government clearance and certain other restricted positions.

records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.
 
 
**Job Description**
Shield AI is seeking a highly driven Sr. Manager Materials Planning & Logistics to lead supply planning, material readiness, production planning, and logistics execution for next-generation autonomous aircraft development programs and a new greenfield manufacturing facility. This leadership role is accountable for establishing the people, processes, systems, and infrastructure required to support rapid product development, new product introduction, and the transition to scalable rate production.
 
 
The ideal candidate combines strong operational leadership with hands-on execution, thrives in fast-paced environments, and has experience building manufacturing and supply chain capabilities from the ground up. You will work cross-functionally with Engineering, Program Management, Quality, Procurement, and Operations teams.
 
 
**What You'll Do**
Development Program Materials Planning
 
 

* Own the materials planning, production control, inventory, warehousing, and logistics strategy.
* Partner with Engineering, Program Management, and Procurement to develop and maintain accurate build plans that are aligned with program milestones.
* Define and monitor key performance indicators for schedule attainment, material availability, shortage reduction, inventory health, work-order execution, and planning accuracy.
* Identify long-lead material risks and implement mitigation strategies to protect schedule.
* Oversee the development and execution of material recovery plans.
* Drive engineering change management processes to support rapid development and ECO implementation.
* Develop planning models that support rapid prototyping, design iteration, and low-rate initial production activities.
* Support executive-level program and operations reviews by clearly communicating material status, risks, business impacts, and required decisions.

Greenfield Facility Build & Operational Readiness
 
 

* Lead planning and logistics readiness activities for a new manufacturing facility.
* Design and implement warehouse, stockroom, and material flow processes from receiving through point-of-use consumption.
* Establish inventory control procedures, material storage standards, and transaction discipline.
* Partner with Manufacturing Engineering and Facilities teams to optimize material movement and operational efficiency.

Team Leadership
 
 

* Create a culture focused on accountability, operational excellence, continuous improvement, and mission execution.
* Establish standard work and training programs.
* Drive cross-functional collaboration to solve complex challenges.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or related field.
* 7+ years of experience in materials planning, inventory management, or supply chain operations.
* Experience supporting complex hardware development programs in aerospace, defense, automotive, robotics, or advanced manufacturing environments.
* Demonstrated experience implementing or scaling material planning and inventory management processes.
* Strong understanding of MRP/ERP systems and supply chain planning methodologies.
* Experience managing material readiness for new product introduction (NPI) and engineering development programs.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly dynamic environment with evolving priorities.
* Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain/maintain a security clearance

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting greenfield manufacturing facility launches or major facility expansions.
* Aerospace, defense, unmanned systems, or advanced technology manufacturing experience.
* Experience with Oracle, SAP, Costpoint, or similar ERP platforms.
* APICS/ASCM certifications (CPIM, CSCP) or equivalent.
* Familiarity with ITAR, EAR, DFARS, and government contracting requirements.
* Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or operational excellence experience.
* Experience supporting production ramp and transition from development to rate manufacturing.

**Why Shield AI**
At Shield AI, you'll help build technology that matters. You'll work alongside world-class engineers, operators, and innovators solving some of the most challenging problems in autonomy and national security. This is a unique opportunity to shape the foundation of a rapidly growing aerospace and defense company while helping bring revolutionary autonomous systems into operational service.
 
 
#LD
 
 
**Full-time Regular Employee Offer Package**
Pay within range listed + Bonus + Benefits + Equity
 
 
**Temporary Employee Offer Package**
Pay within range listed above + temporary benefits package (applicable after 60 days of employment)
 
 
Salary compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, licenses and certifications, and specific work location. All offers are contingent on a cleared background and possible reference check. Military fellows and part-time employees are not eligible for benefits. Please speak to your talent acquisition representative for more information.
 
 
###
 
 
Shield AI is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.
 
 
Compensation Range: $167,328 - $250,992

records.title: Senior Manager of Operations
records.description:
**Senior Manager of Operations - Austin, TX**

**DESCRIPTION:**

We’re seeking a hands-on Sr. Operations Manager with experience scaling silicon-based products in a semiconductor company. This player-coach role owns the operational path from foundry and wafer production through test, backend processing, and manufacturing. You’ll qualify and manage manufacturing vendors, establish and strengthen quality-control measures, and drive consistent quality, yield, cost, and delivery as production grows.

Experience with RFID inlay production is especially relevant.

**What you’ll do:**

* Own foundry relationships from negotiation through production execution, and scale wafer level production.
* Manage wafer-test facility relationships; evaluate and qualify test partners, and select test equipment to optimize cost, quality, and throughput.
* Lead test development, wafer backend operations, yield improvement, reliability, and failure analysis.
* Qualify and manage manufacturing vendors, including overseeing end-to-end inlay production and its ramp to volume.
* Establish and improve quality-control measures, operating procedures, and RMA processes.
* Monitor supplier quality, conduct supply-chain audits, and resolve manufacturing, quality, and delivery issues.
* Establish and improve ERP/MRP processes, WIP tracking, inventory planning, and production controls.
* Develop cost models, negotiate contracts, and drive improvements in cost, quality, and delivery.
* Manage one direct report and coordinate work across four internal engineers and executive stakeholders, including the CEO.

**What you’ll bring:**

* BSEE or equivalent practical experience.
* 7–10 years of operations, manufacturing, or related experience in a semiconductor company.
* Experience with RFID inlay manufacturing is a plus.
* Hands-on experience with silicon-based products and semiconductor manufacturing operations.
* Experience scaling products from wafer fabrication and test through backend processing and volume production.
* Experience working with foundries, wafer-test facilities, and manufacturing vendors.
* Familiarity with yield optimization, reliability, quality assurance, supplier audits, failure analysis, ERP/MRP systems, WIP tracking, and inventory planning.
* Strong communication, coordination, and negotiation skills, with a practical, roll-up-your sleeves approach.
