records.description:
PLANT MANAGER

\*WE ARE LOOKING FOR THREE PLANT MANAGERS TO SUPPORT OUR STEEL PROCESSING FACILITIES: GARY, IN; OIL CITY, PA ; WASHINGTON, PA.

The Plant Manager will manage and oversee all aspects of plant operations (safety, quality, production etc.) as well as P&L. They will oversee securing customer contracts and new business opportunities. They combine business knowledge with technical knowledge to optimize profitability and efficiency when it comes to the related products and/or services.

· Identify, implement, and support safety, environmental, lean manufacturing, quality, and process improvements.

· Directly supervisor employees in HR, Accounting, Purchasing and Operations.

* Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; address complaints and resolving problems.
* Lead teams in achieving performance goals associated with safety, quality, delivery, and cost.
* Allocate and manage resources (labor, capacity, and materials) to optimize productivity.
* Participate in product team meetings to help effectively improve product line performance and strategic planning.
* Demonstrate initiative and willingness to find improvements using Lean Manufacturing.

records.description:
### **Summary**

The Production Manager oversees the operations of the entire production facility (excluding purchasing, personnel, and non-production functions), with a focus on the Converting department. This role ensures adherence to company policies and procedures while driving optimal operational performance. The manager directly supervises Converting employees and supervisors.

**Perks of Pratt:**

* Medical/Dental/Vision Plans
* Short Term/Long Term Disability
* Supplemental Life Insurance Plans
* Child Bearing/Parental Leave
* 401K Plan with Company Match
* Paid Holidays/Paid Vacation
* Uniforms/Safety Shoes/Prescription Safety Glasses
* Healthy Lifestyles Program/ Virgin Pulse Fitness Tracker
* $500.0/Year Gym Membership Reimbursement100% Tuition Reimbursement/Assistance Program
* Income Protection Plans
* Legal & Travel Assistance Plans
* EAP/Home Auto Insurance Plans
* Wireless/Auto/Computer Discount Plans

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **Production & Operations**

* Provide full production support, with a strong emphasis on converting machine performance.
* Maximize productivity and minimize downtime through effective resource management.
* Coordinate with Maintenance on PMs, MVP, and machine uptime goals.
* Oversee converting production, including equipment installation and major repairs.
* Support cost-reduction strategies and drive productivity improvements.
* Ensure compliance with all company policies, safety protocols, and quality standards.

#### **Quality & Safety**

* Ensure plant focus on quality processes and tools for each converting machine.
* Maintain plant housekeeping standards and ensure machine cleaning programs are current.
* Drive safety initiatives and uphold OSHA, EPA, and company regulations.
* Oversee all audit protocols (third-party, customer, and internal).

#### **Leadership & Supervision**

* Directly supervise Converting employees and supervisors.
* Set and communicate quality, efficiency, and production standards.
* Provide training, coaching, conflict resolution, performance evaluations, and disciplinary action as needed.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, teamwork, and high morale.

#### **Administrative & Strategic Support**

* Evaluate new methods, machinery, and safety programs; contribute to planning, budgeting, and purchasing.
* Maintain optimal staffing levels daily.
* Communicate issues to the General Manager in a timely manner.
* Remain on-call and available after hours to address urgent production issues.
* Perform additional duties as assigned by management.

### **Qualifications**

#### **Required**

* High school diploma or GED
* 10 years of experience in corrugated manufacturing
* 5 years of proven management experience in a production environment

#### **Preferred**

* College degree
* Experience with Ward Servo Pro Die Cutters, Bobst 8.2, and Gopfert Die-Cutters
* 5+ years in converting manufacturing operations
* 2+ years in a supervisory role
* Proficiency in Lean/5S, OSHA, EPA regulations
* Mechanically inclined with strong troubleshooting skills
* Strong project management and coaching abilities

### **Skills & Competencies**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Sound mathematical and analytical capabilities
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and lead effective meetings
* Emotional resilience and conflict resolution skills
* Positive leadership presence and professional demeanor

### **Performance Measurements**

* **Operating Standards:** Meets/exceeds performance goals for production and customer service
* **Personal Growth:** Achieves annual professional development goals
* **Employee Relations:** Demonstrates effective team development, coaching, and motivation
* **Creativity:** Contributes innovative ideas to improve business operations

### **Physical & Work Environment Requirements**

* Regular walking, talking, hearing; frequent standing and reaching; occasional sitting
* Visual requirements include close, distance, color, peripheral vision, depth perception, and focus adjustment
* Exposure to wet/humid conditions, mechanical parts, fumes/particles, and high noise levels

Requirements:

Pratt Industries is America's 5th largest paper and packaging company with more than 10,000 highly skilled employees dedicated to the environment and sustainability. Pratt Industries is one of the largest corrugated packaging companies in America, with sophisticated manufacturing facilities in more than a dozen states. The company operates three of the most modern, cost effective paper mills in the country, as well as a series of sheet and box plants strategically placed throughout the United States offering a wide range of creative packaging solutions. Pratt Industries is committed to recycling and the environment by “harvesting the urban forest." 
Pratt Industries offers competitive compensation plans with incentive opportunities, full benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, FSA, All State, Pre-Paid Legal, and 401(k) with company match, paid vacation, and paid holidays.

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
As a leader and innovator in the snack food industry for over 50 years, J&J Snack Foods provides branded snack foods to foodservice and retail supermarket outlets across the U.S. Its products include such icons as SUPERPRETZEL, ICEE, and Dippin' Dots along with other key brands like LUIGI'S Real Italian Ice, The Funnel Cake Factory Funnel Cakes, and Hola Churros. J&J also has a strong presence in bakery providing cakes, cookies, and pies to some of the largest grocery and convenience retailers in industry. Our company continues to deliver record sales led by a talented team and a commitment to "Fun Served Here".

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

Reporting to the Senior Director of Plant Operations, the Plant Manager serves as the senior leader responsible for the overall operational performance of a high-volume snack food manufacturing plant. This role oversees all day-to-day plant activities and is accountable for safety, quality, service, cost, people, and culture. The Plant Manager leads cross-functional teams across production, maintenance, quality, warehouse, planning, and sanitation to ensure the efficient production of high-quality products in alignment with company standards and financial targets. This position combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution, translating company objectives into daily plant operations while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement. The Plant Manager plays a critical role in delivering the production plan, enhancing productivity and profitability, and fostering a safe, engaged, and high-performing workforce.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS****:**

* Leads and manages all aspects of plant operations, including production, maintenance, quality, warehouse, planning, and sanitation, to ensure the safe, efficient, and timely manufacturing of high-quality products.

* Establishes and sustains a strong safety culture by promoting a zero-injury mindset; ensure full compliance with all OSHA, FDA, GMP, HACCP, and environmental regulations through proactive programs, audits, and corrective actions.

* Delivers the production plan on time and in full by optimizing operational performance, including OEE, labor efficiency, yield, and waste reduction, while identifying and eliminating constraints and bottlenecks.

* Partners with Quality to uphold the highest food safety and product standards; ensure adherence to all quality systems, maintain audit readiness, and lead root cause analysis and corrective actions for quality deviations.

* Builds, leads, and develops a high-performing team by recruiting, training, and coaching supervisors and frontline employees; fosters a culture of accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement, while supporting succession planning and positive employee/labor relations.

* Owns and manages the plant's financial performance, including the operating budget, labor and overtime costs, waste, and conversion costs; monitor expenditures and drive cost-effective operations aligned with business objectives.

* Champions continuous improvement initiatives by implementing Lean manufacturing principles, 5S, and structured problem-solving methodologies; lead kaizen events and leverage data and KPIs to drive performance and decision-making.

* Ensures equipment reliability and optimal facility performance through strong partnership with maintenance; oversee preventive maintenance programs and manage capital improvement projects to support operational efficiency and long-term growth.

* Collaborates cross-functionally with Planning, Procurement, Engineering, Quality, and Distribution to align materials, staffing, and maintenance plans with production needs, including support for new product introductions and process changes.

* Tracks, analyzes, and reports key performance indicators related to safety, quality, delivery, cost, and people; communicate performance and improvement plans effectively to senior leadership.

* Performs other duties and special projects assigned to support plant operations and organizational objectives.

**COMPETENCIES:**

To perform this job successfully, the Plant Manager must be self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to solve problems while staying focused on priorities. The following knowledge, skills, and abilities are required:

* Excellent planning, organizational, and time-management skills, with the ability to balance production and maintenance priorities.

* Proven leadership and team-building abilities, including advanced coaching, employee development, and motivation skills.

* Exceptional interpersonal, communication, and active listening skills.

* Adaptable and flexible, able to navigate change and respond to evolving operational needs.

* Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving capabilities.

* Collaborative, with the ability to lead team-based decision-making processes.

* Highly motivated, results-oriented, and driven to achieve operational excellence.

* Alignment with and passion for the company's mission, vision, values, and operating principles.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business Management, or a related field; Master's degree preferred. Equivalent experience will also be considered.

* Minimum of 7–10+ years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing, preferably in CPG or food production, with prior experience leading a plant or large production operation.

* Proven track record in safety management, including implementing and enforcing safety systems and ensuring compliance with OSHA and other regulatory standards.

* Extensive experience managing food quality systems and adhering to GMP and other industry requirements.

* Strong operational knowledge of manufacturing processes, maintenance, and engineering principles, with demonstrated practical application.

* Experience managing budgets, expenses, and cost performance, with solid financial and accounting understanding.

* Hands-on experience with continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean, 5S, Six Sigma (Green or Black Belt preferred), or similar process improvement frameworks.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with enterprise systems such as SAP or JD Edwards is a plus.

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
Select Milk Producers is one of the nation’s largest and most progressive dairy cooperatives, with 32 wholly owned subsidiaries, 8 processing plants, and 8 joint ventures including Continental Dairy Facilities, Continental Dairy Facilities Southwest, Mill Haven Foods, Select Custom Solutions, GreenLink and Select Services. With over 800 employees, the Select Milk family of companies impacts all aspects of the dairy farm business and at the heart of our family of companies, is you.

"We strive to go above and beyond what’s expected in providing for our families, leading our employees, caring for our land and animals, serving our customers, producing quality milk, and serving one another. This commitment is more than our business, it’s in our culture and our character. We believe in being accountable, in doing what’s right, in performing at our best, in setting a higher standard."

Select Milk Producers and its subsidiaries offer an attractive compensation and a best-in-class benefits package that includes but is not limited medical, vision, dental, life insurance and more that can be tailored for you and your family. Other benefits for eligible employees include 401(k) up to 6% company match, life and disability insurance, and paid holidays & vacation. We are proud to promote an equal employment opportunity workplace.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Plant Operations: Review daily inventories and plan daily production. Conduct daily staff meetings to coordinate daily plant activities. Review daily load out schedule and coordinate with staff and milk movement personnel. Review daily production efficiencies and production reports. Review companies KPI’s, plant loss and assist in setting goals. Reports directly to the Director of Operations.
* Plant Quality: Review microbiology test results daily and direct further investigation of high counts. Review list of any out-of-spec. product with Food Safety Quality Assurance (FSQA) Manager. Review all product C of A's.
* Plant Audits: Check each department daily. Check employee GMP’s. Review daily report of audits. Assist Quality Assurance with all plant audits.
* Industrial Wastewater: Check wastewater facility daily. Review daily reports as required.
* Sanitation: Review CIP records daily. Review random equipment checks with chemical account representative.
* Plant Employees: Audit sampling techniques and sanitation practices. Monitor production departments throughout shift and assure employee compliance with GMP’s, sanitation and safety. Provide training as needed. Provide annual GMP and HACCP training.
* Purchasing: Review and approve order supplies. Track purchases and prepare appropriate paperwork.
* Equipment: Verify that all plant equipment is in good working condition and all preventative maintenance is being performed on a scheduled basis. Review and approve all work orders. Review all daily maintenance activity reports. Develop capital justifications to update equipment as needed.
* Environmental: Review of Air Quality annual reports. Review and coordinate completion of Annual Form R for EPA/Health Department. Review and coordinate completion of Annual Hazardous Materials Inventory and Business Plan. Perform other duties, as necessary.
* Safety: Review Safety program and training with EHS management. Daily observation during plant audit will include safety. Check each department and observe employee safety procedures. Member of the Food Safety Team and Food Quality Team.
* Leadership: Utilize Code of Conduct and core values to drive development and growth opportunities for all team members.
* Support a company culture of continuous improvement by participating in efficiency and improvement efforts.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**:

* This position has management and employee supervisory responsibilities for the entire facility in the area of discipline, hiring, and firing.
* Review on the job training reviews.
* Coordinate on the job training.
* Oversee adherence to company policies and procedures.
* Oversee scheduling of management, employees, and temporary labor.
* Have the responsibility of reviewing timesheets, overtime and approve payroll.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES REQUIRED:**

* An individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* Must have the ability to trouble shoot problems and be persistent until a solution is found.
* Must work in a safe manner and follow all safety procedures including use of safety equipment.
* Must be willing to ask for assistance when the process is unclear.
* Proficient in verbal and written communication skills. Must be able to communicate with upper management on a daily basis.
* Leadership, team development, coaching, and / or teaching experience.
* Good math and statistical skills.
* Excellent computer skills for data input, report writing, program tracking.
* Excellent organizational and follow through skills.

**EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Dairy or Food Science and four years of experience in a Plant leadership role in a Dairy or Food Manufacturing facility is strongly desired.

records.title: Sand Plant Manager
records.description:
**Job Description:** 
Responsible for the management of all aspects of a sand mining and production facility. This position will utilize budgets, production goals, and effective communication. Safety must be a top priority. 
 
**Job Requirements:** 
**ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** 
 
Direct the following department personnel to ensure safety and productivity is achieved. 
1. Mine Team 
2. Wash Operators 
3. Dry Plant Operators 
4. Quality/Lab 
5. Maintenance

* Efficiently schedule and supervise hourly personnel for weekly operations, monitor timecards, vacations, and control overtime.
* Work with corporate HR department on staffing needs and employee issues.
* Handle discipline and grievances, as required, while maintaining acceptable labor and employee relations.
* Accurately collect, review, and forward operating data, such as mine, wash, and dry plant production reports.
* Assist HSE Coordinator in collecting the necessary data for MSHA and DNR reports.
* Communicate effectively and timely with owners, corporate directors, and/or other management of problems or potential problems that affect the proper operation of the plant. Problems may include personnel, equipment, transportation, quality, or raw materials.
* Direct activities safely to achieve optimum rates of productivity consistent with long/short range goals
* Direct and coordinate plant/mine related projects with Director of Mining
* Assisting in the preparation of capital projects and plan, and their completion • Direct and oversee activities performed by subcontractors.
* Monitor the mine operation to ensure compliance with all regulations concerning air emissions, water discharge, erosion and sedimentation control.
* Assist, implement, and comply with ISO 9001 quality program.
* Review quality reports daily and ensure quality standards are being followed.
* Evaluate with the EHS Coordinator the company’s training program and conditions in the plant, creating a culture of safety that exceeds MSHA guidelines and regulations.
* Ensure safety and good housekeeping by being active in all programs.
* Recommend and/or purchase materials and supplies as necessary, utilizing corporate purchasing department. Recommend equipment and process modifications to improve efficiencies.
* Ensure work standards, policies, plans, and procedures are enforced. Support management’s policies and programs.

**ADDITIONAL REQUIRMENTS**

* Team-oriented, an effective communicator (verbal and written), able to offer technical expertise and guidance, and have the ability and willingness to build rapport with department team members and external departments.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and set priorities appropriately.
* Understanding our company functions as a cohesive operation, and often employees serve in many roles and various functions or capacities.
* Develop working relationships with other corporate personnel and plants.
* Maintain open communications with subordinates, peers, and superiors.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s Degree, in Business Management or related field
* 3 to 5 years of related experience in a position of leadership, Surface Mining Experience preferred
* Valid driver’s license required.
* Advanced experience working with MSHA Safety and Environmental competency
* Supervisory skills
* Budgetary skills - Capital planning and projects
* Short and long-term planning and scheduling
* Leadership Skills

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Pass toxicity test.
* Medical clearance to wear respiratory protection.
* Team?oriented, effective communicator (verbal and written), able to offer technical expertise and guidance, and
* have the ability and willingness to build rapport with team members and external agencies.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and set priorities appropriately.
* Willingness to further training or education, if requested.

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
**Company Description**

Sirtex Medical is a global leader in healthcare, with offices in the U.S., Australia, Germany, and Singapore, dedicated to improving patient outcomes.

Our mission is to be at the forefront of minimally invasive cancer and embolization therapies. By partnering with physicians, we aim to provide innovative products that enhance patient outcomes and simplify treatments. Achieving this ambitious goal requires passionate and talented individuals who are committed to making a difference. Our flagship product, SIR-Spheres® Y-90 resin microspheres, is a targeted radiation therapy for liver cancer. To date, we have delivered over >150K doses across 50+ countries, significantly impacting patients' lives worldwide. Our success is fueled by our dedication to serving the medical community, maintaining professionalism, fostering a collaborative work culture, nurturing an entrepreneurial spirit, and continuously pursuing innovation and improvement.

At Sirtex, we are committed to creating a great workplace. We offer a range of benefits, programs, and services to support our employees, ensuring they have opportunities to contribute to our success and advance their careers. Join our inclusive community, where you can collaborate with talented colleagues, bring your ideas to life, and advance your career, all while delivering innovative healthcare solutions to patients.

 **Job Description**

**SCOPE:**

The Wilmington plant is the largest of 3 global Sirtex manufacturing site and serves as the principal production site of both SIR-Spheres microspheres and Lava product lines. The Plant Manager is responsible for leading the sites manufacturing operations, engineering, warehouse and product distribution.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

 

* Develop and lead execution of the site manufacturing strategy for both the SIR-Spheres and Lava value streams. Align site goals with Senior Leadership and Corporate objectives.
* Team Performance Management: lead, develop and mentor manufacturing team members.
* Manage production schedules, ensuring resource availability and capacity to meet demand, working closely with the Supply Chain team, using optimal schedules to minimize overall costs.
* Lead Continuous Improvement efforts, identifying process, equipment, product, and other opportunities, that reduce cost, improve quality and safety at the site.
* Full responsibility for developing and managing to site budget.
* Ensure resource and equipment capacity to ensure efficient and reliable manufacturing.
* Set site target KPI’s managing OEE, Labor Efficiency, Scrap, Equipment Utilization, etc.
* Ensure product is built to specification and in compliance with all Quality System requirements.
* Manage the site engineering team to ensure equipment and processes are robust and meet all manufacturing requirements. Manage PM strategy and ensure that execution is completed on time.
* Support the Quality Department, working with on site Quality team members to ensure that compliance with all areas of the Sirtex QMS are being followed. Identify opportunities for improvement and work to implement them directly in the QMS.
* Work in conjunction with HSE/Facilities Department to ensure a safe working environment for all employees and that the facilities is maintained, and compliant with regulatory requirements for both the handling of radioactive materials and medical device manufacturing.
* Manage all shipping, receiving and warehousing activities. Ensure timely material receipt, inventory accuracy is maintained, and products are shipped on time.

 
**Qualifications**

**EDUCATIONAL PREREQUISITES AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related discipline such as Chemistry or Biomedical field
* 5+ Years experience working in medical device or pharmaceutical industry preferred.
* Prior experience working with radioisotopes preferred.
* 3+ years of site management experience, with 10+ years of leadership experience.
* 6 Sigma Green belt preferred. Experience using 5S and Lean principles is preferred.

The anticipated annual base salary range and target bonus opportunity is $136,000 to $171,000 annually, plus a 15% target annual bonus.

The final position level and compensation will be determined based on non-discriminatory, job-related factors, including geographic location, skills, experience, education, and alignment with the position requirements. In addition to base salary and bonus eligibility, Sirtex offers a comprehensive benefits package, including paid sick and vacation time, medical, dental, vision and life insurance, and a generous 401(k) matching program and other benefits, subject to applicable plan terms and eligibility requirements.

 **Additional Information**

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines

Do you want to be part of something bigger? A team whose impact stretches across the globe making a real difference to the quality of people’s lives. Sirtex recognizes that well-being, financial health, and work-life balance are crucial for our employees to achieve personal success.

Sirtex offers qualified candidates:

* Diverse and flexible work arrangements to achieve the optimum balance between work and personal responsibilities.
* A culture of respect, diversity, collaboration, and innovation fostering inclusiveness and superior performance.
* Attractive compensation and benefit packages which are practical, robust and equitable.
* A commitment to support ongoing professional growth through career development, on the job experiences and training opportunities.
* Challenging work which supports the development of new and better ways to improve clinical outcomes for oncology treatment around the world.
* An unwavering commitment to company values, employee safety and excellence in everything we do.

Diversity drives innovation; inclusion fosters belonging, growth and success. Sirtex believes that it takes multiple perspectives and voices to create a culture and workplace which fosters engagement, teamwork, and employee satisfaction to perform our best and deliver on commitments. We are dedicated to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, included, and can share their ideas so that we can exceed even our own expectations.

Sirtex is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Sirtex will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities, in accordance with applicable law.

records.description:
Description:

**POSITION SUMMARY & KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY:**

The Plant Manager is responsible for leading all operational and financial activities and directly interacting and collaborating with all internal/external stakeholders and support departments. The Plant Manager will develop and execute long and short-term initiatives aligned to our broader business goals as an innovative label solutions partner.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Ensure compliance and engagement with all Environmental, Health and Safety (EHS) policies and procedures.
* Drive site performance by monitoring and managing key business metrics, including Safety, Quality, Delivery, Productivity, Cost, Inventory, and Employee Engagement.
* Actively lead in EHS, training, safety observations, hazard identification, and safety committees
* Foster, develop, and implement Continuous Improvement (CI) activities through all facets of the business
* Full Profit & Loss (P&L) statement responsibility
* Strategic planning including capital investments, budgets, staffing, and capacity. Additional support to Sales, Estimating, and R&D on strategic planning
* Lead daily production activities by monitoring performance against targets and provide support in attaining levels of expected performance
* Lead and develop leaders to achieve established goals of safety, quality, service, production, and cost
* Ensure the plant has the necessary tools and training to successfully and efficiently meet their goals
* Provide direction and guidance to the team through coaching and counseling; motivate, empower, develop and recognize individual and team achievements
* Develop & implement best in class training programs
* Support development and roll out of Standard Work including Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Work Instructions (WI), One Point Lessons, (OPL) and Training Documentation
* Works closely with Planning, Quality, HR, Logistics, Engineering, Maintenance, and EHS to ensure proper production planning and utilization of resources on the right priorities to meet customer requirements
* Reviews daily production schedule to plan work and coworker’s assignments. Rebalance based on utilization of assets and resources.
* Provides proactive leadership, actions, and results on safety, quality, and CI topics
* Develop and implement workflow practices & policies that enhance speed and efficiency without compromising safety or product quality
* Lead the CI process utilizing operational tool sets (i.e Lean, Six Sigma, 6S, TPS, TPM.) to provide high levels of performance
* Lead coworkers in performing operations according to sound operating principles and company policies and procedures
* Provides support regarding the manufacturing process and makes recommendations regarding safety, quality, tools, equipment, costs/expenses
* Analyzes, supports, and presents results on operational and financial business goals and outcomes
* Recruit, hire, train, motivate, and develop coworkers in line with our core values and company policies and practices.
* Support our commercial teams on customer related matters
* Maintains a high standard of professional knowledge, ethics, and practices when dealing with customers, suppliers, peers, coworkers, and leadership
* Other duties as requested

Requirements:

**REQUIRED SKILLS/ABILITIES:**

* Familiar with CI, Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma and other current manufacturing concepts, practices, and procedures
* Effective verbal and written communication skills including ability to effectively train and develop others
* Ability to coordinate plant activities and create material, manufacturing and communication flow throughout the facility
* Must demonstrate excellent leadership, communication, and team building skills across direct reports as well as support departments
* Strong business acumen (leadership principles, strategic planning, critical thinking, budgeting, resource allocation, human resources, etc.)
* Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
* Experience with ERP systems

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Finance, Operations or relevant experience
* 7-15 years manufacturing experience with at least 5 years of relevant experience

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Ability to lift products up to 50 lbs.
* Ability to work in a standing position for long periods of time
* Other physical demands may include climbing, crouching, bending, reaching, stooping, etc.

**Reasonable Accommodations Statement**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable Accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Heartland Label Printers is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.**

**We participate in the federal E-Verify program to confirm the work eligibility of all new hires following an accepted job offer.**

* Reporting to the Vice President of Operations, the Plant Manager is responsible for providing management direction and leadership to ensure that the energy facility is operated in a safe, reliable, and economic manner consistent with site contracts, permits, and rules and regulations.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 
 

* Operates the facility in a safe manner and ensures that a safe work environment is provided to minimize the risk of accidents and injuries.
* Compliance with all company policies, procedures, and commercial commitments
* Implement programs and activities that provide a work environment that promotes effective goal accomplishment, productivity, and morale
* Optimize plant performance through appropriate utilization manpower, equipment, supplies and external support.
* Provide coaching, training, and development opportunities for the team to ensure appropriate skill sets are maintained
* Establish procedures and controls to manage all expense activities to conform to established budgets
* Communicate effectively with the site staff, management, customers, vendors, and outside agencies
* Demonstrate effective management skills in meeting or exceeding facility goals and objectives

 
QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS

* A four-year degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering or commensurate experience is required as well demonstrated track record of successful goal achievement
* A minimum of ten (10) to fifteen (15) year’s relevant experience, with a minimum of ten years in a management position.
* A through, demonstrated knowledge of energy facility operations and maintenance as well as management methods necessary to control and improve facility performance.
* Experience managing and supervising employees operating Gas Turbine, Plant Auxiliary Equipment, and Emergency Generators.
* Experience in tracking and reporting Individuals for this position must have good verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to do reaching, climbing, lifting (up to 50 pounds), walking, and stooping.
* Ability to manage a schedule in a timely and accurate manner
* Ability to handle other administrative duties as assigned by management
* Moderate to advanced MS Outlook Excel, Powerpoint, and Word

 
PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS
 

* GOLD STEAM AND RED REFRIGERATION
* NJ STEAM AND CHILLED WATER LICENSES

 
JOB REQUIREMENTS
 
 
Demonstrated knowledge of all facets of power plant operations. Demonstrated ability to make competent decisions in emergency situations, writing operating procedures and training of other personnel. Demonstrate good verbal and written communication skills. Ability to do reaching, climbing, lifting (up to 75 pounds), walking, and stooping.

Salary Range: 140K-175K annually

records.description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.

L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

***Job Title: Director, Manufacturing Engineering***

***Job Code: 47622***

***Job Location: Camden, AR***

***Job Schedule: 4/10: Employees work 10 hour days, 4 days a week***

**Job Description:**

The Manufacturing Engineering Director in Camden, Arkansas will plan, organize and technically direct the manufacturing engineering activities and staff. Enable Operations to execute all programs in a safe and efficient manner, and ensuring the achievement of quality, cost and delivery schedule objectives. This position reports to the Senior Director Operations and Site Management. Our Camden, AR site is at $600M+ revenue and produces a diverse portfolio of highly engineered products for aerospace and defense applications. The individual will be responsible for implementing a disciplined operating system in line with the enterprise while improving the operating effectiveness of the site and leading an organization of over 190 people.

**Essential Functions:**

* 50% - Direct and lead technical team: Analyze, evaluate and determine appropriate solutions for manufacturing technical problems encountered in the application of manufacturing methods, facilities and processes. Apply engineering procedures, provide technical direction, create and apply work instructions and tooling for the factory floor. Participate in program and site corrective action boards and be a key member in customer escape and non-conformance investigations; develop direct cause, root cause and mistake proof corrective actions, as well as separation criteria when required. Ensure proper deployment of resources to achieve cost effective results in support of site and business unit deliverables. Direct the installation of Electronic Work Instructions (Platform is DELMIA) across the site and all product lines. Strict oversight of the Job Safety Analysis and Process Safety Management programs at the site.

* 15% - Administrative management: Ensure a safe work environment and remain in compliance to federal and local regulations. Develop long range technical and administrative plans, goals and strategies.

* 15% - Customer interface: Establish priorities to meet the needs of the customer and the organization with a dedication to support the manufacturing shop floor. Represent the organization as a prime internal and customer contact on manufacturing technical operations.

* 20% - Strategy and Continuous Improvement: Lead the sites Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) program. Drive operational

excellence throughout the organization and create a metrics driven, highly accountable mindset within the organization.

* Ability to obtain a US secret security clearance.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree with a minimum of 15 years prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree with a minimum of 13 years prior relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 19 years of prior relevant experience.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated supervisory and leadership skills, including planning, organizing and directing activities; developing talent; and collaborating across business units and functional teams to achieve site objectives.

 

* Strong understanding of business development, program management, engineering, finance, operations and process control, with the ability to engage effectively with plant-floor teams, customers and executives.

 

* Experience in aerospace and/or general industrial sectors, including multiple years in a leadership capacity, with program management, engineering leadership and experience with inert, energetic and propellant materials.

 

* High-energy, results-driven leader with a disciplined work ethic, a bias for action and a continuous improvement mindset. Able to drive commitments to closure, elevate performance and lead organizational change in a demanding environment with lean staffing.

 

* Ability to satisfy federal government requirements for access to government information.

records.title: 1. Manufacturing General Manager
records.description:
Job Summary

Deligh Industries Inc is seeking an experienced, organized, and results-driven Manufacturing Project Manager to oversee manufacturing projects from planning through completion. The successful candidate will coordinate production activities, manage project timelines, monitor budgets, collaborate with engineering and operations teams, and ensure projects meet quality, productivity, and operational objectives.

Key Responsibilities

* Plan, coordinate, and oversee manufacturing projects from initiation to completion.
* Develop project schedules, milestones, budgets, and resource plans.
* Coordinate with production, engineering, procurement, and quality control teams.
* Monitor manufacturing project progress and ensure deadlines are met.
* Identify operational challenges and implement appropriate solutions.
* Track project expenses and support cost-control activities.
* Coordinate equipment purchases, materials, and production requirements.
* Monitor product quality and ensure compliance with established standards.
* Prepare project reports and provide progress updates to management.
* Organize project meetings and communicate responsibilities to team members.
* Evaluate project performance and recommend process improvements.
* Ensure project activities follow applicable workplace safety procedures.

Qualifications and Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
* Previous experience in manufacturing, project management, or industrial operations.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and production workflows.
* Experience managing project schedules, budgets, and resources.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management software.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

Preferred Skills

* Manufacturing project management.
* Production planning and coordination.
* Budget monitoring and cost control.
* Quality assurance and process improvement.
* Resource and materials management.
* Cross-functional team leadership.
* Project reporting and performance analysis.

Work Environment

This position involves working in a manufacturing and industrial operations environment, combining office-based project planning with coordination on the production floor. The manager works closely with engineers, production supervisors, technicians, suppliers, and management personnel. Appropriate safety procedures must be followed when entering manufacturing areas.

Career Progression

With demonstrated performance and professional development, employees may pursue advancement into senior project management, manufacturing operations management, plant management, production director, or industrial operations leadership roles.

Benefits

Potential benefits may include paid time off, health coverage, retirement savings options, professional development, and other employment benefits, depending on company policy, employment status, location, and eligibility.

About the Company

Deligh Industries Inc is identified as the employer for this opportunity. Applicants should contact the company directly to confirm its manufacturing operations, project assignments, specific responsibilities, and employment details.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit an updated résumé highlighting relevant manufacturing, industrial operations, engineering, project management, or production coordination experience. Qualified applicants may be contacted for additional information and an interview.

Pay: $18.00 - $22.00 per year

Benefits:

* Relocation assistance

Work Location: In person

records.title: Quality Director
records.description:
**Job Title:** Quality Director

**FLSA:** Full-Time, Exempt

**Department:** Quality (Assurance (QA) and Control (QC))

**Reports To:** President

**Has Direct Reports:** Yes

 

**Summary**

The Director of Quality will lead the development and execution of a comprehensive quality strategy that spans all functions of the manufacturing operations. This role is responsible for ensuring organizational compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, industry standards, and customer specifications, while promoting a culture of quality excellence, proactive risk management, and continuous improvement. In addition to providing strategic oversight of quality assurance, quality control, compliance, and regulatory activities, the Director will serve as the senior quality authority in cross-functional collaborations and executive-level decision-making. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in chemical manufacturing and regulatory compliance, particularly in ISO, GMP, EPA and OSHA; and demonstrate a proven ability to build, lead, and scale high-performing quality organizations.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

1) Develop and implement the company’s quality vision, strategy, and systems to support operational objectives and business growth.

2) Ensure full compliance with regulatory requirements (e.g., ISO 9001, cGMP, EPA, OSHA, REACH) and all relevant customer, industry, and statutory standards.

3) Oversee quality assurance, quality control, regulatory affairs, document control, and audit readiness across all manufacturing sites.

4) Lead the development and enforcement of quality policies, procedures, and performance metrics.

5) Manage internal and external audits and serve as the primary point of contact for regulatory agencies and customer quality assessments.

6) Drive investigation and resolution of critical quality issues, non-conformances, deviations, and customer complaints through root cause analysis and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) programs.

7) Establish and monitor quality KPIs to ensure consistent product quality, process capability, and continuous improvement.

8) Collaborate with cross-functional leadership (Operations, R&D, EHS, Supply Chain) to ensure quality is embedded throughout the product lifecycle.

9) Lead and mentor quality teams across multiple locations; develop organizational capabilities through structured training and talent development.

10) Provide regular quality performance updates and strategic insights to senior leadership.

11) Support new product introductions, process validation, and change control programs.

 

**Education and/or Experience**

1) Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, chemical engineering, quality management, microbiology or a related field is required.

2) Professional certifications such as ASQ Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), or Six Sigma Black Belt are strongly preferred.

3) Minimum of 10 years of progressive quality leadership experience, with at least five years in a senior management role within the chemical or process manufacturing industry.

4) Proven experience managing regulatory inspections, customer audits, and third-party certification processes.

5) Strong background in quality management systems (QMS), regulatory compliance, and risk management in a regulated environment.

6) Multi-site leadership experience is a plus.

 

**Additional Skills**

1) Deep knowledge of ISO 9001, cGMP, ICH Q7/Q10, and chemical industry-specific regulations (EPA, OSHA, REACH, TSCA).

2) Expertise in statistical process control (SPC), root cause analysis, CAPA, and quality risk management.

3) Strong strategic planning, analytical thinking, and decision-making capabilities.

4) Demonstrated success in leading change, driving process improvements, and fostering a quality-driven culture.

5) Excellent interpersonal, communication, and leadership skills.

6) Proficiency in quality software tools, ERP systems (e.g., SAP), and data reporting platforms.

records.title: Director of Operations
records.description:
**Director of Operations**

At **MPE** we are dedicated to making a difference in the world through cutting-edge medical technology. Our mission is to be the global leader in design, engineering, and manufacturing solutions for the medical and technology industries. We are committed to creating impactful solutions that improve lives and fostering an environment where our team members can thrive, grow, and contribute to groundbreaking advancements in the medical field.

**A better career for you. Creating medical technology for all.**

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**We are seeking a dedicated Director of Operations to join our team.**

In this vital role, you will be responsible for all of the Company’s Manufacturing and Maintenance activities related to all MPE sites. The Director of Operations will plan, direct, coordinate, and oversee operations activities in the organization, ensuring development and implementation of efficient operations and cost-effective systems to meet current and future needs of the organization.

If you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment where precision and teamwork matter, we’d love to hear from you!

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as a key member of the Leadership Team that develops, establishes, communicates and executes the strategic direction of operations while aligning with overall business goals and objectives and supporting customer requirements.
* Work closely with President/CEO to drive manufacturing plans, goals and future innovations including Lean, Six Sigma, Quick Response Manufacturing techniques and Continuous Improvement to evolve our World Class Organization.
* Ensure that, as the Company grows, our manufacturing capabilities meet or exceed industry and customer requirements for cost, quality, responsiveness, lean, efficiencies, safety and best practices.
* Develop, recommend and manage budgeting and budget execution within functional area with a focus on costs savings, productivity improvements and quality assurance. Manage within the budgetary constraints. Analyze and report on variances between actual and budgeted expenditures
* Oversee all manufacturing engineering, production control, production process development, and preventive maintenance.
* Develop and implement processes, procedures and controls to promote efficient operations of the organization and ensure all Operations teams remain compliant to the processes, procedures and controls.
* Work closely with the Quality Team to ensure manufacturing processes are meeting customers’ requirements and required scorecard levels.
* Monitor and understand our customers’ and other outside agencies regulatory and quality system requirements and incorporate into our manufacturing processes while maintaining compliance.
* Ensure the training of new and present employees in the processes and methods required to achieve the organization’s standards for quality, quantity, and safety, consistent with the companies compliance and operational needs. Identifies additional training needs and ensures proper training is developed and provided.
* Oversee the Company’s environmental, health and safety efforts in manufacturing to remain in compliance OSHA, EPA, State and local regulations and provide a safe working environment for our employees.
* Establish and maintain best practices for Manufacturing and Preventive Maintenance to develop and run a world-class manufacturer for medical devices. Ensure the maintenance of departmental housekeeping standards.
* Maintains knowledge of emerging technologies and trends in operations management.
* Presents periodic performance reports and metrics to the Chief Executive Officer and Leadership Team.
* Leader and Ambassador for MPE Cultural Values internally and externally.

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**Qualifications**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or related field or equivalent experience

**Experience and Training:**

* At least 10 years of manufacturing and continuous improvement experience in a leadership role
* Experience in capital equipment and ROI analysis
* Experience low-volume, high product mix manufacturing
* Experience in Lean, Six Sigma and/or Quick Response Manufacturing techniques

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**Physical and Mental Demands:**

* Regularly required to analyze, interpret data and documents, read and write business correspondences, present information, and problem solve.
* Must be able to read, write, apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**Why Join Us?**

* **Mission-Driven Work:** Help deliver medical products that change lives.
* **Growth Opportunities:** We support career development and internal promotions.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:**
 + Medical (HSA-qualified and traditional plans), dental, and vision—coverage starts the first of the month after hire.
 + 401(k) with company match.
 + Nine paid holidays and vacation time from day one.

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**If you're detail-oriented, team-driven, and ready to contribute to life-changing medical technology, apply today and grow your career at MPE.**

**No relocation or sponsorship available for this role.**

records.title: Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering
records.description:
Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering

White Bear Lake, MN

**About Heraeus**

Making displays foldable? Help hearts beat with micro-particles? Work on solutions involving precious metals? As a family-owned global technology group we help our customers to always being one step ahead.

 

**About Heraeus Medevio**

Heraeus Medevio combines medical technology expertise with collaborative partnerships. Together with medical device manufacturers, we develop and implement solutions for defined applications. As part of the Heraeus Group, we support the professional development of our employees and offer opportunities for career development, depending on the role, location and operational conditions.

To reach our vision of improving 100 million lives every year, we foster a culture of curiosity that thrives on challenge, continuous learning, growth, and the opportunity to try new things. With sites in the United States, European Union, and Asia, and over 2,200 employees worldwide, together, we will meet tomorrow's challenges today.

 
**Position Summary**
 
The Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering leads the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of advanced manufacturing technology across the Americas manufacturing network, including automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing. This role owns the design, development, validation, implementation, and maintenance of automated manufacturing equipment, assembly systems, robotics, vision inspection technologies, digital manufacturing solutions, and additive manufacturing processes and equipment that support the production of medical devices. The Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering role builds and leads a team of engineering professionals across these disciplines, sets technical direction and standards, and partners closely with Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, and Supply Chain to advance productivity, quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence across multiple sites.
 
**This is an onsite position at the White Bear Lake, MN location with travel to other global manufacturing sites.**
 
**What You’ll Do Every Day:**
 

* Develop and execute the advanced manufacturing engineering roadmap (including automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing) aligned with business objectives.
* Establish long-term technology strategies to support manufacturing capacity expansion, cost reduction, and product quality improvement across the manufacturing network.
* Identify emerging technologies and evaluate opportunities for implementation, including robotics, AI-enabled inspection systems, Industry 4.0/digital manufacturing applications, advanced controls, and additive manufacturing processes and equipment.
* Lead capital equipment planning and investment strategy across automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing initiatives.
* Collaborate with Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Supply Chain, and external technology partners to enhance productivity, quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence.
* Direct a team responsible for automation engineering, controls engineering, robotics, machine vision, electrical engineering, digital manufacturing/manufacturing systems integration, and additive manufacturing.
* Build and mentor high-performing engineering teams through coaching, performance management, and talent development, while establishing engineering standards, best practices, and design methodologies across advanced manufacturing disciplines.
* Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with company policies and applicable laws, including selection, training and development, assigning work, and performance management of employees.
* Manage complex, multidisciplinary engineering projects from concept through implementation, delivering on time and within budget while meeting technical and quality requirements, and communicate progress and issues clearly to leadership to support project and site objectives.
* Manage external automation, digital manufacturing, and additive manufacturing integrators, contractors, and equipment suppliers.
* Develop and control departmental operating and capital budgets; establish project schedules, resource plans, and cost controls.
* Other duties may be assigned as required.

 
**What We’re Looking For:**
 

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Automation, or Industrial Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field required; Master’s degree in Engineering, MBA, or related discipline preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in automated manufacturing environments; experience in digital manufacturing and/or additive manufacturing strongly preferred.
* Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing engineering teams.
* Experience within medical device, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or other highly regulated manufacturing industries.
* Proven success leading large-scale automation, digital manufacturing, and/or additive manufacturing projects and capital equipment installations.
* Experience with equipment validation and regulatory compliance in FDA-regulated environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams across multiple sites and drive continuous improvement and digitalization initiatives.
* Excellent communication, problem-solving, project management, and organizational skills.
* Ability and willingness to travel across the Americas manufacturing network (White Bear Lake, MN; Costa Rica; Puerto Rico), approximately 25-50% of the time.

 
*Medevio is committed to providing competitive total compensation and benefits packages. The expected hiring range for this position is between $160,000 and $190,000 based upon a full-time schedule. This is a good faith estimate on the applicable range. Base salaries are determined by taking a variety of factors in account, including, but not limited to, candidate qualifications, geographic locations, market conditions and internal equity. This position is bonus eligible, with a target bonus of 20%. Our total compensation package includes eligibility for comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with company match, education reimbursement, paid parental leave and paid time off.*
 

**Curious? Apply now!**

Heraeus is proud to be an employer that provides equal access to opportunities for all its employees. We provide fair and equal consideration to all qualified applicants, regardless of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other legally protected characteristic. A diverse and inclusive culture is at the heart of our Vision, Mission, and Values. We are dedicated to cultivating a workforce that reflects a broad spectrum of cultures, backgrounds, and perspectives.

We participate in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility after hire. Learn more at www.e-verify.gov

**Any further questions?**

If you need any assistance or have questions, please contact hrdirect-americas@heraeus.com or visit our website at jobs.heraeus.com.

records.description:
**Company Description**

**About AbbVie**

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

 **Job Description**

**Position Summary:**

The **Sr Director Process Engineering Peptides API** sets enterprise direction and senior technical governance for process engineering strategy, process platform deployment, process package design, technical assurance, manufacturing technology interfaces and project delivery for biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy manufacturing within AbbVie Strategic Investment.

The role supports Strategic Investments through engineering leadership, technical expertise, standards development, technical governance and project execution support across multiple manufacturing sites, strategic investments and technology platforms.

The role supports engineering activities associated with peptides manufacturing facility investments, new production capabilities, strategic capacity creation, advanced manufacturing platforms and new technology deployments across the Strategic Investment portfolio.

The role partners with Strategic Investments, manufacturing sites, operations, quality, EHS, validation / CQV and external engineering partners to deliver technically robust and business-aligned engineering solutions.

**Strategic Investment Context**

* Strategic Investment provides engineering leadership, technical governance, standards development and project execution support across AbbVie’s Strategic Investments and strategic capital portfolio.
* The organization supports new biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy manufacturing facilities, new platform deployments, strategic capacity creation, advanced biologics and CGT manufacturing capabilities and standards development for emerging technologies across Strategic Investments.
* Strategic Investment roles are expected to promote common standards, transfer lessons learned across regions and sites, and enable consistent engineering delivery across strategic capital investments.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Strategic Investment Governance and Standards:**

* Establish, maintain and deploy global engineering standards, technical practices and governance expectations for biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy process engineering strategy, process platform deployment, process package design, technical assurance, manufacturing technology interfaces and project delivery.
* Drive consistent application of technical standards, design principles, lessons learned and engineering playbooks across regions, sites and capital projects.
* Define enterprise standards, engineering requirements and technical guardrails for new biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy technologies, including requirements for consistent design, deployment, qualification, operation and scale-up across Strategic Investments.
* Ensure discipline strategies support AbbVie’s long-range Strategic Investment objectives, strategic investment programs and adoption of new technologies across future manufacturing platforms.
* Provide governance and escalation for technical decisions with material safety, quality, compliance, cost, schedule, operability or lifecycle impact.

**Strategic New Technology and Capital Investment Support:**

* Provide engineering leadership for strategic capital investments, including new biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy facility builds, technology platform deployments, new production capabilities, strategic capacity projects and lifecycle technology upgrades.
* Support front-end engineering, facility concept development, investment option evaluation, manufacturing capability assessments and site / platform planning activities for biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy assets.
* Partner with Strategic Investments and project leadership to ensure technical assumptions, deliverables, risks and resource needs are integrated into capital program plans.
* Apply Strategic Investment lessons learned and standards to improve project quality, speed, reliability and readiness across the portfolio.

**Technical Leadership and Delivery:**

* Lead or support technical decision-making for biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy process engineering strategy, process platform deployment, process package design, technical assurance, manufacturing technology interfaces and project delivery across multiple manufacturing sites, capital projects and technology platforms.
* Ensure engineering deliverables support safety, quality, compliance, operability, maintainability, reliability, sustainability and operational readiness.
* Coordinate technical input from project teams, site SMEs, external engineering partners, vendors and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Drive timely resolution of technical issues and ensure suitable escalation when decisions have broader project, network or business impact.

**Cross-Functional Integration:**

* Partner with Strategic Investments, manufacturing operations, quality, validation / CQV, EHS, site engineering, MS&T, supply chain, finance and related engineering disciplines.
* Ensure discipline decisions are integrated with biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy manufacturing strategy, network capacity, technology platform deployment, regulatory expectations and site handover needs.
* Facilitate collaboration across Strategic Investments, sites and project teams to avoid fragmented solutions and drive consistency across the strategic capital portfolio.
* Represent Strategic Investment in technical reviews, project forums and risk discussions relevant to assigned scope.

**Capability Building and Continuous Improvement:**

* Share engineering best practices, lessons learned and technical knowledge across sites, regions and projects.
* Build capability through coaching, mentoring, technical review discipline and development of reusable engineering practices.
* Promote a culture of engineering excellence, safety, quality, reliability, collaboration, accountability and proactive risk management.
* Support continuous improvement of Strategic Investment standards, templates, knowledge management and project delivery approaches.

**Strategic Investment Leadership Expectations:**

* Collaborate across Strategic Investments to identify, develop and deploy best practices, technical standards, lessons learned and capability-building initiatives.
* Promote consistency, quality, reliability, sustainability and project delivery performance across regions, sites and capital projects.
* Support long-range manufacturing strategy, strategic investment planning and Strategic Investment capability development.
* Build technical capability through coaching, mentoring, standards governance, knowledge management and cross-functional collaboration.

**Stakeholder Interfaces**

Strategic Investments:

* Investment planning, portfolio alignment, technical assumptions, front-end engineering, biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy technology deployment standards and strategic capital program support.

Manufacturing Sites and Operations:

* Network needs, site readiness, operability, maintainability, startup, handover and operational performance support.

Quality, Validation / CQV and EHS:

* Compliance expectations, validation strategy, qualification readiness, safety, risk review and inspection readiness interfaces.

Strategic Investment Disciplines:

* Cross-discipline technical integration, standards, design reviews, technical issue resolution and lessons learned.

External Engineering Partners, EPCM Firms, Vendors and OEMs:

* Technical oversight, deliverable review, issue escalation, supplier alignment and execution quality.

 
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science or a relevant technical discipline required; advanced degree preferred where relevant.
* Typically 15+ years of relevant engineering, manufacturing, capital project, technical operations or regulated manufacturing experience.
* Demonstrated technical capability in biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy process engineering strategy, process platform deployment, process package design, technical assurance, manufacturing technology interfaces and project delivery.
* Experience supporting biologics drug substance, cell therapy, gene therapy, viral vector, mRNA, sterile biologics or similarly regulated biopharmaceutical manufacturing environments preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to work across global functions, manufacturing sites, project teams, suppliers, vendors and external engineering partners.
* Strong communication, risk management, technical judgment, stakeholder engagement and structured problem-solving skills.

**Technical Competencies:**

* Biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy process design and process package review
* Front-end engineering and concept development
* Biologics and CGT technology transfer, platform deployment and manufacturing scale-up
* Process safety and CQV interfaces
* Strategic Investment support
* Strategic capital investment and new biologics / CGT technology deployment support
* Engineering governance and standards
* Development of engineering standards and deployment requirements for emerging biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy manufacturing technologies
* Technical understanding of bioreactor, harvest, purification, single-use, closed processing, aseptic processing, viral vector, cell processing and cryogenic / cold-chain interfaces as applicable to biologics and CGT platforms
* Technical risk management
* Project execution support
* Stakeholder management
* Vendor / partner technical coordination
* GMP and regulated manufacturing awareness
* Operational readiness and handover support

**Leadership Competencies:**

* Strategic thinking and enterprise mindset
* Matrix leadership and influence without direct authority
* Clear technical communication and executive-ready recommendations
* Risk-based decision making and issue escalation
* Collaboration across functions, sites, regions and external partners
* Capability building, mentoring and knowledge sharing
* Lead, coach and develop a high-performing technical engineering team with clear priorities, accountability, development plans and delivery expectations aligned to Strategic Investment objectives.
* Set technical direction for the engineering team, ensuring work is prioritized against safety, quality, compliance, business value, capital delivery needs and long-range manufacturing strategy.
* Build technical bench strength by identifying capability gaps, developing succession depth, mentoring senior engineers and enabling knowledge transfer across sites, projects and technology platforms.
* Create an inclusive, disciplined technical decision-making environment where engineers challenge assumptions, manage risk transparently and escalate decisions with material safety, compliance, cost, schedule or operability impact.
* Align team performance with enterprise standards by reinforcing consistent engineering practices, structured technical reviews, lessons learned adoption and measurable delivery outcomes.
* Continuous improvement and commitment to safety, quality and compliance

**Working Relationships:**

This role works globally with Strategic Investments, Strategic Investment disciplines, biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy manufacturing sites, quality, validation / CQV, EHS, operations, MS&T, supply chain, finance, external engineering firms, technology vendors and equipment suppliers. The role is expected to operate across multiple projects, manufacturing sites and technology platforms, supporting new biologics and CGT manufacturing investments, new production capabilities and enterprise standards for emerging biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy technologies.
