records.title: Manufacturing Engineering Director
records.description:
The Figeac Aero Group has multiple locations across the world. Figeac Aero North America, located in Wichita, Kansas in the heart of the country, is a leading aerospace partner for detailed parts and sub-assemblies with specialization in saturation shot peening, shot peen forming, chemical processing, painting, assembly, non-destructive testing, and machining.

At Figeac Aero North America, we place a high value on our employees. Employees are given the opportunity to be a part of something special while achieving their career goals. We offer competitive compensation as a smaller company in addition to an attractive benefits package for qualified employees.

***Manufacturing Engineering Director***

***Salary****: $90,000 - $120,000*

**Experience:** 8+ years in Manufacturing Engineering discipline in Aerospace environment.

**Job Duties:**

* Responsible for coordinating and executing activities around the following: Leading technical teams in the improvement of current processes, transitioning new statements of work, being the focal point of communication between quality, operations, NC Programming and Planning.
* Monitor and enforce adherence to internal processes and standards to ensure a consistent product to the manufacturing floor.
* Collaborate with NC Programming, operations and Manufacturing Engineering on tool and fixture design.
* Review first part runs with Quality, Operations and NC Programming to verify a conforming part and acceptable manufacturing process.
* Mentoring and training of new Manufacturing Engineers/Planners.
* Interface with customer base to resolve engineering issues.
* Investigate and resolve manufacturing issues related to low profitability or excessive scrap.
* Engagement at the estimating stage on strategic packages to review engineering design and productivity concerns.
* Shop support and guidance on first article builds to ensure engineering compliance and manufacturing process design effectiveness.
* Provides planning, direction, and coordination for all technical activities while monitors performance to estimates, budgets and organization goals.
* Participates in developing organization and department goals and objectives.
* Manage and execute assigned projects to meet all project criteria on time and on budget.
* Transition Technical Phase of new work statements on time and achieve manufacturing targets.
* Be instrumental in reducing overall manufacturing costs of strategic work statements by reducing cycle times, setup, scrap, secondary operations content, raw material content and other process driven cost components.
* Enhance core competencies in complex machining and programming.
* Challenges others to develop as leaders while serving as a role model and mentor.
* Inspire coworkers to attain goals and pursue excellence.
* Recommend and implement process changes in order to improve cost, delivery, quality.
* Identifies opportunities for improvement and makes constructive suggestions for change.
* Analyze information and evaluate results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
* Leadership and Communications.
* Report progress and projects weekly to Leadership Team.
* Mitigate team conflict and communication problems.

**Education/Experience**

* A four-year Engineering degree and 8 years relative experience in an Aerospace Engineering discipline is required
* A minimum of 10 years’ experience in a Manufacturing Engineering discipline is preferred
* Extensive knowledge and experience in machining, inspection, tooling design, assembly, and lean manufacturing methodologies
* Familiarity with MRP systems and fundamentals
* Full knowledge and adherence to ITAR/EAR restrictions and responsibilities

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Ability to act with integrity, professionalism and confidentiality
* Mandatory background in an aerospace or manufacturing environment required.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including interpersonal, negotiation & conflict resolution.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate.
* Expert in all Microsoft Office 365 applications and knowledge of ERP programs preferred
* Ability to prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate.
* Self-motivated, innovative, practical, and adaptable
* Ability to speak, read, write, and understand English language
* Must be 18 years or older
* Must be a US citizen or legally authorized to work in the United States, not eligible for VISA sponsorship

**Working Conditions:**

* This position is 100% onsite (Wichita KS)
* Monday to Friday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm
* Some hours outside of office schedule may be required.
* Regular attendance is mandatory and must follow all work safety programs
* The essential duties job may require the ability to stoop; to reach; to stand, to walk and sit for extended periods of time; to push and/or pull objects weighing up to 30 pounds; to lift and carry objects weighing up to 15 pounds; to use finger dexterity to operate a computer and other office equipment and hand strength to grasp files and other objects; to perceive the attributes of objects by touch; to hear and verbally exchange ideas and information with the public, staff and others on the phone and in the office. Occasionally being on foot, bending, stooping, squatting, kneeling, climb stairs and kneeling and/or crouching to retrieve files and other items. Occasionally Lifting and carrying (with assistance) items weighing 20-50 lbs.

**Competitive Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance with competitive rates
* Company paid life & AD&D insurance
* Corporate YMCA memberships
* Paid Time Off
* Generous 401(k) with company match
* Life Insurance, AD&D, Disability & Voluntary options
* Employee Assistance Plan

Figeac Aero North America is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

records.title: Director of Quality, Regulatory & Improvement
records.description:
***Title:*** ***Director of Quality, Regulatory and Improvement***

**Job Summary:**
----------------

This senior leadership role leads the quality departments for all Deringer-Ney locations globally. The Director implements best practices and metrics to coordinate all teams under a unified Quality Management System and is responsible for ensuring that the company's products, services, and manufacturing processes comply with strict government laws, industry standards, and internal quality systems. The role plans, coordinates, and directs the activities of the quality assurance and compliance programs to ensure the production of consistent, reliable products that meet or exceed established standards, and leads the continuous improvement team to support, train, and execute the DNIOS system.

***Supervisory Responsibilities:****Yes*

**Duties/Responsibilities:**
----------------------------

* Manage all quality departments by formulating, developing, and overseeing global goals, objectives, policies, procedures, systems, and outcomes pertaining to quality controls, assessments, and audits.
* Quality Management Systems (QMS): Build, maintain, and continuously improve QMS frameworks (such as ISO 13485 and ISO 9001).
* Develop a high-performance team by acquiring, developing, training, coaching, cultivating, and managing talented Quality Control personnel.
* Maintain and improve the quality system through routine system audits and corrective actions, and ensure that corrective actions, whether internal or external, are handled in a timely manner.
* Risk & Lifecycle Management: Oversee design controls, validation packages, complaint handling, and post-market surveillance (such as Automotive Reporting).
* Manage and maintain quality inspection and product release programs for raw materials, work in process (WIP), and finished goods.
* Regulatory Compliance & Filings: Lead product submissions and act as the primary liaison during agency audits.
* Disseminate quality awareness, adherence, and developments to global stakeholders by scheduling and performing regional quality audits and by ensuring that ISO systems are managed and maintained.
* Serve as an active member of the DNI Leadership Team, sharing the function's progress toward its goals while setting, and driving toward, an aspirational vision for a best-in-class quality department.
* Create a Cost of Poor Quality metric for the organization and set specific goals to improve quality performance across the company.
* Lead the development of the Annual Strategic Planning (P.D.C.A.) Cycle to include the Improvement Process.
* Lead the organization in attaining key metrics based on Balanced Scorecard (BSC) Objectives. Understand the department's key performance indicators and leading and lagging indicators, and contribute to achieving these goals, both individually and as a team.
* With the CIP Team, perform systematic audits designed to confirm that process standards are being utilized and met (BSC One-Page Reports).
* Interact with and make recommendations and presentations to the Executive Leadership Group via standardized checks: weekly, monthly, quarterly, and year-end. Maintain the PDCA Cycle while focusing on BSC Objectives.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**
------------------------------

* Strong background in ISO 9000 system management, including training and auditing.
* Strong background in ISO 13485 system management and thorough knowledge of FDA requirements and other international standards that regulate the medical device industry.
* Knowledge of automated inspection equipment, including vision systems and coordinate measuring devices.
* Adept at delegating and managing multiple tasks with various levels of priority.
* Excellent communication skills; must be able to present ideas, results, and requirements effectively throughout the organization and to the customer on a timely basis.
* Expert skill set in applied statistics, reliability, design of experiments, MSA, GR&R, and project management.
* Fluency with various software packages commonly used in project management, database, SPC, word processing, and data acquisition.
* Analytical, problem-solving, project management, facilitation, and decision-making skills are essential.
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate, coach, resolve conflict, and promote teamwork.
* Ability to see and hear the facts from several viewpoints while promoting success through interactive problem solving and teamwork.

**Experience & Education Requirements:**
----------------------------------------

* Technical degree (BS, BSE, or BSME) with a minimum of 10 years' experience in quality engineering or quality management.
* Strong preference for relevant industry experience in a metals or electrical connectors company or similar.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Control, or Regulatory Affairs within a regulated field such as medical devices, automotive, or defense.
* Preferred certifications: Regulatory Affairs Certification (RAC), Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), or Certified Quality Engineer (CQE).
* Demonstrated project management skills in the areas of process control, SPC, automotive PPAP submission, and statistical analysis.
* Lean Green Belt or Black Belt certification, Six Sigma, and DMAIC process experience.
* Actively continuing training through courses and seminars.

***Physical Requirements:***

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times.
* Must be able to access and navigate each department at the organization’s facilities.
* Travel to other locations as required.

records.description:
**We believe that great healthcare is an essential safeguard of human dignity.**

At Laborie, we know the work we do matters – it’s what fuels our motivation and contributes to our success. If you’re ready to make a positive impact in the lives of patients across the globe, we’d like to meet you.

We support and empower our employees to grow their careers in an environment that encourages a sense of belonging and a connection to doing good. We’re not afraid to roll up our sleeves to make our goals a reality and work together to solve for our customers. We reward and recognize our employees based on our values of **Aspire to Greatness, Respect All, Own It, Working Together, Persist with Passion.**

**Who We’re Looking For:**

To ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and the Laborie Medical Quality Systems in the development, manufacturing, and marketing of Laborie Medical products. The position supports corporate wide process improvement initiatives relating to Quality and Regulatory.

**About the Role:**

* Develop and direct quality strategies, objectives, policies and procedures for assigned sites and Quality Management Systems.
* Directly responsible for the CAPA, Internal Audit, Complaint Handling and Training Systems for assigned sites and Quality Management Systems, including results against Quality Objectives related to these areas.
* Provide team leadership, development, and talent management activities including coaching, resource forecasting, hiring, performance management, training, and budgeting for the Quality Assurance and Quality Engineering functions to meet the company's objectives.
* Maintain quality standards set forth in the Laborie Medical Quality Manual(s) and those of its subsidiaries.
* Influence management and staff to encourage continuous improvement of quality and compliance.
* Proactively identify/resolve compliance risks.
* Fulfill the duties of back-up Management Representative.
* Play prominent role in acquisition due diligence and integration efforts.
* Prioritize and manage continuous improvement activities for Laborie
* Provide technical recommendations based on trend analysis to eliminate future problems and execute changes as necessary.
* Maintain compliance to all applicable regulations for the marketing of medical devices.
* Manage the CAPA process for all the company QMS’s.
* Lead auditee and serves as escort during inspections and audits performed by external regulatory bodies and internal auditors.
* Execute miscellaneous tasks, as assigned.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* BS or BA in Business Administration/Computer Sciences/Engineering or related degree
* Experience in a leadership position with direct supervision of Quality/Regulatory professionals
* Minimum 8 years’ experience working in a medically regulated industry in a Quality or Regulatory position.
* Experience with ISO13485, MDSAP, MDR, CFR820
* Experience with Project Management, Problem Solving, Six Sigma, Lean Management Systems, Root Cause Analysis, and other standard Quality tools
* Strong project management skills and attention to detail
* Excellent communication skills, cross department collaboration and leadership skills

**Why Laborie:**

Our Mission every day is to operate as a world-class specialist medical company making and advancing technologies that preserve and restore human dignity. We do that today by helping people with pelvic and gastrointestinal conditions live normal lives, and by helping mothers and babies have safe deliveries.

* Paid time off and paid volunteer time
* Medical, Dental, Vision and Flexible Spending Account
* Health Savings Account with Company Funded Contributions
* 401k Retirement Plan with Company Match
* Parental Leave and Adoption Services
* Health and Wellness Programs and Events

We are interested in a qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we will not be sponsoring work visas for this position, at this time.

*Laborie* *provides equal employment opportunities and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person’s race, color, gender, age, religion, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, or any characteristic protected under applicable law. Laborie is committed to providing access and reasonable accommodation in our services, activities, education, and employment for individuals with disabilities.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

records.title: Sr. Manager - Continuous Improvement
records.description:
Lead continuous improvement at our Battle Creek, Michigan manufacturing facility, where your work will shape performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost and growth. As a key member of the plant leadership team, you will set the CI vision, advise site leaders on strategy and lead a team of continuous improvement professionals.

You will own the plant's management operating system and annual cost-out process while building the capabilities that sustain results. This role combines enterprise-level thinking with daily visibility on the plant floor, giving you the opportunity to turn data, Lean methods and cross-functional partnership into measurable operational gains.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Set and execute the plant's continuous improvement strategy, creating the behaviors, systems and culture needed to achieve plant goals.
* Lead, coach and develop the salaried continuous improvement team while building Lean problem-solving capability across functions.
* Own the plant management operating system, annual cost-out process and A3 strategy documents, including daily, weekly and monthly performance tracking.
* Identify, scope and prioritize breakthrough and incremental improvement opportunities using plant data and operational metrics.
* Teach and model root-cause analysis, DMAIC, standard work, waste reduction, recurrence prevention and structured follow-up.
* Facilitate Kaizen events and cross-functional improvement efforts that strengthen safety, quality, delivery, cost, yield and equipment effectiveness.
* Maintain the plant continuous improvement project docket, track savings and communicate project status and results to operations leadership.
* Partner with operations, engineering and technical teams to implement sustainable solutions and share best practices across PCB facilities.
* Serve as a change leader who constructively challenges non-value-added work and helps teams navigate resistance to change.

**Why You'll Love This Role**

* A visible seat on the plant leadership team with direct influence on site strategy and operational performance.
* The opportunity to build CI capability across the organization and leave a clear handprint on how the plant works.
* Broad collaboration with operations, engineering and CI leaders across Post Consumer Brands.
* A role where big company resources meet a practical, hands-on plant environment.

**Location & Travel Requirements**

* This role is based at the Battle Creek, Michigan manufacturing facility.

**Education**

* A bachelor's degree in science, engineering, management or a related field is preferred.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5 or more years of related experience in a manufacturing environment.
* 3 or more years of successful leadership experience guiding teams that execute continuous improvement or Lean Six Sigma work.
* Demonstrated experience delivering measurable efficiency, effectiveness and financial benefits through continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience operating in a large manufacturing plant environment.
* Deep working knowledge of Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement methods, including root-cause analysis, DMAIC, Kaizen and waste reduction.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects, use operational data to set priorities and sustain improvements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in food manufacturing.
* Experience working in a union manufacturing environment.
* Experience in food or automotive manufacturing settings.
* Experience leading Black Belt-level or transformational cost-out initiatives.

**Success in This Role**

* Builds trust and strong working relationships across plant leadership, operations, engineering and frontline teams.
* Influences, coaches and develops others while setting clear expectations and maintaining accountability for results.
* Communicates a compelling improvement vision and translates complex problems into organized, practical action plans.
* Uses sound analytical and business judgment to solve complex problems and prioritize actions quickly.
* Leads change with candor, optimism and respect, including in environments where established ways of working may be challenged.
* Demonstrates a consistent commitment to a safe, respectful workplace.

**Ready to Make an Impact?**

If you are ready to lead transformational improvement, develop strong teams and help a large manufacturing operation perform at its best, bring your experience and big ambitions to Post Consumer Brands.

records.title: Senior Manager, Quality & QMS
records.description:
**Job Overview:**

The Senior Manager, Quality & QMS is responsible for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continuously improving the Quality Management System (QMS) for Intech’s medical device manufacturing operations.

This position provides senior-level leadership for all site quality activities, including production quality, nonconformance management, CAPA, internal and external audits, supplier quality, document and record control, quality metrics, and continuous improvement. A primary responsibility of the role will be to lead the organization in developing and implementing an effective QMS and preparing the site for ISO 9001 certification.

This position will serve as the primary quality leader for the site and will work closely with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Product Development, and other functional leaders to ensure that quality is integrated into the business and manufacturing processes rather than operating as a separate inspection function. This role is a hands-on position and will operate strategically while also working directly with manufacturing personnel to establish practical, sustainable quality processes.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Own the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the site's Quality Management System.
* Lead the organization through its ISO 9001 readiness and certification process.
* Establish and maintain quality policies, procedures, work instructions, forms, records, and other QMS documentation.
* Establish effective document and record control processes.
* Develop quality objectives, metrics, and management-review processes.
* Ensure QMS processes are understood, implemented, and effective across the organization.
* Identify gaps, risks, and opportunities for improvement and develop practical plans to address them.
* Provide leadership for quality throughout the manufacturing process.
* Establish appropriate inspection, testing, sampling, and process-control requirements.
* Partner with Operations and Engineering to identify and eliminate sources of variation and defects.
* Monitor production quality performance and trends.
* Lead efforts to reduce scrap, rework, defects, and recurring quality issues.
* Ensure appropriate controls are in place for nonconforming product(s), product identification, traceability, and inspection status.
* Support process changes, equipment changes, product introductions, and manufacturing improvements from a quality perspective.
* Own and continuously improve the site's CAPA and nonconformance processes.
* Lead investigations into significant quality issues and recurring nonconformances.
* Establish effective root-cause analysis and corrective-action practices.
* Ensure corrective actions address systemic causes and are implemented and verified for effectiveness.
* Monitor CAPA and NCR trends to identify broader process and systemic issues.
* Establish appropriate escalation of significant quality risks to site leadership.
* Develop and manage the internal audit program.
* Conduct or oversee internal QMS and process audits.
* Coordinate customer, certification, surveillance, and other external audits.
* Serve as the primary quality contact during external audits.
* Ensure audit findings are appropriately investigated, corrected, and closed.
* Build an organization that is continuously audit-ready rather than preparing only immediately before an audit.
* Establish and maintain supplier quality processes.
* Develop supplier qualification, evaluation, monitoring, and re-evaluation practices.
* Establish supplier quality expectations in partnership with Supply Chain and Operations.
* Monitor supplier quality performance and trends.
* Lead or support supplier corrective actions.
* Participate in supplier selection and qualification activities as appropriate.
* Address recurring supplier issues through effective root-cause analysis and corrective action.
* Establish meaningful quality metrics and dashboards.
* Monitor trends in NCRs, CAPAs, audits, supplier performance, scrap, rework, customer issues, and other relevant indicators.
* Translate quality data into actionable improvement initiatives.
* Provide regular quality performance updates to leadership.
* Use structured problem-solving and continuous-improvement methodologies to improve processes and reduce risk.
* Develop strong working relationships with employees at all levels of the organization.
* Partner closely with manufacturing personnel to solve problems at the source.
* Provide quality leadership, coaching, and training.
* Establish clear expectations for quality ownership throughout the organization.
* Promote a culture of prevention, accountability, disciplined problem-solving, and continuous improvement.
* Communicate quality risks clearly and objectively to leadership.

*Management reserves the right to change job duties and responsibilities at any time. Therefore, this job description is not designed to cover every requirement of the job.*

**Education and Work Experience Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 7+ years of progressive experience in quality, quality systems, manufacturing quality, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience implementing, managing, or significantly improving a Quality Management System.
* Strong working knowledge of ISO 9001.
* Must have demonstrated experience taking an organization through ISO 9001 certification.
* Demonstrated experience with CAPA, nonconformance management, root-cause analysis, and corrective action.
* Experience leading internal and external audits.
* Experience working directly in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience with supplier quality and supplier corrective actions.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with both production personnel and senior leadership.
* Ability to establish structure and processes in an environment where the QMS is still developing.
* Medical device manufacturing experience preferred.
* ISO 9001 Lead Auditor or Internal Auditor training/certification preferred.
* ASQ certification such as CQA, CQE, or CMQ/OE.
* Experience with statistical process control, process capability, risk management, or other quality engineering tools.
* Lean Six Sigma or other continuous-improvement experience a plus.
* Familiarity with applicable medical-device quality and regulatory requirements a plus

**Physical Demands and Work Environment:**

* Ability to maintain regular, punctual attendance consistent with company policies
* Must occasionally lift, carry and/or move up to 25 lbs.
* Occasionally required to stand, walk, bend, and constantly sit for extended periods
* Must be able to talk, listen and speak clearly on the telephone
* Continually required to read, write, and type
* Occasional exposure to heat or cold (non-weather) environments
* Occasionally required to use hand/arm movements such as grasping, reaching, pulling

records.title: Senior Manager of Production
records.description:
Gwynedd Manufacturing is seeking a hands-on Senior Manager of Production with a strong CNC machining background to lead day-to-day operations in a high-precision environment. This role is ideal for someone who has progressed through the ranks—from the shop floor into leadership—and is ready to step into a broader operational role.

The ideal candidate brings deep, practical knowledge of CNC machining (mills, lathes, EDM) and thrives in a fast-paced, high-tolerance manufacturing setting. This is not a purely strategic role—this leader will be actively engaged on the floor, driving performance, mentoring teams, and continuously improving processes.

Key Responsibilities:

* Lead daily plant operations with a strong presence on the manufacturing floor, ensuring output, quality, and efficiency targets are met
* Direct oversight of machining operations including CNC mills, lathes, and EDM, ensuring optimal machine utilization and performance
* Manage and develop a team of supervisors, leads, and machinists (50–100+ employees)
* Serve as a technical resource and mentor, supporting setup, programming, and troubleshooting when needed
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on cycle time reduction, scrap reduction, and process standardization
* Partner closely with Engineering and Quality to ensure tight tolerance requirements and manufacturability of parts
* Own production scheduling, workflow optimization, and labor planning to meet customer demand
* Establish and reinforce shop floor accountability, KPIs, and standard work practices
* Maintain a safe, compliant, and disciplined manufacturing environment
* Support new product introductions and prototype builds with a strong understanding of machining constraints
* Overseeing multiple departments withing the manufacturing space.

Qualifications:

* 5+ years of progressive manufacturing experience, with clear growth from hands-on machining into leadership
* Strong CNC background required (setup, programming, and/or machining experience with mills, lathes, EDM)
* Prior experience in roles such as Machine Shop Manager, Manufacturing Manager, or Plant Manager
* Proven ability to lead teams in a high-precision, tight-tolerance environment
* Deep understanding of machining processes, tooling, fixturing, and production workflows
* Experience driving continuous improvement on the shop floor (Lean, process optimization, etc.)
* Comfortable being hands-on and highly visible in daily operations, not just managing from an office
* Strong leadership and communication skills with the ability to develop talent from within
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field preferred, but equivalent hands-on experience strongly valued

Physical and Work Environment Requirements: 
This position is based in a manufacturing environment and may require the following over extended periods of time up to a full 8-hour work shift (excluding lunch and breaks): stand, walk, sit, squat or bend, kneel and rise, lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to — and occasionally exceeding — 50 pounds, view a computer or other digital screen, work on a computer, workstation or comparable system, and make accurate entries in such systems. Manual dexterity and fine motor skills are required for detailed assembly and precision work. Work may take place in areas with varying temperatures or no climate control, varying noise levels, and production equipment in motion. Proper personal protective equipment (PPE) must be worn in designated areas at all times as required by company policy. Reasonable accommodations may be available to enable individuals with disabilities but are always subject to safety concerns for the employee and all team members. Employer may require a physical assessment of the candidate’s ability to perform these tasks as a condition of an offer letter. Any assessment will be performed by a third party vendor and will be reported on a pass/fail basis with no other medical information conveyed to employer.

*Equal Opportunity Employer:* 
*Gwynedd Manufacturing is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

*Note: This job description reflects general duties and responsibilities and is not intended to be an exhaustive list. Management may modify or assign other responsibilities as needed.*

records.title: Senior Manager, Warehouse Operations
records.description:
**Who We Are**

Stored Energy Systems (SENS) is an award-winning manufacturer of premium quality power conversion products located in Longmont, CO. In business for over 50 years, SENS is the market leader with a proven track record of providing highly reliable battery chargers, DC power systems, and related products to industrial markets. For more information on our company please see our web site at www.sens-usa.com.

**View the SENS Product Catalog**

**Summary**

The Senior Manager, Warehouse Operations leads the people, processes, and systems that maintain accurate inventory and reliable material flow across Stored Energy Systems (SENS) manufacturing operations. Based at Disc Drive headquarters, this role leads teams and team members across all SENS locations on first shift (days) and second shift (evenings). The role oversees receiving, warehousing, inventory control, material handling, production replenishment, kitting, inter-factory transportation, shipping, and freight coordination, while developing teams and operating capacity to support production continuity, customer deliveries, and growth.

**Responsibilities**

Leadership and Operating Performance

* Establish consistent material handling and inventory management standards, performance expectations, and accountability across all locations.
* Develop supervisors and team leaders through coaching, training, performance management, and succession planning.
* Own Warehouse Operations staffing plans and coordinate coverage, priorities, and escalation processes across all locations and both shifts to support production needs.
* Promote safe material handling and consistent workplace practices in partnership with the Environmental Health and Safety team.

Inventory Accuracy and Control

* Own inventory accuracy and control standards across SENS inventory locations, including inventory held at partner locations.
* Establish consistent receiving, put-away, picking, transfer, issue, return, and reconciliation processes in Infor SyteLine. Oversee receipt processing for non-inventory purchases.
* Lead cycle counting, inventory discrepancy investigations, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Maintain material identification, traceability, first-in, first-out practices, and segregation of restricted or nonconforming inventory.
* Partner with Procurement and Finance on inventory reconciliation and actions to improve inventory health, supporting Procurement’s ownership of inventory turns, safety stock levels, and excess and obsolete inventory.
* Lead preparation and execution of annual physical inventories at all SENS locations.

Production Material Flow

* Lead production material delivery, including stock picking, replenishment of point-of-use inventory areas, scheduled material delivery routes, and kanban replenishment parameters. Align execution with sales, inventory, and operations planning (SIOP) and production schedules.
* Develop and implement scalable assembly-phase kitting processes for configure-to-order and engineer-to-order products. Ensure kit accuracy, completeness, alignment with current revisions, staging, and return of unused materials.
* Coordinate material priorities, shortage escalations, and decisions about incomplete kits with Planning, Production, and Procurement.
* Establish visual management and kanban replenishment processes from kitting through delivery to production lines.

Transportation, Shipping, and Freight

* Own inter-factory transportation and inventory transfers, movement of finished products to shipping, and return flows for empty bins, carts, and protective packing materials.
* Lead local shipping operations and centralized inbound and outbound freight execution, coordinating with Planning & Fulfillment and Order Management to support on-time, complete customer shipments.
* Manage freight and premium freight costs against budget and maintain transportation contingency plans to support production continuity and customer deliveries.

Capacity and Continuous Improvement

* Translate production forecasts into logistics capacity plans. Lead warehouse and material-flow readiness for factory expansions and production ramps, including space, staffing, and training.
* Improve productivity through standard work, waste reduction, daily performance management, process automation, and enterprise resource planning (ERP) system improvements, in partnership with IT, Manufacturing Engineering, and Continuous Improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in manufacturing inventory, warehousing, and logistics, including 5+ years leading supervisors and teams across multiple sites and shifts.
* Demonstrated success scaling warehouse operations in a high-growth manufacturing environment.
* Strong knowledge of inventory controls, ERP transactions, cycle counting, kanban, supermarkets, production replenishment, and order kitting.
* Experience managing shipping operations, transportation providers, and freight costs.
* Experience supporting repetitive manufacturing production.
* Demonstrated ability to improve inventory accuracy, establish consistent operating practices, and develop effective supervisors and team leaders.
* Ability to analyze operational and financial data, resolve problems, and communicate priorities and issues across functions.
* Experience implementing Lean or continuous improvement initiatives.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, logistics, operations, engineering, or a related field
* Relevant supply chain, logistics, or Lean certification.
* Experience with Infor SyteLine, barcode scanning, and warehouse management systems.
* Experience in electrical equipment, industrial products, or similarly complex manufacturing environments.
* Experience supporting configure-to-order or engineer-to-order production.

**Location:** Longmont, CO

**Base Compensation:** $135,000 - $165,000 is the projected range of annual base salary for this role depending on the candidate’s overall qualifications and experience.

**Bonus:** This position is eligible for an annual bonus based on individual and company performance.

**Closing Date:** December 1st. While we expect to keep the position open through this date, the posting may be extended or closed early based on applicant volume and hiring needs.

**Onsite Perks**

* Free gym with 24/7 access

records.description:
**Date Posted:**

2026-11-16

**Country:**

United States of America

**Location:**

US-CA-EL SEGUNDO-E01 ~ 2000 E El Segundo Blvd ~ BLDG E01

**Position Role Type:**

Onsite

**U.S. Citizen, U.S. Person, or Immigration Status Requirements:**

The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required. U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance

**Security Clearance Type:**

DoD Clearance: Secret

**Security Clearance Status:**

Active and existing security clearance required after day 1

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

**Raytheon Company, Managed by Collins Aerospace**

We are seeking a dedicated professional to join our team as a Senior Manager, Program Quality Leader. This onsite role, based in El Segundo, CA will support Positioning, Navigation and Timing (PNT) Avionics within Mission Systems. In this role, you will lead efforts and develop teams to effectively implement Quality & Mission Assurance (QMA) requirements across all program phases. You will serve as the primary Quality interface for customers, suppliers, and programs.

**What You Will Do**:

* Develop and lead a team of Program Quality Leads (PQLs) and Customer Quality Engineers (CQEs) to support program execution and deliverables.
* Engage with internal and external stakeholders to establish effective relationships and influence decision-making across multiple levels within a cross-functional environment at multiple sites.
* Ensure quality requirements are integrated into program estimates and proposals and oversee their consistent application.
* Lead and oversee the implementation of Quality & Mission Assurance (QMA) requirements across all phases of assigned programs.
* Serve as the primary QMA interface for customers, suppliers, and internal program teams, ensuring alignment with customer requirements and expectations.
* Drive strategic improvements to enhance quality processes, reduce defects, and improve overall program performance.
* Oversee the development and application of quality metrics to identify root causes and implement long-term corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with industry and regulatory quality standards, including ISO 9001, AS9100, and AS9102.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including program management, operations, and engineering, to ensure process capability, product conformance, and on-time delivery.
* Manage customer interface activities, including interactions with Acquisitioned Customers and Defense Contract Management Agency (DCMA).
* Support manufacturing processes by interpreting drawings, work instructions, and Bills of Materials (BOMs).
* Promote continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, reduce costs, and improve customer satisfaction.
* Must be willing and able to travel up to 10% of the time.

**Qualifications You Must Have**:

* Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and minimum 10 years of relevant experience, or an Advanced degree and minimum 7 years of relevant experience.
* Experience reviewing customer proposals and part orders for compliance risk to quality requirements, and establishing cost estimates for quality support.
* Experience leading teams in program management, quality management, operations management, or an engineering capacity.
* Experience as the direct interface to external customers.
* Experience with manufacturing processes, including quality systems and industry technical standards (ISO 9001 or AS9100), as well as interpreting drawings, work instructions, and Bills of Materials (BOMs).

**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Direct experience working with Defense Contract Management Agency (DCMA).
* Certification in Customer Oriented Results and Excellence (CORE) or similar.
* American Society for Quality (ASQ) certification.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Experience leading initiatives that result in reduced operating costs, improved quality, and enhanced customer satisfaction.
* Experience with SAP (or similar ERP systems) and with Power Apps (or similar tools).

**What We Offer Benefits**

This position may offer relocation.

Some of our competitive benefits packages include:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Three weeks of vacation for newly hired employees
* Generous 401(k) plan that includes employer matching funds and separate employer retirement contribution, including a Lifetime Income Strategy option
* Tuition reimbursement program
* Student Loan Repayment Program
* Life insurance and disability coverage
* Optional coverages you can buy pet insurance, home and auto insurance, additional life and accident insurance, critical illness insurance, group legal, ID theft protection
* Birth, adoption, parental leave benefits
* Ovia Health, fertility, and family planning
* Adoption Assistance
* Autism Benefit
* Employee Assistance Plan, including up to 10 free counseling sessions
* Healthy You Incentives, wellness rewards program
* Doctor on Demand, virtual doctor visits
* Bright Horizons, child and elder care services
* Teladoc Medical Experts, second opinion program
* And more!

**Learn More & Apply Now!**

Do you want to be a part of something bigger? A team whose impact stretches across the world, and even beyond? At Collins Aerospace, our Mission Systems team helps civilian, military and government customers complete their most complex missions — whatever and wherever they may be. Our customers depend on us for intelligent and secure communications, missionized systems for specialized aircraft and spacecraft and collaborative space solutions. By joining our team, you’ll have your own critical part to play in ensuring our customers succeed today while anticipating their needs for tomorrow. Are you up for the challenge? Join our mission today.

The next chapter of our future as an aerospace company is here, and we are excited about what this means for our employees and customers! Get onboard the Collins Aerospace Operations team and play a part in managing our innovative products from inception to delivery. The Operations team continues to grow and aims to strengthen the connection of Manufacturing Operations, Supply Chain and Environment, Health & Safety (EH&S) across Collins Aerospace. In this dynamic environment, you will have the opportunity to network across our businesses and functions, all while improving the productivity, quality and efficiency of our operations worldwide.

* Please ensure the role type (defined below) is appropriate for your needs before applying to this role.
* **Onsite:** Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.

At Collins, the paths we pave together lead to limitless possibilities. And the bonds we form – with our customers and with each other - propel us all higher, again and again.

 

Apply now and be part of the team that’s redefining aerospace, every day.

#LI-JC4

***As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.***

The salary range for this role is 145,600 USD - 276,800 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. RTX considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role, function and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, location, education/training, and key skills.Hired applicants may be eligible for benefits, including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts, flexible work schedules, employee assistance program, Employee Scholar Program, parental leave, paid time off, and holidays. Specific benefits are dependent upon the specific business unit as well as whether or not the position is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement.Hired applicants may be eligible for annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs depending on the level of the position and whether or not it is covered by a collective-bargaining agreement. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and are dependent upon a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual performance, business unit performance, and/or the company’s performance.This role is a U.S.-based role. If the successful candidate resides in a U.S. territory, the appropriate pay structure and benefits will apply.RTX anticipates the application window closing approximately 40 days from the date the notice was posted. However, factors such as candidate flow and business necessity may require RTX to shorten or extend the application window.

*RTX is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. RTX provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.*

records.title: Sr. Manager, Quality
records.description:
At Bloom Energy, our vision for a world powered by clean, reliable, and affordable energy is more than just a dream—we’re making it reality.

 

For over two decades, we’ve been at the forefront of the global energy transition, pioneering solutions that empower critical industries to thrive in a rapidly digitizing, energy-intensive world. From revolutionizing power for AI-driven data centers to ensuring resilience for hospitals, electric grids, manufacturing facilities, and utilities, our solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) and solid oxide electrolyzer (SOEC) technologies are redefining what’s possible by delivering energy abundance for all. With more than 30,000 fuel cell modules deployed worldwide, we are the trusted partner for Fortune 100 companies and innovators alike. Our cutting-edge solutions enable unparalleled “time-to-power” capabilities, reliability, and sustainability, ensuring our customers remain ahead in a world where soaring energy demand and intensifying energy scarcity are rapidly becoming the new norm.

At Bloom, we thrive on collaboration, bold thinking, and relentless innovation. We believe that, together, we can create a brighter, more sustainable future while tackling the most pressing challenges of the 21st century.

 

We are looking for a S **r. Manager, Quality** to join our team in one of today’s most exciting technologies. This role will report to **Director of Quality** and based in **Newark, Delaware. This is a fully on-site, in office role 5 days a week** .

 

**Role and Responsibilities:**

* Ensure 100% Quality assurance at the Skid line manufacturing through inspection, testing, and sub-component testing/inspection. Assist in hiring personnel needed to support this effort.

* Partner with Install Quality team (field) to understand real time (daily) what items are escaping the plant and instituting immediate mitigation plans including addressing any inventory in the pipeline not yet installed.

* Implement permanent corrective actions working with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply chain, or SQE as per relevance on each issue.

* Provide quality input into the new equipment being purchased for the scaling of Delaware manufacturing. Include inputs for quality assurance into equipment design, and verification of process steps. Understand and provide input into the planned operation, what can be bypassed, maintenance plans, calibration or drift of the equipment, automation that can fail and be undetected leading to quality escapes.

* Participate and understand results from testing in the plant; Functional test, Tommy test, FIT, etc. Drive pareto of failures to help cross functional problem solving of test failures.

* Implement a 100% functional test (new) on skid final product assembly; electrical continuity, communications integrity, piping assurance, start up simulation, etc. to assure 100% QA prior to shipping to customer.

* Ensure skid components and systems have latest FW revision prior to shipping to the W/H, or out of W/H to field.

* Work with CIG and Manufacturing Engr, and NPI to implement workload being removed from the customer install side and being moved into skid assembly. Provide oversight to ensure best quality achievement; ensure work instructions are clear, operators trained, workstations have proper tools, and judgement criteria.

* Collaborate with Supplier Quality / Suppliers to achieve zero-defect flow (“dock-to-stock”) for all purchased, contract manufacture parts, materials, and Bloom Energy manufactured parts.

* Drive component and design failures back to the earliest point of detection in the process.

* Ensure manufacturing process have Control plans with CTQ, and POA built in to each station.

* Work collaboratively with Design teams to DFM, through a “registration system”, and Pokeyoke assembly methods for highest quality assurance.

* Drive test excellence in the manufacturing plan to ensure that equipment and test stations are certified with robust qualification programs, that are documented and controlled for changes with proper accuracy and gage R&R techniques.

* Drive yield task forces to achieve company wide targets at each manufacturing point under this scope, with cross functional teams driving top pareto issues to RCCA.

* Ensure early engagement with the product engineering team to teach and perform early stage risk assessments (DFMEA et.al.)

* Design for manufacturability and reliability improvements during the early design stages of product development.

* Work with Engineering NPI and the manufacturing engineering teams to perform PFMEA, write work instructions, and establish quality check-points to guarantee zero-defect quality in production.

* Develop and implement formal, comprehensive process documentation including process flow diagrams, Process FMEAs, process control plans, operations method Sheets, manufacturing quality charts (MQCs) and etc.

* Lead critical problem solving task forces with emphasis on cross functional inputs, accountability, time to RCCA, and ensurance of mitigation of inventory, or field units at risk.

* Troubleshoot product issues by reviewing engineering drawings and design requirements. Drive a rigorous resolution process for product quality, reliability and design issues.

* Perform data-driven root cause failure analyses for design, manufacturing, and administrative problems.

* Perform process audits to monitor, continuously improve, and sustain superior product quality.

* Demonstrate the ability to interface and work collaboratively across departments internally and with suppliers and customers, (including Purchasing, Quality, R&D, Manufacturing, Product Engineering, Marketing and Finance), while building strong and cooperative working relationships.

* Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) Reduction: Establish and govern site COPQ metrics (scrap, rework, sorting, and warranty risk); lead cross-functional yield-improvement blitzes targeting measurable cost reductions and scrap minimization.

* Process Capability & Zero-Defect Mentality: Drive process capability (C\_p / C\_{pk} \ge 1.33) across critical-to-quality (CTQ) operations (welding, brazing, ceramic stack assembly, plumbing/gas-delivery, and electrical integration).

 

**Skills and Experience:**

* More than 10 years of increasing responsibility in the areas of Quality, and Manufacturing .

* Experience implementing company-wide ISO 9001 procedures and TS16949 standards and related process documentation. Possess working knowledge of process capability and control requirements, methods and systems.

* Demonstrated track record of building, restructuring, or significantly scaling a manufacturing quality team during rapid production ramp-up

* Proven successful application of multi-discipline engineering problem solving techniques.

* Understand the critical elements of modern Manufacturing Statistical Process Control, (e.g., practical working knowledge and experience with SPC, Process Capability, Cp, Cpk, etc.)

* Understand the critical elements of modern Reliability Engineering, (e.g., MCF, MTBF, MTT, etc.)

* Certification in a recognized problem-solving methodology such as six-sigma Black Belt, 8D, or Global Problem Solving.

* Strong verbal/active listening/written communications.

* Demonstrate planning and leadership skills.

* Expert with metrology, calibration, and Gage R & R’s.

* Ability to train in Quality System Auditing.

* Fluent in product phase-gate, NPI and technology transfer.

* Expertise in applying PPAP, First Article Inspections (FAI) and Reports).

* Strong critical thinking, analytical skills, and problem solving.

* Ability to effectively work within a very intense, dynamic, fast-paced, and demanding work environment.

* Familiarity with industry codes and quality standards applicable to clean power systems (ISO 9001:2015 required; working knowledge of ASME, NFPA, or UL standards preferred).

* ASQ Certified Manager of Quality / Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE) and ASQ Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE) alongside CQE and Six Sigma Black Belt.

* Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Office Suite and statistical software.

* Possess a passion for excellence.

* Unrestricted willingness to travel to all regions. Travel may be up to 25% of time.

* BS, MS or PhD in Mechanical/Material Science/Chemical/Electrical/Systems Engineering.

* Direct experience managing high-temperature fluidics/gas delivery, welding/brazing, ceramic integration, power electronics, or structural enclosures is a strong plus.

 

Bloom Energy is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We are committed to compliance with all applicable laws providing equal employment opportunities. All qualified applicants, will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability. Bloom Energy makes reasonable accommodations, consistent with applicable laws, for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified applicant or employee with a disability, who can perform the essential job functions, unless undue hardship would result.

 

At Bloom Energy, we are committed to supporting the well-being of our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits package for eligible employees includes competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans with a large employer contribution, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with company match, generous Mental Health Support services, Legal services, virtual Physical Therapy access, and Fertility & Family Forming benefits.

Bloom Energy is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The total compensation for this position includes standard company benefits and is based on various factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience.

**Salary Ranges:**
==================

$149,300.00 - $214,700.00

records.title: Senior Manager, Quality Assurance - GxP (GCP)
records.description:
PTC Therapeutics is a global commercial biopharmaceutical company. For over 25 years our team has been deeply committed to a unified purpose: Extending life’s moments for children and adults living with a rare disease.

At PTC, we cultivate an inclusive culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds to join our team**,** fostering a strong sense of belonging.

Visit our website to learn more about our company and culture! 
Site: www.ptcbio.com

**Job Description Summary:**
----------------------------

The Senior Manager, Quality Assurance - GxP (GCP) is responsible for managing GxP Quality Assurance (QA) functions with an emphasis on Good Clinical Practice (GCP) compliance for development products. This involves engaging and collaborating with cross-functional internal and external teams to evaluate processes, procedures, and activities for adherence to relevant industry standards, regulatory guidelines, and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as appropriate.
 
 
The incumbent will support and/or conduct internal and external GCP audits of investigator sites, vendors, clinical study reports, investigator brochures, and submission documents, etc.
 
 
She/He will assist in inspection readiness activities. 
 
She/He may manage direct reports. 
 
The incumbent works cross-functionally with internal departments and external resources on GxP QA related issues.
 
The Senior Manager, Quality Assurance – GxP (GCP)supports adherence to relevant regulatory requirements and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as appropriate.

**Job Description:**
--------------------

*Responsibilities:*

* Partners with Clinical Development/Operations and actively participates in clinical study teams to ensure GCP compliance. Assists in identifying and communicating clinical trial-related risks and opportunities for process improvement. Reviews study-related documents and plans.
* Performs internal and external audits as assigned to ensure compliance with GXP regulations and guidelines.
* Communicates audit results to internal stakeholders and writes audit report.
* Assesses audit responses and ensures closure of corrective action preventative actions (CAPAs).
* Leads backroom activities during regulatory authority inspections and assists with GxP inspection readiness activities.
* Supports Quality Management System (QMS) including, but not be limited to, the following activities:
* QA review/approval of deviations, CAPAs and change controls.
* Drafts, reviews, and approves SOPs.
* May manage, coach, and mentor direct reports.
Performs other tasks and assignments as needed and specified by management. 

 

*Qualifications:*

Bachelor’s degree in a scientific discipline and a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience in Quality Assurance or related role in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or related environment.

* Detailed knowledge and understanding of GCP regulations.
* Demonstrated experience leading and/or conducting QA audits.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing risk-based audit plans.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and foster positive, collaborative relationships with internal staff as well as with external, third-party vendors.
* Demonstrated leadership ability and experience managing, coaching, and mentoring direct reports.
* Experience supporting regulatory agency inspections.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively, as required, in a fast-paced, matrixed, team environment consisting of internal and external team members.
* Analytical thinker with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt to changing priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent planning, organization, and time management skills including the ability to support and prioritize multiple projects.

*Special knowledge or skills and/or licenses or certificates preferred.*

* Experience writing and reviewing SOPs.
* Clinical lab experience.

* Registered GxP Quality Assurance Certifications.
* Experience supporting regulatory agency (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA) inspections.
* Knowledge and experience in Good Laboratory Practice (GLP), Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), and/or Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) regulations.

*Travel requirements: Up to 30% (Domestic and International)*

*Expected Base Salary Range: $141,900 -$175,000. The base salary offered will be contingent on assessment of candidate education level, background, and experience relative to the requirements of the position they are being considered for, as well as review of internal equity.*

*In addition to base salary, PTC employees are also eligible for short- and long-term incentives. All eligible employees may also enroll in PTC’s medical, dental, vision, and retirement savings plans*

**EEO Statement:**

**PTC Therapeutics is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all individuals, regardless of race, color, national origin, gender, age, physical characteristics, social origin, disability, religion, family status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, disability, veteran status or any unlawful criterion under applicable law. We are committed to treating all applicants fairly and avoiding discrimination.**

records.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The IT Quality Senior Manager accomplishes results through the management of professional team(s) and department(s). Integrates subject matter and industry expertise within a defined area. Contributes to standards around which others will operate. Requires in-depth understanding of how areas collectively integrate within the sub-function as well as coordinate and contribute to the objectives of the entire function. Requires basic commercial awareness. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to guide, influence and convince others, in particular colleagues in other areas and occasional external customers. Has responsibility for volume, quality, timeliness and delivery of end results of an area. May have responsibility for planning, budgeting and policy formulation within area of expertise. Involved in short-term planning resource planning. Full management responsibility of a team, which may include management of people, budget and planning, to include duties such as performance evaluation, compensation, hiring, disciplinary and terminations and may include budget approval.
 
 
**Responsibilities:**

* Performs initiatives related to User Acceptance Testing (UAT) process and product rollout into production. Testing specialists who work with technology project managers, UAT professionals and users to design and implement appropriate scripts/plans for an application testing strategy/approach. Responsibilities may also include software quality assurance testing.
* Manages multiple IT Quality teams or an IT Quality functional area (depending on size of business).
* Resolves complex and highly variable issues.
* Analyzes trends at an organizational level to improve processes; follows and analyzes industry trends.
* Develops and designs standards and procedures; ensures that they are adhered to throughout the software development life cycle.
* Manages organizational process change.
* Develops and implements methods for cost, effort and milestones of IT Quality activities. Strives for continuous improvements and streamlining of processes.
* Ensures consistency and quality of processes across the organization. Exhibits in-depth understanding of concepts and procedures within own area and basic knowledge of these elements in other areas.
* Requires in-depth understanding of how own area integrates within IT Quality and has basic commercial awareness.
* Evaluates subordinates' performance and makes decisions on pay increases, promotions, terminations, etc.
* Uses evaluative judgment in complicated or novel situations; uses multiple sources of information.
* Impacts IT Quality through delivery of end results and contribution to planning, finances/budget and formulation of policies.
* Responsible for budgeting, project estimates, task management & balancing prioritization across multiple streams of development
* Responsible for people management, mentoring and career development process for Shanghai team including delivering performance review, training, recruiting.
* Collaborates with local and global stakeholders like QA team, production support team, environment management team, DBA team, etc. to ensure project stability and productivity.
* Responsible for handling day-to-day staff management issues, including resource management and allocation of work within the team/project.
* Performs other duties and functions as assigned.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of others and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.
* Playwright & TypeScript/JavaScript Mastery (Required): Extensive hands-on experience designing and implementing scalable, maintainable test automation frameworks from scratch using Playwright and TypeScript/JavaScript.
* CI/CD Pipeline Integration & Quality Gating (Required): In-depth experience establishing continuous testing workflows within CI/CD pipelines, including setting up automated regression triggering and pipeline hard gating.
* Containerization & Scaled Infrastructure (Strongly Preferred): Strong background in leveraging Docker and Kubernetes to containerize test suites and horizontally scale distributed test execution across enterprise environments.
* GenAI & Agentic Testing Workflows (Strongly Preferred): Experience using AI Harnesses (e.g., GitHub Copilot or Claude) and creating custom AI agents or automated agentic workflows to optimize the software testing lifecycle.

**Qualifications:**

 
 

* Extensive hands-on experience designing and building scalable, maintainable test automation frameworks using Playwright and TypeScript/JavaScript.

* In-depth experience establishing continuous testing workflows within CI/CD pipelines, including automated regression triggering and pipeline gating.

* 6 to 10 years of IT testing experience, with excellent knowledge of software testing techniques and tools.

* Working knowledge of established software development and testing lifecycle methodologies.

* Full people management experience, including performance evaluation, hiring, and career development.

* Strong communication and diplomacy skills, with the ability to influence and persuade stakeholders across functions.

* An automation-first mindset, applying AI-driven approaches to test development.

**Education:**

 
 
 

* Bachelor’s/University degree, Master’s degree preferred
 

-

---------------------

Technology

**Job Family:**
---------------

-

--------------

Full time

-

---------------------

Jersey City New Jersey United States

-

--------------------------------------------

$129,840.00 - $194,760.00 

In addition to salary, Citi’s offerings may also include, for eligible employees, discretionary and formulaic incentive and retention awards. Citi offers competitive employee benefits, including: medical, dental & vision coverage; 401(k); life, accident, and disability insurance; and wellness programs. Citi also offers paid time off packages, including planned time off (vacation), unplanned time off (sick leave), and paid holidays. For additional information regarding Citi employee benefits, please visit citibenefits.com. Available offerings may vary by jurisdiction, job level, and date of hire.

------------------------

Please see the requirements listed above.

-------------------------

For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter.

Nov 23, 2026

We use automated processing, including artificial intelligence, for our legitimate business interests (or our reasonable and appropriate business purposes) to identify and align the candidate's skills and abilities with a specific job opening. Additionally, if you so choose, or consent, we can match your skills and abilities to other suitable roles at Citi.

Importantly, all our hiring processes and decisions, including determining your suitability for a role, are conducted, checked, and decided by individuals. Our automated processing and AI do not involve relying on automatic or autonomous decision-making. records.description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

**Environmental Conditions**

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards

**Job Description**

**Title: Senior Manager Quality Sterility Assurance**
-----------------------------------------------------

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

**Division/Site Specific Information**

Role reports to the Ridgefield, NJ site and reports to the Drug Product Division within the Pharma Services Group.

 

**Discover Impactful Work:** 
As a Senior Manager of Quality at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will guide strategic quality initiatives and support a culture of continuous improvement across our organization. You'll oversee quality management systems, ensure regulatory compliance, and enhance customer experience through excellent quality standards. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you'll develop and implement quality strategies that support our mission of enabling customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer.

**A Day in the Life:**
----------------------

* In this role, you'll manage quality assurance and quality control teams while building strong partnerships with operations, R&D, commercial teams, and customers.
* You'll guide process improvements through Practical Process Improvement (PPI) methodologies and risk-based approaches.
* Your leadership will be essential in maintaining inspection readiness, managing customer relationships, and ensuring compliance with global regulatory requirements.
* As a member of the Quality Leadership Team, you'll support quality initiatives that deliver consistent product excellence while meeting business objectives.
* You'll develop quality professionals, lead investigations, and implement data-driven solutions that enhance our quality systems and customer satisfaction.

**Keys to Success:**

**Education/Experience**
------------------------

* Advanced Degree plus 6 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 8 years of experience in pharmaceutical, medical device, or regulated life sciences industry required.
* Preferred Fields of Study: Science, Engineering, Chemistry, or related technical field
* Professional certifications desired (ASQ, Lean Six Sigma, etc.)
* 5+ years of quality management/leadership experience
* Experience hosting regulatory inspections and customer audits
* Experience implementing continuous improvement initiatives
* Experience with quality tools including FMEA, Risk Analysis, and Root Cause Analysis

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities**

 

* Expert knowledge of global quality standards (ISO 13485, ISO 9001, FDA 21 CFR 820, EU MDR/IVDR)
* Strong understanding of quality management systems and GMP requirements
* Demonstrated experience leading quality investigations, CAPA, and change control processes
* Excellent project management and cross-functional leadership abilities
* Strong data analysis and problem-solving capabilities
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to build collaborative relationships at all levels
* Proficiency with quality management software systems

**Benefits**

We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus scheme, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits! Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation.

**Compensation and Benefits**

The salary range estimated for this position based in New Jersey is $143,200.00–$214,900.00.

This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short- and long-term disability in accordance with company policy
* Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
* Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount

For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total-rewards
