records.title: Quality Systems Project Sr Manager
records.description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talented team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels inspired, invested, cared for, valued, and have a strong sense of belonging.

**What You Can Expect**
-----------------------

Leads the Quality Management System (QMS) integration of acquired medical device businesses and/or products into Zimmer Biomet (ZB) network. Plans, manages and executes the QMS Integration Project Plan (IPP) to update, harmonize and transition the acquired site’s QMS to ZB Global Quality requirements and applicable regulations; to remediate and transfer the site’s QMS and medical device product quality documentation and records from legacy systems into ZB global enterprise IT applications; and to ensure the site obtains and/or maintains certifications and establishment registration. Partners cross-functionally with Quality, Regulatory, R&D, Operations, Supplier Quality, Post-Market Surveillance, Servicing, IT, the Integration Management Office (IMO) and acquired-site leadership to complete integration on schedule and within budget while maintaining continuous regulatory compliance, product supply and in-process regulatory submissions.

**How You'll Create Impact**
----------------------------

* Leads cross-functional, multi-workstream QMS integration projects for newly acquired medical device businesses, from post-close planning through harmonization, documentation transfer, verification of effectiveness and integration closure.
  + Serves as the ZB Quality Integration Lead / QMS Project Leader for assigned acquisitions; accountable for the integration plan, schedule, budget, resources and deliverables.
  + Proposes corporate-wide process and issue solutions; resolves conflicts and escalates risks and roadblocks to Quality leadership and the IMO.
  + Coaches and mentors ZB and acquired-site team members on ZB Global QMS requirements; may supervise or direct team members, contractors and consultants.
  + Reviewer and approver of integration plans, gap assessments, migration protocols/reports and document-controlled forms.
  + Serves as Global SME for the QMS integration process and as site SME for multiple QMS sub-systems during transition.
  + Represents Quality in external and internal (global, site, IMO and executive) meetings, and during regulatory inspections and certification audits related to integration.
  + Strategic project planning for projects of all scale and complexity (plan, resources, budget).
* QMS Integration Planning and Project Management:
  + Translates due diligence findings into integration scope, risk-based priorities and workstreams; authors and maintains the QMS Integration Project Plan (IPP) per ZB global integration guidance and M&A procedures, and obtains cross-functional approval of the plan and its revisions.
  + Establishes and leads integration workstreams (e.g., Management Controls; Document & Record Controls & QMS Software; Design & Development Controls & Risk Management; Servicing; Purchasing, Production & Process Controls; CAPA / Quality Systems; Post-Market Surveillance; Regulatory and Clinical Affairs), assigning ZB and site owners, milestones and target dates.
  + Maintains detailed integration action plans, schedules and risk/issue logs (e.g., SharePoint, Smartsheet); leads recurring integration project meetings and reports status, budget, timeline, risks and roadblocks to Quality leadership, the IMO and site senior leadership.
  + Manages the integration budget and resource plan (including incremental headcount and external support) and revises the IPP when scope changes (e.g., new markets, new NPI projects, new product registrations).
* QMS Harmonization and Transition:
  + Leads gap assessments of site QMS procedures, processes and records against the ZB Global Quality Manual, global procedures (GBL/GBLW), and applicable regulations and standards; documents the harmonization approach and remediation actions.
  + Drives revision, adoption or retirement of the site Quality Manual, Quality Policy, procedures and work instructions; defines interim controls, “hybridized” processes, workstream decision forms and design control transition memoranda to maintain compliance until full adoption of global requirements.
  + Coordinates implementation of management controls, including Management Representative designation, organization charts and job descriptions, global KPIs and Global Quality Report, management review, and internal/external audit programs.
  + Establishes stakeholder-agreed cutover / go-live dates for each QMS sub-system (e.g., document control, CAPA, nonconformance, product holds, HHE/field actions, complaints, supplier controls, calibration, servicing) and ensures open legacy records are completed and closed under legacy procedures.
  + Coordinates intercompany quality agreements between the acquired site and ZB sites (e.g., complaint handling units, distribution and service centers) and contract manufacturers.

**How You'll Create Impact (cont.)**
------------------------------------

* Documentation Remediation and Transfer to ZB Enterprise Applications:
  + Plans and leads the transfer of QMS and product quality documentation and records from the acquired site’s legacy eQMS/document management system into ZB global enterprise applications (e.g., Windchill, OpenText LiveLink, WOW, Codebeamer, EtQ Reliance, iLearn, ServiceMax).
  + Develops data migration / transfer protocols, data mapping, acceptance criteria, verification and summary reports; ensures migrated and archived records remain complete, accurate, retrievable and compliant with record retention and electronic records/signature requirements.
  + Assesses and remediates product quality documentation, including Design History Files (DHF), Risk Management Files (RMF), Device Master Records, labeling, specifications and drawings, validations (process, software, test method) and supplier files (e.g., ASL, SPPA, SCN, SCAR), to ZB global requirements before or during transfer.
  + Coordinates with R&D and Regulatory Affairs to sequence documentation transfer so that ongoing NPI, design transfer and regulatory submissions (e.g., 510(k)) are not disrupted.
  + Partners with IT and global system owners on site set-up (e.g., site codes, user access, configuration), system training for site personnel, training curricula mapping to the ZB learning management system, and legacy system archival and decommissioning.
* Compliance, Effectiveness and Closure:
  + Ensures continued compliance and inspection readiness throughout the transition; initiates IE, CAPA or equivalent when gaps represent substantial noncompliance to regulatory requirements.
  + Supports site certification readiness (e.g., ISO 13485, MDSAP) and preparation for the post-integration corporate QMS audit.
  + Plans verification of effectiveness of integration activities (e.g., internal or independent QMS audit), drives closure of resulting nonconformances, and authors the IPP closure summary.
  + Captures lessons learned and continuously improves the ZB global QMS integration process, templates and playbook.

*This is not an exhaustive list of duties or functions and might not necessarily comprise all of the essential functions for purposes of the Americans with Disabilities Act.*

**What Makes You Stand Out**
----------------------------

* Expert knowledge of medical device QMS requirements: FDA 21 CFR Part 820, 21 CFR Part 11, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, EU MDR, MDSAP and other global regulations.
* Broad working knowledge of all QMS sub-systems: document and record control, design controls, risk management, CAPA, nonconformance, complaints/MDR, HHE/field actions, supplier controls, process and software validation, calibration, servicing and post-market surveillance.
* Proven program/project management of complex, multi-workstream, cross-functional projects (scope, schedule, budget, resources, risk and change control).
* Experience with M&A integration, site transfers/consolidations, or QMS harmonization and remediation.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise eQMS/PLM applications (e.g., Windchill, EtQ, OpenText, Codebeamer, Greenlight Guru), data migration and computer system validation.
* Strong knowledge of DHF, RMF, DMR and technical documentation content and structure.
* Ability to lead and influence without direct authority and to manage organizational change and cultural transition at acquired sites.
* Excellent executive-level communication, facilitation and status reporting.
* Sound risk-based judgement, problem solving and decision making in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.
* Excellent technical writing skills.
* Proficient with project management and reporting tools (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet, SharePoint, Tableau/Power BI).

**Your Background**
-------------------

* Bachelor's Degree and 5 years of relevant experience, or Associate's Degree and 7 years of relevant experience, or High School Diploma or Equivalent and 9 years of relevant experience required.
* B.S. in Engineering, Life Sciences or related field preferred.
* Advanced degree (M.S./MBA) preferred.
* 10+ years in medical device Quality / Quality Systems or equivalent experience, including 5+ years leading cross-functional projects highly preferred.
* Experience leading QMS integration, harmonization or remediation for acquisitions, site transfers or eQMS/PLM implementations strongly preferred.
* PMP or equivalent project management certification preferred.
* ASQ CQA, CQE or CMQ/OE, or ISO 13485 / MDSAP Lead Auditor certification preferred.
* Lean / Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt preferred.
* Experience with SiMD/SaMD, robotics or capital equipment preferred.

**Travel Expectations**
-----------------------

* Up to 30% (domestic and international travel to acquired sites and ZB locations)

**Expected Compensation Range**
-------------------------------

$128,000 - $160,000 USD Annually

### **Job Description:**

Shield AI is actively seeking candidates with deep expertise in manufacturing and quality methodologies, paired with a relentless drive to enable supplier success and strengthen mission-critical operations.

Shield AI’s Supply Chain Quality team is responsible for global quality oversight across our supplier base. The team reduces supply-chain risk through supplier assessments and internal risk reviews, proactively drives supplier qualification and development activities.

In this role, you will lead a supplier quality team responsible for supplier qualification, development, performance management, and quality assurance across Shield AI’s aerospace and defense supply base. You will set supplier-quality priorities; manage team capacity, technical execution, and resource allocation; and develop high-performing quality leaders. The role also oversees supplier audits, nonconformance resolution, root-cause investigations, and hands on hardware dispositions.

You will evaluate supplier capability, quality performance, organizational risk, and resource needs to ensure purchased hardware and materials meet Shield AI engineering, customer, regulatory, and quality requirements. As an experienced aerospace quality leader, you will partner closely with Supply Chain, Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, and Program teams to resolve complex supplier-quality issues, improve supplier capability, and reduce quality and delivery risk across the supply base.

* Develop the supplier quality team responsible for supplier qualification, surveillance, performance management, and corrective-action activities across Shield AI’s global aerospace and defense supply base.

* Develop Supplier Quality leaders and engineering personnel through coaching, performance management, succession planning, workforce development, and technical mentorship.
* Oversee supplier qualification, risk assessments, periodic performance reviews, supplier audits, source inspections, and approved-supplier status across complex aerospace hardware, commodities, and manufacturing processes.
* Ensure supplier requirements are effectively flowed down and that suppliers comply with applicable quality management system, engineering, customer, contractual, regulatory, and statutory requirements.
* Escalate significant supplier-quality risks and direct SCARs, supplier recovery efforts, and capability-improvement plans that could affect product quality, delivery, mission readiness, or program execution.
* Partner with Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, and Program teams to address supplier producibility, design-for-manufacturability, process capability, technical execution, and quality risks.
* Advance supplier-quality processes, business systems, data analytics, and continuous-improvement practices that strengthen supplier capability, product quality, delivery performance, and supply-base resilience.

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or another related technical discipline.

* Demonstrated proficiency in root-cause analysis and structured problem-solving methods, including 8D, 5 Whys, and fishbone analysis.

As a global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the lives of patients with serious and rare diseases, you’ll be part of a community that prioritizes the human experience, celebrates curiosity, and values every person’s contributions to meaningful progress. That commitment has earned us recognition from leading workplace and culture organizations, including Science's Top Employers, Great Place To Work® in the U.S., and Fortune's Best Workplaces in BioPharma.

  
  

For patients, for each other, and for the future of science, we’re in. Are you?

  
  

**About the Role:**

Reporting to a Director of Clinical Quality Assurance, the Sr. Manager of Clinical Quality Assurance serves as a Development QA (DevQA) representative on the development team assuring quality and regulatory compliance related to GCPs and other related activities performed by Clinical Study (Trial) Teams. You will provide support and promote collaboration internally and externally to ensure all systems, processes and their outcomes comply with applicable international and national standards, regulations, and guidelines.

**What You'll Do:**

In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to Serve and maintain qualification as a GCP Subject Matter Expert (SME) as well as contribute to and support the maintenance of a risk-based and scientific-based quality system to support GCP. You’ll also:

  

* Ensure that a strategic audit plan is implemented and activities are conducted and reported according to SOPs and regulations.
* Perform audits of investigator sites, TMFs, vendors, and internal systems/processes.
* Support the evaluation and acceptability of clinical vendors/suppliers.
* Support strategic direction with cross functional working groups to identify and mitigate GCP quality and compliance issues.
* Establish and foster compliance with ICH E6 Guideline for Good Clinical Practice.
* Provide support and coaching to other staff members to develop additional quality and auditing resources.
* Manage quality documentation in Veeva QMS.
* Act as company’s representative during regulatory agency inspections.

**Who You Are:**

Basic Qualifications

You meet the following minimum education and experience requirements:

* BA/BS degree in Biology or Chemistry or related life sciences discipline along with a minimum of 5 years of GCP experience.
  

Preferred Qualifications

In addition to meeting the basic qualifications above, you will also possess some or all of the following:

* An understanding and practical working knowledge of clinical regulations, good clinical practices, development processes, and regulatory inspection procedures.
* Experience in developing SOPs, reviewing internal clinical, regulatory, and medical processes to ensure they are consistent with current regulatory and GCP requirements.
* GCP audit experience with the ability to conduct external audits of investigator sites, CROs, supporting laboratories, and monitoring organizations with responsibility for writing audit reports and reviewing and tracking CAPAs.
* Ability to conduct external audits of investigator sites, CROs, supporting laboratories, and monitoring organizations with responsibility for writing audit reports and reviewing and tracking CAPAs.
* Experience in supporting regulatory agency inspections and working with regulators and internal staff to help prepare for inspections.
* Broad knowledge of risk-based quality systems and approaches consistent with ICH E6 for Good Clinical Practice.
* Solid experience with Phases I-IV (particularly Phase III); experience with Regulatory approval, NDAs and MAAs is preferred.
* Ability to foster a collaborative/partnership environment, adapt to other personalities in a respectful manner that is conducive to goal achievement and team. building while maintaining quality and compliance.
* Highly organized with a strong attention to detail, clarity, accuracy, and conciseness.
  

**Where You’ll Work**

This is a fully remote role. It can be performed effectively from anywhere while staying connected to your Insmed team and community. Occasional travel for team meetings or events may be expected.

**Travel Requirements**

This position involves frequent domestic/international travel (up to 25-30%) to support clinical QA including external audits.

records.description:
Site: Newton-Wellesley Hospital

Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.

**Job Summary**

The Sr. Manager in this role will oversee the execution of MGB strategy, processes, and infrastructure for the domains of safety, risk and PFR. This role oversees a team of safety, risk, and PFR specialists to support the implementation of standardization of best practices and a system strategy. This role will collaborate with site leadership to execute long and short-term goals for Risk Management, Patient Safety programs, and Patient and Family Relations.  
  
Does this position require Patient Care?  
No  
  
Essential Functions  

* Support the build out of safety/risk/PFR infrastructure, ensuring standardization in training, processes, and safety responses that are in line with MGB.

  

* Executes the MGB safety plans including those around event analysis, safety event reporting/management/mitigation.

  

* Implement the standardized risk management strategy, policies, and procedures, ensuring that risk management activities both align to and augment our approach to patient safety.

  

* Implement the system-wide safety event reporting system.

  

* Support as needed for system wide safety events such as recalls, shortages, and other events that impact safety.

  

* Understand data provided by the system team and use knowledge of local practices to identify areas of opportunity for improvement of patient safety as well as communicate to the system areas that are at risk.

  

* Execute the MGB quality and clinical compliance strategy within local site ensuring adherence to MGB standardized processes around quality measurement, strategy, prioritized areas, and performance improvement while also providing critical feedback about issues and needs that are arising within local site.

  

* Liase as needed with local site Risk/Safety/PFR leader to create prospective solutions and performance improvement as a result of safety events. Partner with safety team as needed prospectively to create performance improvement in pursuit of harm avoidance.

  

* Senior local site manager responsible for Quality Assurance and Performance Improvement QAPI planning and documentation, and updates as needed for board quality committee/patient care assessment committee.

  

* Serve as the senior local site administrative manager covering compliance activities at local site, ensuring adherence to local site standardized processes around tracer activity, site level preparedness activities, and measuring/monitoring compliance.

  

* Understand data provided by the system team and use knowledge of local practices and culture to identify areas of opportunity for improvement as well as communicate to the system areas which are at risk.

  

* Provides strong bi-directional communication between the system and the site, with accountability for distribution of organization communication (including pertinent data and analytics) from MGB to local site and vice versa.

**Qualifications**

Education Bachelor's Degree Related Field of Study required or Bachelor's Degree Patient Safety Leadership required and Master's Degree Nursing preferred Can this role accept experience in lieu of a degree? No Licenses and Credentials Experience Safety, Risk Management, and patient family relations. 3-5 years required and Leading process improvement and initiatives and managing teams. 3-5 years required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities - Support the build out of safety/risk/PFR infrastructure, ensuring standardization in training, processes, and safety responses that are in line with MGB. - Executes the MGB safety plans including those around event analysis, safety event reporting/management/mitigation. - Implement the standardized risk management strategy, policies, and procedures, ensuring that risk management activities both align to and augment our approach to patient safety. - Implement the system-wide safety event reporting system. - Support as needed for system wide safety events such as recalls, shortages, and other events that impact safety. - Understand data provided by the system team and use knowledge of local practices to identify areas of opportunity for improvement of patient safety as well as communicate to the system areas that are at risk.

records.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form!

In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by *TIME* as a “Best Invention”, *MIT Technology Review* as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and *Fast Company* as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia.

Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing - might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.

**Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.**

**Role Description**
--------------------

Form Energy is looking for an experienced Senior Director of Quality to join our battery manufacturing organization. In this role you will lead the Quality department for Form Energy. Your scope will be company-wide and your team will implement systems and processes that ensure products are designed, manufactured and shipped to the highest levels of performance, reliability, and quality.

This role is for an executive leader with experience developing new technologies and bringing high-volume manufacturing facilities to life. You will provide vision, strategy and leadership to help Form achieve manufacturing scale, cost-reduction, and daily operation execution.

As the key driver for shipping the highest quality products, you will thrive when working closely with leadership and cross-functional teams throughout the product development lifecycle, from early R&D to validation testing, pilot builds, and ultimately commercial production of customer-facing products.

*Relocation assistance is available.*

### **What you'll do:**

* Develop and sustain a world-class quality management system powered by a highly-trained, flexible, and proactive staff
* Maintain product risk profiles and manage quality systems to ensure Form Energy is meeting or exceeding risk expectations
* Ensure Form Energy production operations are releasing only conforming products to our customers
* Communicate key risks and opportunities to leadership and provide direction to resolve top issues and drive definitive corrective action
* Plan and efficiently manage Quality resources (labor, OpEx, and CapEx) and report on department performance and needs
* Communicate Form Energy's commitment to quality with internal and external interested parties
* Drive a customer-focused culture anchored by strong individual ownership and accountability

### **What you'll bring:**

* At least 10 years experience in quality, manufacturing, or manufacturing engineering
* At least 5 years in a senior-leader / site-leader quality role, demonstrating a clear record of success in building industry-leading teams that can execute in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
* Expertise in building Quality Management Systems (e.g., IATF 16949, ISO9001).
* Highly technical background, with a strong foundation in logical reasoning that allows for a steep learning curve and the ability to adapt to new technologies
* Excellent leadership, project management, communication, and organizational skills
* Bachelor’s Degree (or higher) in Engineering

### **Where you'll work:**

This role is based at Form Factory 1 in Weirton, WV—an easy commute from the city of Pittsburgh, PA. This 550,000-square-foot facility is our hub for high-volume battery production and a leader in the new era of American energy manufacturing. **Relocation assistance is available.**

*#LI-Onsite*

*Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here.*

*When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed.*

*To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.*

*If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.*  
  
*Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will* ***never*** *solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.*

**What to Expect**

The Staff Manufacturing Engineer, GA position, reporting to General Assembly Manufacturing Engineering Manager, is located at our Fremont Factory location. The primary responsibility of this role is to lead, support, and manage introductions of new manufacturing equipment and processes as well as continuous improvement of existing equipment in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. This person will drive the implementation of new projects, production lines and product changes. The successful candidate is a self-starter, has strong engineering skills and leadership capabilities, and can manage a small group of engineers to execute multiple projects and priorities at the same time. This role requires working closely with Design Engineering, NPI, Quality, Production, Purchasing, Industrial Engineering, external Line builders, and other departments to take vehicle design changes and new vehicle designs from initial concept through prototype development and into full production, and to transform and adapt existing manufacturing equipment to changing requirements and conditions.

  
**What You'll Do**

* Build and lead a project team of engineers to execute a diverse roadmap of projects including new product introductions and business directives such as capacity increase and cost reduction
* Facilitate performance management, resource allocation, and engineering skill development with manager. Including performance reviews, growth, and development
* Design, procure, and fully commission equipment, specifically: stakeholder buy-in, RFQ, vendor selection, decision analysis, project workflow approvals, installation, and commissioning
* Ensure thorough and proper equipment validation and production startup through FAT, SAT, OEE, availability, complete technical documentation, and transfer of ownership success criteria
* Provide detailed assessments and critical Design For Manufacture (DFM) reviews of Product, Process and Tooling designs
* While executing projects objectively define and achieve OEE, throughput, and cycle time
* Lead all GA engineering groups both internal and external with tooling design and reviews
* Study technologies to expert-level of understanding, utilizing internal & external technical resources to fully understand, teach and lead new / newly implemented technologies
* Develop business cases and ROI studies, and communicate project justification to senior leadership
* Provide technical support, leadership, and training to engineers and cross departmental teams

  
**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or equivalent certification, or proven equivalent experience
* 8+ years of proven experience designing, implementing, and optimizing complex manual and automated manufacturing equipment & processes, preferably in the automotive industry
* Work independently with concepts and documentation from prototype to sustaining activities
* Familiarity with assembly processes, technologies, and platforms, their capabilities, and limitations
* Extensive Proficiency with 3D and 2D CAD platforms
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, and proven interpersonal skills and ability to objectively resolve conflict within a large group
* Able to work flexible hours and schedules as required

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight!

This role is part of Blue Origin Operations, which is comprised of Integrated Supply Chain, Test Operations, Safety, Quality, and Mission Assurance. This includes Manufacturing and Supply Chain support across all Blue Origin facilities.

We are a team of collaborators, doers, and problem-solvers who are relentlessly dedicated to a culture of safety. This position will directly impact the history of space exploration and will require your dedication and detailed attention towards safe and repeatable space flight! Join us in lowering the cost of access to space and enabling Blue Origin’s vision of millions of people living and working in space to benefit Earth!

  

Be part of the team of experts collaborating and leading overseeing a portfolio of projects to drive manufacturing evolution for Blue’s Engine Factory based out of Huntsville, AL. This role reports through the VP of Manufacturing.
  
  
We are looking for someone to apply their technical expertise, leadership skills, and commitment to quality to positively impact safe human spaceflight. Passion for our mission and vision is required!

  

**Senior Advisor to VP Engine Manufacturing**

As part of a growing, passionate, and accomplished team of experts, you will directly support the senior leader of all Engine manufacturing. This includes a dynamic, large team involved in the development and implementation of art of the possible manufacturing and operations systems to build the road to space.

* Extremely high judgment with high discretion: ability to be exposed to sensitive matters and maintain confidentiality.

**Director, New Product Introduction (NPI) & Product Lifecycle Management (PLM)**

Round Rock, Texas | Onsite | Full-Time

**Reports to:** CFO/CEO

**Works closely with:** Director of Operations/Engineering/R&D, Quality, Purchasing, Production, Program Management and external suppliers

**Travel:** Approximately 25%-35%, primarily to supplier locations

**Role structure:** Hands-on director role; initially an individual contributor leading cross-functional work

**Role Summary**

The Director of NPI & PLM leads the transition of new and modified products from development into stable production. The role coordinates product documentation, supplier readiness, pilot builds, production handoff and lifecycle changes across Ametrine and its manufacturing partners.

This position is focused on practical execution. The Director will work directly with cut-and-sew partners and other suppliers to ensure products can be produced repeatedly at the required quality, capacity and schedule. The role also helps develop alternate sources and contingency plans across fabric, metallization, printing, DWR treatment and cut-and-sew operations.

**Primary Responsibilities**

**New Product Introduction**

* Maintain the NPI schedule for new products, product changes and manufacturing transfers.
* Coordinate requirements, design release, sourcing, prototype builds, pilot production, validation and production handoff.
* Use clear stage gates, owners, due dates and readiness checklists.
* Identify schedule, supplier, material, quality and capacity risks early and drive actions to closure.
* Provide concise status updates covering progress, open decisions, risks and next steps.

**Prototype-to-Production Transfer**

* Work with Engineering and R&D to review designs for manufacturability and production readiness.
* Prepare or coordinate BOMs, routings, work instructions, technical packages, inspection points and packaging requirements.
* Lead prototype, pilot and first-production builds at Ametrine and supplier locations.
* Capture lessons learned and ensure changes are reflected in released documentation.
* Confirm that Operations and suppliers are ready before a product is released to routine production.

**Cut-and-Sew and Supplier Readiness**

* Work onsite with cut-and-sew partners to establish and improve production methods.
* Review patterns, sewing specifications, fixtures, templates, work instructions and inspection requirements.
* Assess supplier labor, equipment, training, floor space, quality controls and available capacity.
* Develop practical ramp plans and verify production rates through actual builds.
* Support supplier training and resolve manufacturability, throughput and quality issues during launch.
* Track supplier actions and escalate missed commitments or unsupported plans.

**Product Lifecycle Management**

* Maintain control of released BOMs, specifications, approved materials, suppliers, routings and product revisions.
* Coordinate engineering changes and assess their impact on inventory, suppliers, schedule, testing and customer requirements.
* Ensure the correct product configuration is used for each order and customer.
* Support PLM process and system improvements, including appropriate integration with ERP/MRP.
* Maintain orderly lifecycle records from product introduction through sustainment and retirement.

**Supply-Chain Resilience**

* Maintain a process-level supply-chain map covering fabric, metallization, printing, DWR, cut and sew, accessories and final delivery.
* Identify bottlenecks, long-lead items, single-source dependencies and supplier-capacity risks.
* Develop and qualify alternate sources where practical.
* Create contingency plans for specialized processes that cannot be economically dual-sourced.
* Coordinate source qualification with Operations, Purchasing, Engineering and Quality.
  

**Quality and Process Control**

* Partner with Quality to define process controls, inspection requirements and first-article expectations.
* Support supplier qualification, process reviews, root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Monitor first-pass yield, defects, rework and launch-related issues.
* Ensure production methods remain consistent with approved documentation and customer requirements.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Lead NPI work through influence across Engineering, Operations, Quality, Purchasing and suppliers.
* Maintain clear owners, deadlines and escalation paths.
* Coordinate with the Director of Operations so new-product timelines and supplier readiness are aligned with the production plan.
* Support communication and coordination between Ametrine Inc. and Ametrine Ltd. where product development activities overlap.

**Success Measures**

* NPI milestones completed on schedule
* Prototype-to-pilot and pilot-to-production cycle time
* Supplier readiness and capacity verification completed before launch
* Percentage of critical supply-chain nodes with an alternate source or documented contingency
* Launch first-pass yield, rework and defect performance
* Completeness and accuracy of BOMs, routings, work instructions and product revisions
* Timely closure of supplier, manufacturing-readiness and lifecycle risks

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, industrial technology, textiles, supply chain or a related field; equivalent directly relevant experience may be considered.
* Eight or more years of relevant experience in NPI, manufacturing engineering, supplier development, PLM, product transfer or contract manufacturing.
* Demonstrated experience moving physical products from prototype through pilot and into production.
* Experience working directly with external manufacturers or suppliers.
* Working knowledge of BOMs, routings, work instructions, engineering changes and configuration control.
* Experience with ERP/MRP and PLM or related product-data systems.
* Strong project planning, follow-through, problem-solving and written communication skills.
* Ability to work onsite in Round Rock and travel approximately 25%-35%.
* U.S. citizenship required due to the defense-related nature of the company’s work.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with technical textiles, sewn products, outdoor equipment, military products, automotive soft goods, medical textiles, inflatables or related manufacturing.
* Experience with cut-and-sew production methods, patterns, line balancing or labor standards.
* Experience with coated, laminated, printed or metallized fabrics.
* Defense, aerospace or government-contract manufacturing experience.
* Experience qualifying secondary suppliers or developing business-continuity plans.
* PMP, Lean Six Sigma, APICS or similar certification.

**Working Style**

* Hands-on and comfortable working at supplier facilities and on production floors
* Organized, practical and attentive to manufacturing details
* Able to communicate effectively with engineers, operators, supplier managers and company leadership
* Persistent in following actions through completion
* Comfortable balancing several product introductions and production issues at the same time
* Focused on building useful processes without unnecessary bureaucracy

records.title: Director, Industrial Engineering
records.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**
------------------

Anduril's Manufacturing Engineering Team is seeking a Director, Industrial Engineering to lead IE strategy and execution for the Air Defense & Strike (AD&S) division. The Manufacturing Team is responsible for rapidly iterating and building cutting-edge defense hardware — including static equipment, moving ground equipment, sensors, undersea, and flight vehicles — and scaling these products across our production footprint, including our new 5M sq ft manufacturing facility, Arsenal-1.

Industrial Engineering at Anduril operates in a matrix with a Center of Excellence (COE) and embedded IEs directly into the divisions they support. Every embedded IE takes day-to-day direction and priorities from their business line, while the central IE organization provides the methodology, standards, tools, mentorship, career development, surge coverage, and cross-divisional visibility that make each individual IE more effective than they could be on their own. The Director, IE — AD&S is the senior IE leader dedicated to one of Anduril's highest-growth, most operationally complex divisions — owning the IE strategy, team, and results for AD&S and operating as a peer member of the division's production leadership team.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
------------------

As the Director, Industrial Engineering — AD&S, you will own the industrial engineering function for the Air Defense & Strike division end-to-end. You will build, lead, and develop the IE team embedded in AD&S — hiring the right people, designing the team structure, and setting the IE agenda in lockstep with the division's production strategy and ramp trajectory and COE standards and enterprise vision / system. You report to the Director of Industrial Engineering (central IE CoE) and sit as a peer alongside AD&S production leadership, connected to the VP of Production, Director of Manufacturing Engineering, and Program Directors who shape division priorities.

This is a division-level leadership role with enterprise accountability. You are not inheriting a mature, steady-state operation — AD&S is in active ramp across multiple product lines, standing up new production systems, scaling from prototype through low-rate into full-rate production, and doing so at a pace that demands IE leadership who can build the plane while flying it. You will define what IE looks like for AD&S: which capabilities to stand up first, how to staff and structure the team, where to invest in labor standards, layouts, simulation, and capacity planning, and how IE integrates into the division's NPI and production ramp cadence.

You will translate company-wide IE standards and the Manufacturing Development Plan (MDP) into AD&S-specific execution — adapting central methodology to the division's unique product mix, production maturity, and operational tempo while maintaining consistency with enterprise IE standards and Core 4 reporting. You are accountable for IE outcomes across the division: labor standards coverage, layout quality, line balance efficiency, capacity model accuracy, and the measurable impact of IE on AD&S production performance.

The right person for this role is a seasoned IE or manufacturing engineering leader who thrives in start-up and ramp environments — someone who has built teams from scratch, stood up production systems, and driven measurable operational impact in fast-moving, complex manufacturing. You have deep technical credibility in IE fundamentals but lead through strategy and people: setting vision, building organizational capability, and creating the systems that let a growing team deliver at scale. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, making decisions with incomplete information, and operating at the intersection of divisional execution and enterprise IE strategy. You communicate with clarity and conviction to senior leadership and are energized by the challenge of building something new in a high-stakes environment.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

**Divisional IE Strategy and Execution**

* Own the IE strategy for AD&S — defining the roadmap, capability priorities, and investment plan aligned to the division's ramp trajectory, NPI pipeline, and business objectives.
* Translate company-wide IE standards and the MDP process into AD&S-specific execution — ensuring IE deliverables (labor standards, layouts, line balances, capacity models) are completed at the right maturity gates and integrated into division planning.
* Drive Core 4 metrics performance (labor hours per unit, line balance efficiency, throughput, units per square foot) — setting targets, tracking results, and ensuring IE work moves the numbers that matter to AD&S. IE provides the roadmap to scale.
* Serve as the primary IE interface to AD&S leadership for capacity questions, ramp feasibility, layout approvals, make-vs-buy analysis, and production system design. Connect AD&S needs to central IE capabilities and enterprise resources.

**Team Building and Leadership**

* Build the AD&S IE team into a high-performing, right-sized organization — designing the structure, defining roles, leading hiring, and onboarding IEs, IE Leads, and IE Technicians aligned to the division's product lines and production stages.
* Directly manage the embedded IE team — setting expectations, driving accountability, conducting performance reviews, and investing in the growth and career development of every team member. Own the headcount plan and budget.
* Develop high-potential talent, build succession depth, and ensure every IE is proficient in core methodology (time studies, MODAPTS/MTM, line balancing, layout design, capacity modeling, Core 4 measurement).

**Production System Design and NPI**

* Lead IE involvement in production line stand-ups and NPI ramps — from process characterization and layout design through labor standards development, line balancing, rate-readiness validation, and system optimization.
* Own production line and workstation layout design — cell configurations, material flow, equipment placement, and spatial planning for both low-rate and full-rate production using simulation-backed approaches.
* Drive capacity planning and production modeling — ensuring AD&S has accurate capacity models, proactively identifying bottlenecks and constraints, and supporting capital investment decisions with IE analysis.

**Cross-Functional Partnership and Communication**

* Operate as a peer member of the AD&S production leadership team — shaping production strategy, influencing capital and staffing decisions, and representing IE in all forums where production decisions are made.
* Build strong working relationships across Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Program Management, and Facilities. Represent AD&S IE in cross-divisional forums, bringing enterprise best practices back to the division.
* Be present on the floor. Walk the lines, build credibility with operators and supervisors, and model the Gemba-first, data-driven culture the IE team stands for. Communicate IE impact to senior leadership with clarity and conviction.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Systems Engineering, Operations Research, or a related field.
* 12+ years of experience in industrial engineering, manufacturing engineering, or production operations, with demonstrated depth across multiple IE disciplines (labor standards, layout design, capacity planning, simulation).
* 5+ years managing industrial engineers or manufacturing engineers, including experience managing managers or leads — with demonstrated hiring, org design, and team-building experience.
* Experience building or scaling an IE team in a ramp or start-up production environment — designing team structure, hiring into it, and standing up capabilities from early stages.
* Deep technical credibility in core IE fundamentals: time studies, labor standards (MTM/MODAPTS), line balancing, layout design, capacity planning, and production system design.
* Experience operating as a peer of production leadership — influencing strategy, owning budgets and headcount, and communicating IE impact to VP-level audiences.
* Track record of driving measurable operational improvement — IE initiatives that moved production metrics and can be quantified.
* Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export-controlled information or facilities.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Operations Research, MBA, or a related field.
* Experience in defense, aerospace, or other highly regulated, high-mix manufacturing environments with complex compliance and traceability requirements.
* Experience standing up a centralized or embedded IE function from scratch — methodology selection, standards development, tooling, and organizational adoption.
* Proficiency in simulation software (FlexSim, Arena, AnyLogic, or equivalent), data analytics/visualization (Power BI, Tableau), or experience integrating IE deliverables with MES/ERP platforms.
* Experience designing and commissioning new production lines or manufacturing facilities.
* Active security clearance, or ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret security clearance.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

  

### **Benefits**

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  

### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers.   + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
* **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
* **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

### **Data Privacy**

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

  

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. **About Carrier**

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.

**About the Job**
-----------------

The Senior Manager, LCML Fulfillment Operations leads the end-to-end order fulfillment and distribution execution operating model for Carrier's Light Commercial (LCML) HVAC business within Climate Solutions Americas (CSA). Reporting to CSA Logistics & Supply Chain leadership, this role balances customer service reliability, on-time in-full (OTIF) delivery performance, inventory allocation governance, and fulfillment cost-to-serve productivity across North America.

This leader directs a team of fulfillment operations planners, order management specialists, and execution coordinators, steering initiatives in order backlog reduction, multi-site distribution throughput, order consolidation, and peak seasonal readiness. Working collaboratively with Light Commercial SIOP, Manufacturing Operations, Distribution Center (DC) Operations, Transportation, and Commercial Sales leadership, the Senior Manager establishes fulfillment KPIs and SLAs, enhances ERP/WMS/TMS data integrity, and champions continuous improvement across the order-to-delivery ecosystem.

**Work Arrangement:** Hybrid: 3 days in office at the Atlanta Digital Hub, 2 days remote per week.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Fulfillment Execution & Planning Governance:** Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of fulfillment planners and execution coordinators managing day-to-day order allocation, scheduling, and customer delivery execution across North American distribution networks.
* **Network Throughput & Cost-to-Serve Productivity:** Drive order consolidation programs, warehouse/fulfillment cycle-time reductions, avoidable expedite elimination, and measurable cost-to-serve efficiencies across LCML distribution hubs.
* **Order Backlog & SLA Performance Management:** Own fulfillment scorecard reviews, OTIF delivery metrics, order-to-ship cycle times, and aged backlog governance. Partner with DC Operations and Transportation to optimize fulfillment capacity and SLA compliance.
* **Exception Management & Disruption Recovery:** Lead proactive operational recovery for critical customer delivery delays, inventory allocation constraints, capacity crunches, and seasonal demand surges.
* **Cross-Functional Alignment:** Partner strategically with Light Commercial SIOP, Manufacturing Plants, Customer Service, and Commercial Sales leadership to align inventory positioning, product launch (NPI) fulfillment readiness, and customer lead-time commitments.
* **Digital Fulfillment & Systems Enhancement:** Enhance ERP, WMS, and TMS workflow standardization, end-to-end order visibility, automated milestone tracking, and digital executive KPI dashboards.
* **Continuous Improvement & Standard Work:** Implement standardized operating procedures (SOPs), daily tier accountability cadences, and root-cause problem solving (Lean, DMAIC, 5-Why) to sustain fulfillment gains and customer satisfaction.

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations, Industrial Engineering, or a business discipline.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in fulfillment operations, order management, distribution center operations, or domestic supply chain logistics.

* 2+ years of hands-on experience with Enterprise ERP, Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), or Transportation Management Systems (TMS) such as SAP, Oracle, Blue Yonder/JDA, or Manhattan.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, or Master of Business Administration (MBA).
* Professional supply chain or continuous improvement credentials such as APICS (CSCP, CPIM, CLTD) or Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt.
* Background in commercial/light commercial HVAC, industrial equipment manufacturing, or high-SKU seasonal distribution environments.

records.description:
**Optum Insight** is improving the flow of health data and information to create a more connected system. We remove friction and drive alignment between care providers and payers, and ultimately consumers. Our deep expertise in the industry and innovative technology empower us to help organizations reduce costs while improving risk management, quality and revenue growth. Ready to help us deliver results that improve lives? Join us in making healthcare work better for everyone through people-led, responsible AI while **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Senior Director, Back Operations - Collections is the senior operational leader responsible for domestic hospital and professional collections performance across assigned client portfolios. This role directly leads the domestic collections organization and is accountable for cash acceleration, accounts receivable resolution, aging and inventory reduction, productivity, quality, workforce effectiveness, and achievement of client and operational commitments.

The Senior Director works closely with offshore/global delivery leadership to coordinate collections activities across domestic and global operations, including alignment of work allocation, performance expectations, quality standards, escalation pathways, and reporting.

In addition to direct responsibility for domestic collections, this position provides strategic and operational oversight across the broader back-end revenue cycle, including billing, global collections, denial management, and cash posting. These functions do not report directly to this position. The Senior Director is responsible for ensuring strong cross-functional coordination, identifying dependencies and barriers, facilitating resolution of issues impacting collections performance, and promoting accountability for overall back-end revenue cycle outcomes.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely \* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges. For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Domestic Collections Leadership and Performance
  + Provide direct leadership and accountability for domestic collections operations across hospital and professional accounts receivable portfolios
  + Lead a large, distributed organization through directors, managers, supervisors, and frontline collections teams
  + Own domestic collections performance related to cash, days in A/R, aging, inventory reduction, productivity, quality, cost to collect, service levels, and client commitments
  + Establish priorities for collections activities based on payer, aging, balance, account complexity, recovery opportunity, and client requirements
  + Ensure appropriate allocation of staffing and resources to maximize cash recovery and reduce unresolved A/R
  + Maintain disciplined management of aged, high-dollar, complex, and escalated inventories, including underpayments, stalled claims, administrative denials, payer escalations, and accounts requiring cross-functional intervention
  + Hold operational leaders accountable for established performance expectations and lead corrective action and performance recovery when results fall below targeted levels
* Global Collections Partnership
  + Partner closely with offshore/global collections leadership to align domestic and global collections activities
  + Establish consistent expectations for work allocation, work queues, productivity, quality, documentation, escalation, and performance reporting
  + Align domestic and global work based on account complexity, payer requirements, system access, client commitments, resource capabilities, and automation opportunities
  + Identify and resolve gaps in ownership, handoffs, and accountability that may impede collections performance
  + Maintain effective operating rhythms with global leadership to ensure visibility into performance, capacity, risks, and emerging client needs
* Back Operations Oversight and Integration
  + Provide strategic and operational oversight across billing, global collections, denial management, and cash posting, while maintaining direct leadership accountability for domestic collections
  + Partner with functional leaders to monitor performance, identify risks and dependencies, and address issues that may affect cash flow, aging, collections, or client commitments
  + Facilitate cross-functional resolution of issues involving billing delays, claim defects, denials, payment posting, payer behavior, system access, or workflow breakdowns
  + Establish clear mechanisms for escalating significant performance or operational barriers and monitoring remediation through resolution
  + Promote effective integration across back-end revenue cycle functions and appropriate accountability for end-to-end outcomes
  + Identify recurring operational issues and partner with appropriate revenue cycle leaders to address upstream and downstream root causes
* Performance Management and Analytics
  + Establish and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly operating rhythms, including performance reviews, dashboards, scorecards, forecasts, and corrective action plans
  + Monitor and manage key revenue cycle performance indicators, including cash collections, days in A/R, aging, inventory, productivity, quality, denial trends, cost to collect, staffing, and forecast performance
  + Analyze results by client, payer, account type, aging category, work queue, team, and other relevant dimensions to identify trends, risks, and opportunities
  + Establish transparent capacity and workforce plans that connect inventory, expected cash, productivity, staffing, training, attrition, and global delivery assumptions
  + Use data to distinguish performance issues driven by capacity from those caused by process, technology, payer behavior, access limitations, or upstream revenue cycle issues
  + Translate operational data into clear actions, priorities, and performance improvement plans
* Operational Excellence, Technology and Continuous Improvement
  + Identify opportunities to standardize and improve collections workflows, work queues, payer strategies, account segmentation, documentation practices, escalation processes, and operating procedures
  + Partner with Product, Technology, Analytics, and Automation teams to identify and prioritize opportunities to improve collections efficiency and effectiveness
  + Sponsor workflow redesign and automation initiatives that reduce manual activity, improve work prioritization, accelerate account resolution, and strengthen quality
  + Support appropriate adoption of analytics, predictive capabilities, automation, and AI-enabled tools within collections operations
  + Establish appropriate human review, exception handling, quality validation, and operational controls for automated processes
  + Identify recurring collections and denial root causes and partner with the appropriate operational leaders to address issues affecting revenue realization
* Client, Payer and Executive Leadership
  + Serve as the senior operational leader for domestic collections in discussions with client revenue cycle executives, internal executive leadership, and other key stakeholders
  + Lead client performance discussions, operational reviews, remediation planning, and executive escalations related to collections performance
  + Communicate operational performance, risks, root causes, corrective actions, and expected recovery timelines clearly and effectively
  + Coordinate payer escalation strategies when payer behavior contributes to significant payment delays, denials, underpayments, or administrative burden
  + Support new client transitions, expansions, and other operational initiatives involving collections or back-end revenue cycle capabilities
  + Partner across Finance, Client Management, Sales, Technology, Product, Human Capital, Compliance, and other operational functions to achieve client and organizational objectives
* People Leadership and Workforce Development
  + Build, develop, and retain a strong domestic collections leadership team, including directors, managers, supervisors, and emerging leaders
  + Oversee recruiting, selection, onboarding, training, coaching, performance management, succession planning, and retention strategies
  + Establish appropriate spans of control, role expectations, career pathways, and capability requirements based on operational complexity
  + Ensure leaders consistently communicate performance expectations, provide meaningful coaching and feedback, recognize strong performance, and address performance gaps in a timely manner
  + Foster a collaborative, inclusive, accountable, and performance-oriented culture across domestic teams and in partnership with global operations
  + Partner with Human Capital and other stakeholders on workforce planning, organizational change, employee relations, and other personnel matters
* Risk, Compliance and Operational Controls
  + Ensure collections activities comply with applicable federal and state requirements, payer requirements, contractual obligations, client policies, privacy requirements, and company controls
  + Maintain appropriate controls related to account handling, documentation, system access, quality, escalation, and other revenue cycle processes
  + Identify operational and compliance risks and ensure appropriate escalation and remediation
  + Partner with Compliance, Legal, Human Capital, and client leadership as appropriate to address identified risks

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of progressive healthcare revenue cycle experience
* 5+ years of experience in a leadership role with responsibility for operational performance
* 5+ years of experience leading accounts receivable follow-up and collections operations within a complex hospital, health system, physician, or outsourced revenue cycle environment
* 5+ years of experience leading large, geographically distributed teams through multiple levels of management
* 5+ years of experience managing operational performance using cash, A/R, aging, inventory, productivity, quality, staffing, and other key revenue cycle measures
* 5+ years of experience leading operational improvement, standardization, transformation, or performance recovery initiatives
* 5+ years of experience partnering with senior executives, clients, operational leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders
* 3+ years of experience working across domestic and offshore/global delivery environments

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience across both hospital/facility and professional revenue cycle operations
* 5+ years of experience leading complex, multi-client, or large health system revenue cycle operations
* 3+ years of experience working with Epic and/or other major EHR and patient accounting platforms
* 3+ years of experience leveraging workflow technology, analytics, automation, or AI-enabled capabilities to improve revenue cycle performance

* All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $159,300 - $273,200 annually based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

**Application Deadline**: This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and help make the health system work better for everyone. Together, we are shaping the future of healthcare by harnessing technology and innovation to make care simpler to navigate, more affordable and more connected for the people we serve. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcomed, valued, heard and respected, empowering people to bring their authentic selves to work and strengthening our collective impact through diverse talents, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.*

*UnitedHealth Group and its affiliated brands are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer under applicable law and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, religion, age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or federal laws, rules, or regulations.*

*UnitedHealth Group and its affiliated brands are a drug-free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment.*
