records.title: Senior Director, Strategy & Operations, Point of Care, Remote
records.description:
Working in the Office of the Chief Medical Officer and reporting to the VP of Point of Care & Risk Stratification, the Senior Director of Strategy & Operations, Point of Care, will lead day-to-day operations, partnerships, go-to-market efforts, and wraparound support services to maximize the impact of Aledade’s value-based care insights to our partner practices.

The team is looking for a high-output generalist with a strong business analyst toolkit, looking to rapidly take ownership of complex content with high visibility, working across multiple stakeholders. Candidates that thrive managing multiple deadlines on tight timelines and learning content quickly are best positioned to succeed; successful team members in the same function primarily have backgrounds in consulting and generalist healthcare strategy & operations roles.

To start, the role will focus on 1) scaling the deployment of our point of care tools and 2) broadening and deepening the insights available in our point of care tools, to maximize the impact of Aledade’s insights on our patients’ health outcomes and partner practices’ success in their value-based care contracts.

At the end of their first year, a successful leader in the role will own end-to-end accountability for 1) proactive identification, development, and execution of Point of Care deployment improvement opportunities, including field, practice, and clinician education, deployment automation and monitoring, and go to market approach and materials, 2) strategic relationship building and partnership with Aledade’s payer partners to advance point of care tool adoption and impact, 3) goal setting, metric identification and development, and impact evaluation for our point of care tools, 4) identification, evaluation, contracting, and cross-functional execution of net new vendor and external partnerships that support insight delivery and impact.

Additionally, this role will 1) provide direction and expert guidance to junior team members owning individual initiatives, including incentive and adoption programs, educational efforts, hotspotting, monitoring, and alerting development, practice and user-level prioritization and triage, and 2) coordinate with cross-functional product, analytics, technology, performance, care programs, and other senior leaders across Aledade to advance point of care tool adoption and impact.

The role is expected to start as a senior individual contributor, but is expected to grow into a people manager in the near term.

### **Primary Duties:**

In collaboration with cross-functional product, analytics, technology, performance, care programs, and other senior leaders across Aledade:

* Own single-threaded accountability for proactive identification, development, and execution of Point of Care deployment improvement opportunities, including field, practice, and clinician education, deployment automation and monitoring, and go to market approach and materials

* Lead strategic relationship building and partnership with Aledade’s payer partners to advance point of care tool adoption and impact

* Drive goal setting, metric identification and development, and impact evaluation for our point of care tools

* In support of maximizing insight delivery and impact, lead the evaluation, contracting, and cross-functional execution of net new vendor and external partnerships

* Direct and support other Transformation team members’ ideation and execution of strategic initiatives related to point of care deployment and impact

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree required, preferably in Economics, Business, Healthcare, or a related field
* 12+ years of progressive professional experience, or 7+ years progressive professional experience with a Master’s Degree, strongly preferred
* 6+ years of experience in healthcare
* 2+ years of experience in value-based care

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Advanced exploration of emerging AI tools, with additional preference given to individuals that have demonstrated ability building, scaling, and/or teaching AI tooling to broader teams
* Expert Excel skills required, including the ability to work with large, complex, & often incomplete data sets; conduct one-off complex analyses quickly; and utilize Index / Match, XLOOKUP, FILTER, and other advanced formulas
* Advanced PPT skills required, including storyboarding skills, ability to translate complex analyses and concepts into engaging slides, and ability to draft executive-level materials with limited direction
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, as well as the ability to build strong relationships and work with individuals at all levels of the organization, tailoring communication style as appropriate based on audience
* Excellent project management skills, including proven track record leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in health care operations settings
* Strong strategic planning and analytical skills
* Strong “business analyst” toolkit, including abilities to independently prioritize, solve problems via hypothesis-driven analytical methods, manage across multiple responsibilities and projects, execute with attention to detail, and overcome ambiguity
* Poise, confidence, and maturity interacting with key stakeholders, including senior leaders
* Commitment to confidentiality and discretion in appropriately handling sensitive information is required

### **Physical Requirements:**

Sitting for prolonged periods of time. Extensive use of computers and keyboard. Occasional walking and lifting may be required.

**Who We Are:**

Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.

**What Does This Mean for You?**

At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.

In addition to time off to support work-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well-being of our team members:

Flexible work schedules and the ability to work remotely are available for many roles

Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners

Robust time-off plan (21 days of PTO in your first year)

Two paid volunteer days and 11 paid holidays

12 weeks paid parental leave for all new parents

Six weeks paid sabbatical after six years of service

Educational Assistant Program and Clinical Employee Reimbursement Program

401(k) with up to 4% match

Stock options

And much more!

*At Aledade PBC, we don’t just accept differences, we celebrate them! We strive to attract, develop and retain highly qualified individuals representing the diverse communities where we live and work. Aledade is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Employment policies and decisions at Aledade are based on merit, qualifications, performance and business needs. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth or medical conditions related to pregnancy or childbirth), gender identity or expression, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or sexual orientation.*

  

We may use automated tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to help organize and evaluate application materials. These tools support our recruiters and hiring managers by helping manage large applicant pools. Human judgment plays an essential role in our hiring process, including in the oversight and use of any automated tools. If you would like more information about our screening and hiring process, please contact us. Our Commitment to Authenticity. We use Endorsed, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by Aledade PBC using Lever, a cloud services provider located in the United States. Lever is engaged by Aledade PBC to help manage its recruitment and hiring processes. For more information about how your personal data will be processed by Aledade PBC and any rights you may have, please review Aledade PBC’s Candidate Privacy Notice. By applying for this job, you agree to Aledade's Applicant Privacy Policy available at https://www.aledade.com/privacy-policy-applicants If you have any questions about our privacy practices, please contact privacy@aledade.com.

records.description:
**Description**

**Job Overview:**

The Director of Operations provides leadership and oversight for vertical initiatives that enhance operational performance, strengthen community management services, and ensure alignment with evolving legislative and industry requirements. This role serves as the primary expert for change‑management, acting as the central point of accountability for new initiatives, implementation timelines, communication strategies, and reporting outcomes.

Working in close partnership with market leaders and cross‑functional departments, the Director evaluates, tests, and deploys operational improvements that drive efficiency and elevate service delivery. The role also collaborates extensively with Operations leadership across Master Planned Vertical to share best practices, execute strategic initiatives, and support scalable, high‑impact operational enhancements. The Director operates under the direction of the President, Master Planned Communities.

**Your Responsibilities:**

**Strategic Leadership & Change Management**

* Provide market oversight for process improvement initiatives, including operational enhancements, legislative implementation, regional, and national program cascades.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and organizational gatekeeper for all change‑management activities, ensuring disciplined execution and alignment with regional and enterprise priorities.
* Own accountability for initiative timelines, implementation plans, communication strategies, and reporting deliverables, including ongoing user acceptance and adoption.

**Operational Excellence & Efficiency**

* Lead the assessment, vetting, testing, and rollout of operational improvements in partnership with market leaders and internal stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities to refine or redesign existing programs, procedures, and workflows to enhance efficiency and service quality.
* Drive continuous improvement across core community management operations through data‑driven analysis and cross‑functional collaboration.
* Leads compliance within the market with retention programs; NPS, Watchlist, Board Orientation.

**Cross‑Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with internal departments—including Training, HR, Accounting, Legal, region operations, and Technology—to ensure seamless implementation of operational changes.
* Act as a senior liaison between community management and support departments, ensuring alignment, transparency, and effective communication.
* Facilitate knowledge‑sharing and best‑practice adoption across Hi-rise North markets.

**Regional & Enterprise Engagement**

* Collaborate with Operations leaders on region and national initiatives and create scalable efficiencies.
* Support enterprise‑level initiatives and programs by participating in committees, governance groups, and project teams as requested, i.e. NPS.
* Ensure regional alignment with corporate standards, programs, and strategic priorities. Collaborates with regional operations and Directions (peers) on best practices, process improvement, and standardization across the region, reducing redundancy.

**Reporting & Communication**

* Develop and deliver clear, comprehensive reports on initiative progress, operational integration, and service‑level performance.
* Communicate complex operational changes in a clear, objective, and strategic manner to leadership and cross‑functional partners.
* Maintain a forward‑looking understanding of industry trends, legislative developments, and emerging best practices.
* Consistently uphold the values of the organization and provide the highest level of customer service to internal clients.
* Consistent, motivating, thoughtful leadership style to lead others.
* Must be able to attend and actively participate in night meetings as required.
* Occasional attendance at board meetings.
* Perform any range of special projects, tasks and other related duties as assigned.
* Champion the use of internal and external programs and software to support all roles.
* Other duties may be required.

**Skills & Qualifications:**

* Excellent customer service and relationship-building background/skills (internal and external).
* Demonstrated success leading cross‑functional initiatives and driving organizational change.
* Proven ability to influence without direct authority and collaborate across multiple markets.
* Ability to effectively strategize with the overall vision of the organization in mind.
* Ability to work under tight deadlines and consistently meet deadlines.
* Demonstrates effective communication skills consisting of oral, written, and listening.

* Demonstrates problem-solving and solving abilities.
* Ability to draft correspondence and respond to inquiries effectively and independently.
* Ability to read and understand financial statements and budgets.
* Must be proficient with computer programs needed for specific positions including Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.
* Demonstrates organizational skills and time management abilities while working in a fast-paced, multitasking environment.
* Must work effectively with co-workers, customers, and others by sharing ideas in a constructive and positive manner; listening to and objectively considering ideas and suggestions from others; keeping commitments; keeping others informed of work progress, timetables, and issues; addressing problems and issues constructively to find mutually acceptable and practical business solutions; addressing others by name, title, or other respectful identifiers, and; respecting the diversity of our workforce in actions, words, and deeds.

**Physical Requirements:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an associate to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

This position works under usual office conditions. The employee is required to work at a personal computer as well as be on the phone for extended periods of time. Must be able to stand, sit and walk. The incumbent must be able to work extended and flexible hours and weekends as needed. Physical demands include ability to lift up to 10 lbs.

**What We Offer:**

As a full-time associate, you will be eligible for full comprehensive benefits to include your choice of multiple medical plans, dental, and Vision. In addition, you will be eligible for time off benefits, paid holidays, and a 401k with company match. Occasional travel may be required to attend training and other company functions.

**Compensation:** $90,000-$110,000 annually; paid bi-weekly

**Job Summary**
---------------

**Fresh & Ready Foods** is seeking a strategic and hands-on **Operations Director** to lead our Lenexa, KS manufacturing facility. As the site leader, this role is responsible for overseeing all aspects of production, food safety, quality, maintenance, warehousing, and distribution while driving operational excellence and developing high-performing teams.

Reporting to the Regional Director, the Operations Director will be accountable for achieving safety, quality, service, inventory, and financial objectives while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and employee engagement. This highly visible leadership role requires a strong manufacturing background, a passion for people development, and the ability to drive results in a fast-paced food production environment.

#### 

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* Provide overall leadership for plant operations, including production, quality, food safety, maintenance, warehousing, and distribution.
* Lead and develop managers, supervisors, and frontline teams to create a strong culture of accountability, engagement, and performance.
* Champion safety, regulatory compliance, and food safety programs, including SQF, HACCP, sanitation, and audit readiness.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives to improve productivity, reduce waste, and optimize plant performance.
* Establish and manage KPIs related to safety, quality, labor, yield, inventory, customer service, and on-time delivery.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to support customer growth, new product introductions, and operational initiatives.
* Manage budgets, labor costs, inventory levels, and operational expenses to achieve financial objectives.
* Maintain a visible presence on the production floor, coaching leaders and supporting problem-solving efforts.
* Build succession plans and develop future leaders within the organization.
* Foster a culture focused on operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement.

#### 

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Operations, Engineering, Business, Food Science, Supply Chain, or related field preferred.
* 7+ years of progressive leadership experience in food manufacturing, beverage manufacturing, CPG, protein processing, bakery, prepared foods, or related manufacturing environments.
* Experience managing large production teams through multiple levels of leadership.
* Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, Six Sigma, TPS, or similar methodologies.
* Proven track record improving safety, quality, productivity, and financial performance.
* Experience with SQF, HACCP, FDA/USDA regulations, sanitation programs, and quality systems.
* Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, labor management, inventory control, and operational reporting.
* Excellent communication, coaching, and leadership skills.

#### 

#### **Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is a visible, people-focused manufacturing leader who enjoys building teams, developing talent, and driving operational results. They possess strong food manufacturing experience, a continuous improvement mindset, and a proven ability to lead large-scale operations while improving safety, quality, service, and profitability. Experience in high-volume food production environments is strongly preferred.

records.title: Regional Director of Operations
records.description:
Coordinated Services Management (CSM) is an established senior living management company serving nonprofit and mission-driven organizations throughout Virginia. We are seeking an experienced Regional Director of Operations to provide leadership, guidance, and operational oversight for assigned skilled nursing, assisted living and memory care communities in Virginia. This position is based in Roanoke and requires regular travel to assigned communities.

The ideal candidate is a collaborative, results-oriented leader with strong operational and financial management skills, sound clinical knowledge, and a commitment to quality resident care and services.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide leadership, coaching, and operational oversight to community Executive Directors and leadership teams.
* Drive operational excellence, regulatory compliance, quality of care, resident satisfaction, and financial performance.
* Monitor occupancy, marketing effectiveness, staffing, budgets, and financial results, identifying opportunities for improvement and growth.
* Partner with community leadership and home office team to address operational challenges and implement effective solutions.
* Support leadership development, performance management, and succession planning.
* Guide strategic planning, capital improvements, and effective stewardship of community resources.
* Collaborate with nonprofit ownership Boards, presenting operational results, financial performance, budgets, and strategic recommendations.
* Support the mission, values, and long-term success of each community and its nonprofit ownership.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, nursing, or a related field.
* Licensed Nursing Home Administrator with a minimum of three years of Executive Director experience.
* Strong understanding of senior living operations, regulatory compliance, and resident care practices; clinical experience is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated success in leadership development, financial management, and operational improvement.
* Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Multi-community leadership experience and experience with nonprofit organizations preferred.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to travel throughout Virginia, including occasional overnight travel.

**Compensation**

Competitive salary commensurate with experience and qualifications.

**Join CSM and make a meaningful difference in the lives of seniors while supporting the success of mission-driven communities.**

Coordinated Services Management is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Pay: From $145,000.00 per year

records.title: General Manager, Data Operations
records.description:
**About David AI**
------------------

At David AI, our vision is to bring impactful AI into billions of lives through voice. Our mission is to help the world's leading AI companies build better voice models and agents. We're building the data and evaluation infrastructure behind those models.

Founded in 2024, we're a fast-growing Series B company backed by NVIDIA, Meritech, First Round, YC, and others, with ~70 people across San Francisco and New York City.

**About our Data Operations team**
----------------------------------

Our Data Operations team powers David AI's Data Factory, transforming raw audio into high-quality training datasets for leading AI labs. Our mandate is to spin up new data pipelines and run them at a massive scale.

This means starting from a model capability we want a model to unlock, experimenting with different shapes of data and collection strategies, and validating them with researchers. Once an approach works, we industrialize it, building pipelines that can process audio with reliability, quality, and efficiency. We are relentless operators who thrive in ambiguity, equally comfortable prototyping novel workflows as we are managing large-scale production systems.

**About this role**
-------------------

As **General Manager of Data Operations** at David AI, you will lead one of the most critical functions at David AI. You’ll own a major slice of our Data Factory: the engine that powers high-quality, scalable data production. You’ll lead the team responsible for building and scaling pipelines, from 0 1 experiments that unlock new model capabilities to 1 N industrialization that processes data reliably and efficiently.

**In this role, you will**
--------------------------

* Build and lead a team of Data Product Operations Leads, to spin up and scale data pipelines, from early experiments to production systems that generate high-quality audio data at scale.
* Act as a thought partner to executive leadership on how we can evolve and scale delivery capabilities in service of customer needs.
* Continuously monitor and improve pipeline health, spotting issues in sourcing, quality, or process early and owning solutions end-to-end.
* Use metrics to drive decisions, tracking throughput, quality, and cost to guide prioritization and identify where to scale or invest next.
* Work with researchers at leading AI labs to identify new model capabilities and turn them into concrete data workflows and project plans.
* Partner with our internal research team to design and test new data shapes that unlock frontier model capabilities.
* Own outcomes across functions, designing systems, managing execution, unblocking bottlenecks, and ensuring delivery at both prototype and production scale.

**Your background looks like**
------------------------------

* 5 to 10+ years of experience in high-ownership roles (e.g., founder, GM, COO, or strategy/ops at a venture-backed startup).
* Prior experience scaling large-scale operational efforts at high-growth startups or fast-paced companies.
* Technical fluency with data and operations; SQL proficiency required.
* Prior experience designing and scaling systems, processes, and teams across different customer segments and product lines.
* A relentless operator with high standards, bias to action, and strong attention to detail.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid pace; thrives in a “build while flying” environment.
* Low-ego, collaborative, and mission-driven, focused on team and company success.

**Bonus points if you have**
----------------------------

* Experience in data, ML, or large-scale operations.
* Background in CS, industrial engineering, or similar.

**Benefits**
------------

* Unlimited PTO.
* Top-notch health, dental, and vision coverage with 100% coverage for most plans.
* FSA & HSA access.
* 401k access.
* Meals 2x daily through DoorDash + snacks and beverages available at the office.
* Unlimited company-sponsored Barry's classes.

**Visas**
---------

We sponsor international candidates across several visa types, including H-1B *transfers*, H-1B1, O-1, E-3, and TN. We also hire candidates on STEM OPT. If you’re on OPT, we’ll want to confirm you have a path to one of the visas listed above before your OPT ends. While we can’t guarantee any individual outcome, we’ve successfully sponsored teammates from all over the world.

Compensation Range: $205K - $235K

records.title: General Manager - Wastewater Operations
records.description:
**Are You a Wastewater Expert Who Knows How to Build a Business?**

We are looking for a dynamic, entrepreneurial, results-driven **General Manager – Wastewater Operations** to lead, grow, and transform our **Eastern United States Region.**

This is not a traditional operations management position. This is an opportunity for a proven wastewater leader and business-minded entrepreneur to take ownership of a region, build high-performing teams, strengthen customer partnerships, drive profitable growth, and establish a standard of operational excellence.

At Solution Group, we deliver specialized wastewater treatment solutions, chemical program management, and operational expertise to some of the most demanding industrial environments in the country, including dairy processing, rendering, and food and beverage manufacturing.

Our customers depend on us to solve complex wastewater challenges, maintain regulatory compliance, improve treatment performance, and reduce operating costs. We need a leader who understands these challenges firsthand and has the technical credibility, business acumen, and leadership presence to take our regional operations to the next level.

**We are looking for a leader who thinks like an owner, operates like an expert, and leads like an entrepreneur.**

**THE OPPORTUNITY: OWN IT. GROW IT. LEAD IT.**

As General Manager, you will have full accountability for the performance and growth of your assigned region. You will lead a multi-site wastewater operation with accountability for financial performance, customer relationships, business development, operational execution, safety, and talent development.

You will have the autonomy and accountability to make an impact, identify opportunities, challenge the status quo, and build a stronger, more profitable business.

Your mission is to create a high-performing regional organization that consistently delivers exceptional wastewater treatment results, outstanding customer experiences, strong financial performance, and a culture of accountability.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**

**1. Business Growth & Entrepreneurial Leadership**

* Take ownership of regional growth, identifying new customers, developing market opportunities, and expanding our presence within existing accounts.
* Build executive-level customer relationships that create trust, strengthen retention, and generate new business.
* Identify opportunities to introduce additional services, technologies, and revenue streams across existing customer locations.
* Partner with Business Development, Key Account Managers, and Technical Services to win new business and successfully launch new customer operations.
* Explore strategic partnerships, acquisitions, and opportunities to expand our regional footprint.
* Develop and execute a regional growth strategy with measurable revenue and profitability targets.

**2. Full P&L Ownership & Financial Performance**

* Own the financial performance of the region, including revenue, EBITDA, labor, chemicals, materials, maintenance, and capital expenditures.
* Drive profitable growth through disciplined financial management, cost optimization, and operational accountability.
* Establish clear financial expectations and performance metrics throughout the organization.
* Develop accurate forecasts, budgets, and action plans to improve business performance.
* Communicate financial results, opportunities, challenges, and corrective actions to executive leadership.

**3. Wastewater Expertise & Operational Excellence**

* Provide strategic and technical leadership across a portfolio of industrial wastewater treatment operations.
* Leverage your deep wastewater knowledge to improve treatment performance, process stability, compliance, and operating efficiency.
* Establish consistent operating standards, SOPs, preventive maintenance programs, and performance metrics across all locations.
* Drive standardization and best-practice implementation while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce costs.
* Lead troubleshooting and problem-solving efforts on complex wastewater treatment challenges.
* Champion continuous improvement, root cause analysis, process optimization, and operational discipline.

**4. Customer Leadership & Retention**

* Own the overall customer experience and build long-term, trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders.
* Maintain a strong customer retention rate through proactive engagement, exceptional service delivery, and measurable results.
* Lead strategic customer business reviews and identify opportunities to deliver additional value.
* Partner with Key Account Managers to ensure customer expectations are consistently met and exceeded.
* Position Solution Group as a strategic wastewater partner, not simply a service provider.

**5. Safety, Compliance & Operational Discipline**

* Establish a culture where safety, environmental compliance, and operational excellence are non-negotiable.
* Partner with HSE leadership to drive safety performance, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure all locations maintain strong environmental compliance, documentation, training, and preventative safety practices.
* Champion 5S, workplace organization, and consistent execution of operational standards.
* Lead with visibility, accountability, and a commitment to ensuring every employee goes home safely.

**6. Build, Develop & Inspire High-Performing Teams**

* Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional operational leaders and wastewater professionals.
* Lead and coach Key Account Managers, Regional Managers, and Site Managers.
* Establish clear expectations, performance goals, and accountability throughout the region.
* Develop succession plans and create opportunities for employees to grow into greater leadership responsibilities.
* Build a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and results.
* Lead by example and inspire teams to take pride in their work, their customers, and their performance.

**7. Enterprise Leadership & Collaboration**

* Work closely with other General Managers and corporate leadership to share best practices and drive company-wide success.
* Collaborate with Technical Services, Business Development, Sales, HR, Finance, and HSE to strengthen capabilities and execute strategic initiatives.
* Contribute to the long-term growth, scalability, and success of Solution Group.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a strong, confident, entrepreneurial leader who brings together deep technical wastewater expertise, proven operational leadership, and a genuine passion for building a business.

**You are someone who:**

* Knows wastewater treatment. You understand industrial wastewater processes, treatment systems, troubleshooting, chemistry, compliance, and the operational challenges our customers face.
* Thinks like a business owner. You understand P&L performance, revenue growth, cost control, and what it takes to build a profitable operation.
* Is commercially driven. You naturally identify opportunities, build relationships, grow accounts, and turn customer challenges into business opportunities.
* Leads with confidence. You know how to build trust, set expectations, develop people, and hold teams accountable.
* Is operationally disciplined. You believe in KPIs, standardization, preventative maintenance, continuous improvement, and measurable results.
* Is entrepreneurial. You are energized by growth, change, new opportunities, and the ability to make a meaningful impact.
* Is a problem solver. You are comfortable navigating complex operational challenges and making decisions in a fast-paced environment.
* Is collaborative. You understand that regional success contributes to company-wide success.

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS**

* 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in industrial wastewater treatment, environmental services, industrial services, utilities, or related operational environments.
* Demonstrated expertise in industrial wastewater treatment operations, including treatment processes, troubleshooting, environmental compliance, and emerging technologies.
* Proven experience leading multi-site or regional operations with direct leadership responsibility for multiple levels of management.
* Previous full P&L ownership with demonstrated success improving profitability and financial performance.
* A track record of growing revenue, expanding customer relationships, and developing new business opportunities.
* Experience building and implementing operational standards, KPIs, SOPs, audit programs, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, cost management, and accountability.
* Experience with Lean, TPM, 5S, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, customer relationship, and change management skills.
* Ability and willingness to travel 50% or more throughout the Eastern US Region.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Business, Operations, or a related discipline.
* State-issued wastewater operator license (Class A, B, C, or D, as applicable).
* Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement certifications.
* Experience with mergers, acquisitions, and business integration.

**WHY SOLUTION GROUP?**

At Solution Group, you won't simply inherit a job description and maintain the status quo. You will have the opportunity to influence the direction of a growing business, develop exceptional teams, strengthen customer partnerships, and make a measurable impact on our future.

We offer:

* **Executive-Level Compensation:** $140,000–$200,000 base salary, plus eligibility for an annual performance bonus.
* **Meaningful Leadership:** Full regional ownership and the opportunity to directly influence business performance and strategy.
* **Entrepreneurial Opportunity:** The ability to identify opportunities, drive growth, and help shape the future of the organization.
* **Strong Team Environment:** Work alongside experienced wastewater professionals and collaborative corporate leadership.
* **Competitive Benefits:** Health, dental, vision, 401k, Paid Time Off.
* **Professional Development:** Continued technical training and opportunities for career advancement.
* **Travel Reimbursement:** Mileage reimbursement for business travel.

**THE BOTTOM LINE**

**We are looking for a wastewater expert who is ready to lead a business, not just manage operations.**

If you have the technical depth to understand complex wastewater challenges, the business acumen to drive profitable growth, and the leadership ability to build exceptional teams, we want to hear from you.

**Come build something great with Solution Group.**

*Solution Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected status under applicable federal, state, or local laws.*

Pay: $140,000.00 - $200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Dependent care reimbursement
* Dependent health insurance coverage
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Industrial Wastewater: 10 years (Required)
* Leadership: 5 years (Preferred)

Willingness to travel:

* 50% (Required)

records.title: Director Quality Assurance
records.description:
**Obsessed by Science. Entrepreneurial by Nature. United by Purpose.**
Diasorin is a global leader in immunodiagnostic and molecular diagnostic solutions, advancing science to improve patient outcomes worldwide. For more than 50 years, we have combined scientific rigor with an entrepreneurial mindset, operating with a strong commitment to innovation, accountability, and results to deliver trusted diagnostic solutions.
  
  
As the Diagnostics Specialist, Diasorin continuously invests in research, technology, and people. Guided by our values of operational excellence, customer focus, and teamwork, we empower teams to think boldly, act decisively, and transform ideas into meaningful impact across one of the industry’s broadest specialty diagnostic portfolios.
  
  
When you join Diasorin, you are not just filling a role. You are helping build what comes next.
  
  
**Why Join Diasorin**

* Build What Matters Take ownership, challenge the status quo, and contribute directly to solutions that improve patient care worldwide.
* Innovate with Agility at a Global Scale Work in an entrepreneurial environment that enables speed, collaboration, and global impact.
* Grow in a People-Centered Culture Thrive in a culture that values accountability, inclusion, and continuous development.

**Job Scope:**
The Director, Quality Assurance for Austin will lead, establish, implement and maintain quality assurance systems and activities ensuring compliance with domestic and international quality system standards and regulations for commercial medical devices designed, produced and marketed by Luminex. Partner with Manufacturing, Design/Development, Systems Engineering, Quality Control and others across functions to deliver the highest quality instruments, and reagents. This position is responsible for the oversight, control and release of instruments and reagents, quality organizational management, budget preparation, personnel management, organizational goals and metrics, and Executive Level presentations. The Director, Quality Assurance for Austin is a leader and a mentor.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities And Duties**

* Ensures that the Austin site demonstrates regulatory compliance per GLP/GCP/cGMP/GXP, ISO, and other applicable regulations.
* Support instrument new product development and manufacturing changes, provides guidance to the core teams and participate in the process.
* Leader in process optimization by Identifying and analyzing opportunities for continual improvements in product/service quality, customer satisfaction, and company profitability.
* Leads the strategy and improvements for the manufacturing and service depot of Instruments for our customers and partners in compliance with regulations and standards.
* Participates and manage activities for external audits such as ISO, FDA or other regulatory bodies for the Austin site. Acts in Audits - as co-host, SME or escort
* Responds to alleged QMS violations of regulations, policies, procedures as the result of both external and external audits by evaluating and recommending the initiation of investigative activities, immediate corrections and risk analysis processes. Coordinates responses to external audits and manages corrective actions to close.
* Interacts with various internal and external groups to facilitate the completion of internal audits, handling of non-conformances, performing Risk Assessments, CAPA, investigation and support, manufacturing validation as well as Design Transfer.
* QMS improvements and enhancements and is a leading member of the Quality Management Team. Works across the corporation to align and define quality approach for molecular diagnostic products.
* Partners with Site Leadership and Field Quality to conduct, manage, and evaluate investigations related to customer complaints, nonconformances, audits, corrective/preventive action concerns, deviations, recalls, and potential injuries
* Appropriately escalate Quality issues to the Vice President Quality Assurance Molecular Division
* Provide leadership in the application of Quality Tools such as Risk Management, Root Cause Investigations, Designs of Experiments, Capability Studies, in the establishment and investigation of process and products failures and implement lasting solutions of such failures.
* May act as IVDR Person Responsible for Regulatory Compliance (PRRC) for Luminex sites to ensure: the conformity of the devices is appropriately checked before a device is released, the post-market surveillance and reporting obligations are fulfilled and all requirements established between Luminex and Authorized representative are met.
* May act as Management Representative for the site. In this capacity, ensure that product meets label claims and customer satisfaction, any quality or regulatory issue is elevated to the President and/or Vice President Quality Assurance Compliance North America and oversee and drive continuous improvement.
* Develops and releases Change Plans and actions to support the changing needs and requirements of the organization as the result of strategic changes in business direction
* Provide other Quality related technical training as necessary
* Directs activities of employees or through managers who exercise full supervision for daily operations. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws.
* Maintains talent through recruiting and development opportunities. Continually develops internal candidates through succession planning and career development.
* Responsible for enforcing all EHS policies in their span of control
* Be part of any the new key and strategic projects and due diligence process if required
* Ensure all site-level activities and related documentation are aligned with corporate procedures and conducted in accordance with DiaSorin’s established Corporate and Quality Assurance governance requirements.

**Education, Experience And Qualifications**

* Minimum Bachelor degree in a science or engineering discipline with 8+ years of relevant experience/training
* 10+ Years of Experience in Quality Assurance or Regulatory Affairs activities in a cGMP Medical Device or Pharmaceutical environment
* 5+ years of Demonstrated knowledge of current industry quality practices under ISO 13485, ISO 14971, CFR 820 and CFR 806 and international regulations preferred
* 2+ years of Management experience in a complex quality assurance/quality systems field
* 2+ years of Ability to provide leadership to others in the organization through influence, innovative practices and coaching skills to foster a corporate culture of responsiveness, compliance awareness, self-regulation, quality system ownership, challenge of status quo, and continuous improvement in order to achieve the highest level of compliance.
* 5+ years of Excellent problem solving methodology, using industry accepted concepts and tools to solve complex problems in creative and effective ways as they apply to compliance issues.
* 5+ years of Hands-on ability to sort through technical complexities and work in a flexible changing environment.
* 5+ years of Possesses a strong scientific and technical background, sufficient to establish creditability with senior management as well as the manufacturing and product development teams.
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills
* Thorough knowledge of standards and regulations (cGMP, ISO 13485)
* Highly organized with proven time management and prioritization skills
* Ability to work independently and with minimal supervision

JOIN A TEAM WHERE YOU’LL BE CHALLENGED AND valued.
  
  
A career with Summit Polymers means working with smart people in a culture that thrives on challenging, meaningful work. At Summit, we look for growth potential with every hire. **Job Description**
**JOB TITLE:**
Director, Corporate Quality
**FLSA STATUS:**
Exempt
  
  
**REPORTS TO:**
Regional Director of Manufacturing (Corporate)
  
  
**Summary**
This management position is responsible for developing, implementing and continually improving the company’s standardized manufacturing quality systems globally. The Director, Corporate Quality works collaboratively with plant quality managers, general managers and other company resources to achieve world class quality performance as measured by customer quality scorecards. The Director, Corporate Quality interfaces with key customer personnel to build customer confidence in Summit Polymers, ensure Summit Polymers meets customer expectations and requirements, and to resolve significant customer quality concerns.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Duties**
Is responsible for the following major tasks:
  
  

* Exhibits positive leadership and acts with highest levels of integrity and ethics
* Champions corporate wide manufacturing quality system standardization

+ Leads and collaborates with plant quality managers, general managers and RDMs to determine best practices and develop standardized quality system and procedures applicable to all manufacturing facilities
+ Administers, trains, and communicates the company’s standardized quality system and procedures to ensure they are effectively implemented and maintained throughout the company
+ Performs plant quality system standards compliance audits and leads follow up action plan reviews with each plant
+ Lead continuous improvement of quality systems

* Champions overall quality scorecard performance for all customers

+ Develops deep knowledge of every customer quality scorecard
+ Leads specific customer scorecard training for plant quality managers, materials managers and general managers to ensure these leaders understand scoring methodology and act to ensure scorecard success
+ Monitors customer scorecard methodology and scoring changes, and ensures corporate procedures, metrics and personnel proactively adapt to changes to ensure customer scorecard success
+ Engages with other functional departments to ensure all aspects of customer scorecards are understood and actions are taken to ensure scorecard success (examples Sales – cost reductions, materials – minority sourcing)

+ Develops constructive relationships with key customer contacts
+ Builds customer’s confidence in SPI’s performance, capabilities, systems, and integrity
+ Represents the company at customer “quality roundtable” events
+ Reviews customer quality system requirements and specifications and ensure they are effectively communicated and implemented at all levels of the organization

* Engages in significant customer quality concerns and warranty issues

+ Participates in problem solving and customer response preparation for significant customer quality issues
+ Represents the company at critical customer quality concern reviews, leading company response and negotiation to achieve successful resolution
+ Acts as point of contact for customer warranty concerns and engages plant and engineering resources to solve warranty concerns

* Provides quality expertise as a corporate resource

+ Champions Practical Problem Solving activities across the company, including improving effectiveness of management team leadership of the process
+ Key leader for development, update, training and compliance to corporate IATF-16949 compliant systems and procedures
+ Supports new business initiatives and projects with data, metrics, support plans, and technical expertise as related to quality
+ Provide support in developing and performing training plans for quality managers and quality engineers at manufacturing plants
+ Provides additional support at manufacturing plants as needed

* Other tasks and duties as assigned

**Education And Experience**

* 4-year college degree in technical or management field preferred
* 5 years’ experience in role of Quality Manager at automotive supplier preferred

**Skills And Abilities**

* Broad knowledge of quality systems and management practices in automotive plastics manufacturing operations
* Expertise in major automotive OEM quality systems; Ford Q1, GM BIQS, FCA, Nissan, VW, BMW, and Toyota
* Expert problem solving skills utilizing root cause based methods; Practical Problem Solving (PPS), 8D, and 5 why methodology
* Must be able to gather and analyze information easily and make appropriate decisions.
* Outstanding leadership, team building, coaching and decision making abilities
* Highly energetic, confident, and assertive with the ability to lead and motivate others
* Must have excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills

**Travel Requirements**
This position typically does require approximately 18 weeks per year of travel to Summit Polymers Manufacturing Sites.

**Company Overview**
Red 6 is an innovative Augmented Reality (AR) technology startup leading the way in synthetic air combat training. Our primary technology, supporting our ATARS product, enables pilots to simulate the cognitive challenges of flying while accessing realistic, scalable training in dynamic outdoor environments.
  
  
**Director of Quality**
Lead Red 6 into a scalable aerospace product organization.
  
  
Red 6 develops advanced augmented reality capabilities for aerospace and defense applications. We seek a hands-on, strategic Director of Quality to lead the next phase of our evolution into disciplined, repeatable product qualification and production. This leader will strengthen existing foundations while guiding the processes, evidence, and behaviors needed to meet customer, regulatory, safety, and aerospace industry expectations.
  
  
Success requires more than maintaining certifications. The Director will embed quality planning into product development, improve manufacturing and supplier readiness, and create a culture in which teams jointly solve problems before they become defects, delays, or compliance findings. Key results are building practical, auditable quality processes with Quality as a trusted partner across Engineering, Operations, Programs, and the supplier base.
  
  
**What You Will Lead**

* Own the enterprise Quality strategy and roadmap, scaling the Quality Management System (QMS) to match product maturity, production volume, and customer commitments.
* Maintain and continuously improve AS9100 certification and audit readiness. Lead management reviews, internal audits, corrective action effectiveness, risk based thinking, and process ownership.
* Lead ISO 45001 occupational health and safety management system maturation and certification readiness, in coordination with accountable safety and operations leaders.
* Deploy practical Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) disciplines aligned to AS9145 where applicable, including quality planning, process flow, PFMEA, control plans, measurement system analysis, first article inspection, and production readiness reviews.
* Integrate Quality into design inputs, reviews, verification and validation, configuration control, design changes, manufacturing transitions, and product release criteria.
* Establish scalable document and record controls, product pedigree, serial level traceability, inspection and test evidence, nonconformance controls, material review, CAPA, and calibration systems.
* Develop supplier qualification, surveillance, performance scorecards, supplier corrective actions, and risk based oversight of contract manufacturers and critical suppliers.
* Partner with Engineering and Operations to strengthen hardware quality, reliability, manufacturability, process validation, FOD/ESD controls, and handling of nonconforming material.
* Improve the connection between Windchill PLM, Epsilon3 MES, Unanet ERP, and existing compliance tools to support controlled, usable, auditable data across design, build, and delivery.
* Lead customer quality engagement, audits, contractual quality deliverables, and coordination with defense and aerospace stakeholders as applicable.

**LEAD A COLLABORATIVE QUALITY CULTURE**

* Build a capable Quality team with clear roles, coaching, succession planning, and cross functional influence.
* Act as a constructive partner to Engineering. Translate standards and contractual obligations into design intent, risk, and measurable acceptance criteria rather than relying on clause citations alone.
* Distinguish nonnegotiable compliance outcomes from implementation choices. Invite Engineering and Operations to co-design efficient solutions.
* Create early quality engagement in program planning and design reviews. Resolve disagreements using evidence, risk, cost, schedule, and accountable decision ownership.
* Establish shared performance measures and a regular Quality–Engineering working cadence to reduce late surprises and unproductive escalation.
* Promote a just, learning oriented culture that encourages timely issue reporting, root cause analysis, and effective preventive action.

**Qualifications Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Significant progressive aerospace or defense quality leadership experience, including building or scaling an AS9100 QMS and leading certification or surveillance audits.
* Demonstrated success moving products from prototype or development environments into qualified, controlled, repeatable production.
* Working knowledge of APQP per AS9145, AS9102 first article inspection, supplier quality, configuration management, CAPA, and risk based process control.
* Ability to influence senior technical leaders without defaulting to authority or unnecessary bureaucracy. Strong facilitation, coaching, and conflict resolution skills.
* Experience with customer and supplier quality requirements, quality metrics, and cross functional improvement programs.
* Ability to work on site in Denver and travel periodically to suppliers and other Red 6 locations.
* Must be US Citizen to have the ability to obtain and maintain a DoD Security Clearance.

**Preferred Experience**

* ISO 45001 implementation or certification leadership; AS9115 awareness for deliverable software where relevant.
* DoD prime contractor interfaces, DCMA, DFARS, and applicable government customer quality requirements.
* Experience with PLM, MES, ERP, and integrated digital quality workflows, especially Windchill, Epsilon3, and Unanet.
* Lean Six Sigma, ASQ quality credentials, GD&T, hardware reliability, and complex electromechanical systems.
* Experience developing small teams into mature, business enabling quality organizations.

**What Success Looks Like In The First 12 Months**

* Publish an agreed risk based Quality maturity roadmap with clear process owners and milestones.
* Sustain AS9100 compliance and close systemic audit or corrective action gaps with evidence of effectiveness.
* Introduce an appropriate APQP and production readiness framework for priority product lines.
* Improve supplier quality visibility, product traceability, and readiness of controlled manufacturing documentation.
* Demonstrate stronger Quality–Engineering collaboration through earlier issue resolution and fewer late stage quality surprises.
* Provide leadership with a concise scorecard covering escapes, rework, supplier performance, CAPA aging, audit findings, and readiness milestones.

Cytovale, Inc. | South San Francisco, CA
  
  
**Reports to:**
Chief Operating Officer

Quality and Regulatory Compliance

**About Cytovale**
Cytovale is a medical diagnostics company focused on providing a faster, more insightful way to diagnose fast-moving and immune-mediated diseases. Cytovale's IntelliSep test is the first and only stand-alone sepsis detection assay to quickly and accurately analyze white blood cell structure to stratify a patient's risk of sepsis. The test simply and clearly shows risk of sepsis using a biomechanical evaluation of white blood cells from a standard blood draw, generating results in less than 10 minutes. For more information, please visit www.cytovale.com.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Head of Quality and Regulatory owns Cytovale's Quality Management System and serves as the company's designated Management Representative. This leader is accountable for the effectiveness and compliance of the QMS under FDA QMSR (21 CFR Part 820), ISO 13485, ISO 14971, and applicable IEC standards, and for the quality engineering capability that supports design change, process validation, and on-market product improvement for the IntelliSep system and its consumables.
  
  
The role is quality-first with a strong regulatory partnership. Working alongside the Senior Director of Regulatory Affairs, the Head of Quality and Regulatory shapes an 18- to 24-month regulatory roadmap spanning letters to file, Special and Traditional 510(k)s, and Predetermined Change Control Plans (PCCPs), so that product and reliability improvements reach customers predictably and compliantly. The position leads all internal and external audits, third-party registrations, and agency inspections, and is expected to make the organization both more compliant and more nimble.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Quality Strategy and Leadership**

* Define and execute an enterprise Quality strategy that supports regulatory obligations, operational objectives, and long-term growth; establish annual quality objectives and the KPIs used to report progress to executive leadership.
* Lead a multidisciplinary Quality organization spanning Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, Design Quality, Quality Systems, Process Validation, Incoming Inspection, and the audit program.
* Set the strategy for quality infrastructure, including eQMS evolution and the application of AI and analytics to quality processes.

**Quality Management System and Compliance**

* Serve as Management Representative; own the effectiveness of the QMS and its core processes, including CAPA, nonconformance and deviation management, complaint handling, change control, document control, training, and management review.
* Drive process improvements that allow the organization to move quickly while maintaining full FDA, ISO, and QMSR compliance, with documentation that is cohesive, consistent, and built on continuous-improvement principles.
* Establish and sustain a disciplined operating rhythm for internal audits, annual post-market reviews, and periodic management reviews.
* Maintain a proactive state of inspection readiness and lead the organization through FDA inspections, Notified Body audits, and third-party registration activities.

**Design Quality, Change Management, and Regulatory Roadmap**

* Direct design quality assurance across product development and design-change programs, allocating resources, managing budgets, and embedding quality engineers in project teams to ensure efficient, compliant execution.
* Partner with the Senior Director of Regulatory Affairs to develop and maintain a forward-looking 18- to 24-month regulatory roadmap covering letters to file, Special and Traditional 510(k)s, and PCCPs that enable feature and reliability improvements.

**POSITION PURPOSE**

This position is responsible for leading, planning, organizing, and managing the safe and efficient operation and maintenance of the Bison Generation Station (BGS) facility to economically produce electricity to satisfy member needs.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES**

* Provide technical input for the decision-making process in power plant operation and maintenance. Keep plant staff informed of all aspects of the operation and maintenance of the facility and implement necessary corrective actions.
* Manage plant operational equipment; develop and maintain plant personnel and equipment safety standards; and develop preventative maintenance procedures and operational procedure manuals.
* Support the safety program by rigorously assuring standards are enforced and safety is at the forefront of all actions.
* Work in collaboration with other departments to build and adhere to all project budgets; responsible for developing and adhering to the BGS Long-Range Engineering Plan and the Capital Budget.
* Supervise the selection, training, development, and supervision of BGS employees.
* Evaluate the performance of plant section heads reporting to the position, review performance evaluations for all employees, and recommend salary adjustments for plant employees.
* Direct the development and submission of required reports to assure documentation and communication of plant operations, maintenance, and environmental activities.
* Authorize all plant purchase request orders and staff timesheets. In addition, review all proposed changes or modifications to plant systems or equipment and proposed tests or research programs.
* Responsible for staff development to ensure that each section functions safely and efficiently and that they all work together to meet the goals and objectives of Basin Electric, the plant operations division, and the station.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Energy Management, Business, or an Engineering Accreditation Commission/ Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology (EAC/ABET) accredited engineering program; and 10 years of related power generation or petrochemical plant operations, maintenance, or engineering experience; or
* An associate’s degree in Power/Process Plan Technology or related field; and 12 years’ experience in power generation or petrochemical plant operations, maintenance or engineering; or
* A high school diploma or equivalent (GED or HSED); and 14 years’ in power generation or petrochemical plant operations, maintenance or engineering.
* Prior supervisory experience.
* A valid driver’s license.

**PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS**

This position requires constant sitting; and occasional lifting/carrying up to 50 pounds, pushing/pulling up to 20 pounds, standing, walking, bending, crawling, reaching, and climbing. This position uses office equipment and field tools. This position also requires finger dexterity, good vision/hearing, hand coordination, and the ability to perform close work, analyze data/reports, conduct research, and implement recommendations. This position occasionally works in areas of dirt/dust, fumes, chemicals, extreme heat/cold, vibration, noise, and poor ventilation. This position must be respirator qualified.

**KEY SKILLS**

* Effective administrative and human relation skills.
* Excellent organizational, written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficient with personal computers and Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.
* Able to provide work direction, develop plans/procedures/goals, and present information to others.

* Competitive salary aligned with experience.
* Relocation package to support your transition.

* More benefits to support you.

records.description:
**Job Description**
**Please note that this position is not available for visa sponsorship, and we are unable to take over existing employment visa sponsorships.**
TransMedics is transforming organ transplant therapy with the Organ Care System (OCS)—the first portable warm-perfusion platform that keeps donor organs functioning outside the body. It's technology built to give more patients a chance at a transplant, and more transplant teams the confidence to say yes to an organ they'd otherwise have to turn away.
  
  
The
**Sr. Director of Manufacturing Engineering**
is a pivotal leadership role within TransMedics Supply Chain organization, leading Advanced Operations (New Product & Technology Introduction), Sustaining Engineering, Manufacturing (Process) Engineering, and Technical Field Service. Building on TransMedics strong foundation of engineering excellence, this leader will drive the step-change required to enable the company's next phase of growth—ensuring our engineering practices, systems, and infrastructure deliver world-class results, from product quality and reliability to manufacturing performance, efficiency, and scalability.
  
  
This is a build role, not a maintain role. TransMedics growth trajectory demands a leader who can set multi-year transformation strategy and organizational design—while staying close enough to the floor to walk a line, dig into a process deviation, or unblock a launch when it matters. We're looking for someone equally comfortable owning a transformation roadmap and rolling up their sleeves alongside the team. This leader will also play a key role in building the team's reputation as a strong destination for engineering talent—attracting good people and giving them room to grow into bigger roles as the company scales.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the Manufacturing Engineering organization — oversee Advanced Operations, Sustaining Engineering, Manufacturing (Process) Engineering, Technical Field Service, and related functions.
* Drive step-change transformation — advance engineering practices, systems, and infrastructure to enable the next phase of TransMedics growth.
* Ensure world-class quality & performance — deliver excellence in product quality, manufacturing process performance, efficiency, and scalability.
* Advance manufacturing innovation — implement transformational processes using best-in-class development, advanced technologies, automation, and robotic-assisted manufacturing.
* Embed Design for Excellence (DfX) — make DfX, including Design for Manufacturability (DFM), a core enabler of product quality, cost efficiency, and scalability, with a strong focus on simplification and part-count reduction.
* Develop and inspire talent — build and scale a high-performing engineering team while fostering growth, development, and a culture of excellence.
* Stay hands-on — be willing to get into the details on the floor—a process deviation, a line issue, a launch at risk—when the team needs it.
* Position TransMedics as a talent destination — help establish the company as a premier destination for top engineering talent in the U.S.
* Collaborate cross-functionally — partner with peers across R&D, Quality, and the broader Supply Chain organization to support TransMedics mission and strategic goals.

**Strategic Focus Areas**

* Engineering Transformation — deliver step-change improvements in practices, systems, and infrastructure.
* Product Quality & Reliability — ensure world-class outcomes across current and future products, including our hardware fleet.
* Manufacturing Innovation & Scalability — leverage automation, robotics, and advanced processes to scale efficiently.
* Design for Excellence (DfX/DFM) — embed design principles that drive quality, cost efficiency, and simplification (e.g., part-count reduction).
* Talent & Leadership Development — attract, grow, and retain top engineering talent while building a culture of excellence.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration — partner with the broader enterprise to enable TransMedics mission.

**Management Responsibilities**

* Manages a team of direct reports across the verticals referenced above, including performance reviews and professional development planning.
* Oversight of design contractors, co-ops, and interns as needed.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Biomedical, Mechanical, Electrical, or equivalent).
* 15+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience in medical devices or other regulated manufacturing environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA
* Proven experience leading multi-disciplinary engineering organizations through complex growth and transformation initiatives.
* Demonstrated success in the strategic focus areas above.
* Expertise in regulatory frameworks and compliance systems.
* Experience leveraging technology platforms (MES, ERP, and digital tools) to enhance manufacturing and engineering outcomes.
* Strong financial acumen, project planning, and capital management capabilities.

**Work Environment**

* Office and manufacturing floor environment.

As part of our long-term growth plans, TransMedics is excited to announce our plan to relocate our headquarters (HQ) to Somerville, MA by 2028. We chose this location because we believe it is a place where innovation will thrive. Our new state-of-the-art headquarters is designed to support collaboration, creativity, and discovery. We believe this will be a place where we can continue to do things few thought possible in organ transplantation to help patients.
*Specific timing and role impact may vary.*
TransMedics, Inc. is a commercial-stage medical technology company transforming organ transplant therapy for patients worldwide. Our mission is to help save more patients’ lives by increasing access to viable donor organs for those who are awaiting an organ transplant. To accomplish this mission, we partner closely with transplant stakeholders worldwide and help expand their access to healthy donor organs, while delivering the highest quality technology, service, clinical care and outcomes.
  
  
Driven by a passion for improving patient care, we make the impossible possible and keep our employees at the center of everything we do. Together, we strive to enhance the quality of life for transplant recipients and their families, fostering hope and healing in the journey toward better health.
  
  
**Maximize your potential at TransMedics, Inc.**
www.TransMedics.com
  
  
TransMedics is committed to equitable and transparent compensation. The expected base salary range for this role is $220,600-$314,050, which represents the company’s current good-faith estimate of compensation for this position. Actual salary will depend on factors such as, but not limited to, candidate experience, qualifications, skills, and the specific work location. If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact.
  
  
With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses (https://www.idexcorp.com/our-businesses/business-segments/) around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you.
  
  
The Director of Process Engineering is responsible for leading the development, optimization, and scale-up of manufacturing processes to support Mott Corporation's growth across Semiconductor, Aerospace & Defense, and Industrial markets. This role drives process stability, improves yield and cost performance, and ensures successful industrialization of new products.
  
  
Reporting to senior operations leadership, the Director will lead a team of process engineers and collaborate closely with Operations, R&D, and Quality to deliver reliable, scalable manufacturing processes for highly technical and mission-critical applications.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Market-Aligned Process Development

Lead process engineering efforts aligned to Mott's three core markets, ensuring each manufacturing environment meets its unique requirements:
  
  

* Ultra-high purity, contamination-free manufacturing for Semiconductor customers
* High-reliability and regulated production for Aerospace & Defense programs
* Efficient, scalable production for Industrial markets
* Ensure all processes meet customer, regulatory, and product performance requirements
* Drive alignment between process capability and market-specific technical demands
* Process Optimization & Manufacturing Support

Own process performance metrics and drive continuous improvement across all assigned manufacturing areas:
  
  

* Yield and First Pass Yield (FPY) improvement
* Throughput optimization and cycle time reduction
* Scrap and rework reduction programs
* Lead root cause analysis and structured problem-solving for manufacturing and quality issues
* Standardize and document processes, work instructions, and best practices
* New Product Introduction (NPI) & Scale-Up

Partner with R&D and cross-functional teams to accelerate new product industrialization:
  
  

* Lead Design-for-Manufacturability (DFM) reviews and production readiness activities
* Support transition from R&D to production, ensuring robust and repeatable processes
* Implement and enforce APQP, PFMEA, and process validation disciplines
* Collaborate across functions to accelerate time-to-market for new programs
* Process Capability & Technology Development

**Drive Advancement Of Core Manufacturing Technologies**

* Develop and improve manufacturing processes in advanced materials processing (e.g., powder metals, sintering, purification)
* Optimize precision machining and fabrication capabilities
* Enhance cleaning and assembly processes for high-spec environments
* Support evaluation and implementation of new equipment, tooling, and automation
* Drive continuous improvement in process capability and repeatability

* Partner with leadership to recruit and retain top technical talent

* Operations — support daily manufacturing execution and escalation resolution
* R&D / Engineering — ensure smooth technology transfer and DFM alignment
* Quality — ensure process control, validation, and regulatory compliance
* Engage in customer-facing technical discussions for complex applications as needed

**Key Performance Metrics**
Success in this role will be measured against the following metrics:
  
  
**Key Metric Description**
**Yield / FPY Improvement**
First Pass Yield targets across Semiconductor, A&D, and Industrial lines
  
  
**Process Capability (Cp/Cpk)**
Statistical process control where applicable; drives repeatability
  
  
**Cycle Time Reduction**
Throughput improvements and bottleneck elimination
  
  
**Scrap & Cost Reduction**
Waste elimination via Lean and Six Sigma initiatives
  
  
**NPI Launch Success & Speed**
On-time, on-spec new product introductions with validated processes
  
  
**Process Stability & Repeatability**
Standardized work instructions and documented best practices
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* 10–15 years of progressive experience in process engineering within a manufacturing environment
* Proven experience in at least one of the following sectors:
* Semiconductor or high-purity manufacturing
* Aerospace & Defense or regulated production environments
* Advanced industrial / engineered product manufacturing
* Strong background in process development, scale-up, and industrialization
* Demonstrated expertise in root cause analysis and structured problem-solving (e.g., 8D, DMAIC)
* Hands-on experience with continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma)
* Proven track record of leading and developing technical engineering teams
* Experience with APQP, PFMEA, and process validation disciplines

**Preferred Experience**

* Exposure to multiple target markets (Semiconductor, A&D, and Industrial) within a single organization
* Familiarity with filtration, flow control, or advanced materials products
* Experience in cleanroom or contamination-sensitive process environments
* Background in highly regulated or high-spec production settings
* Experience operating within multi-site or global manufacturing organizations
* Advanced degree (M.S. or MBA) in a relevant engineering or business discipline

**Leadership Attributes**
**The Successful Candidate Will Demonstrate The Following Characteristics**
**Execution-Focused**
Drives tangible process improvements with measurable, trackable outcomes
  
  
**Technically Strong**
Capable of diagnosing and solving complex, multi-variable manufacturing challenges
  
  
**Hands-On Leader**
Engages directly with the factory floor and engineering teams — not a remote leader
  
  
**Collaborative**
Works effectively across functions; builds trust with Operations, R&D, and Quality peers
  
  
**Continuous Improvement Mindset**
Relentlessly improves processes and performance; never satisfied with the status quo
  
  
**Talent Builder**

**About Mott Corporation**
Mott Corporation is a global leader in the design and manufacture of precision porous metal products and advanced filtration solutions. With decades of innovation, Mott serves customers across the most demanding markets — including Semiconductor, Aerospace & Defense, Life Sciences, and Industrial applications — where performance, purity, and reliability are non-negotiable.
  
  
Mott's manufacturing capabilities include advanced powder metallurgy, sintering, precision machining, and controlled-environment assembly — making process engineering a strategic and highly visible function within the organization.
