records.title: Head of Aircraft Quality (R6146)
records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.
 
 
**About Shield AI**
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense technology company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Our products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies.
 
 
**Job Description**
We’re looking for a hands-on quality leader to take X-BAT from early prototype builds through production launch and into rate production.
 
 
You will build the aircraft quality organization and establish the quality capability for our new Seattle-area production facility, X-Forge 3. You’ll own product and process quality across prototype, pre-series and production builds, ensuring that lessons from development become effective controls as the program scales.
 
 
This role owns the Quality Management System, quality engineering, inspection, nonconformance management and audit readiness for the X-BAT manufacturing operation. You’ll partner with Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Production and Supply Chain to prevent defects, resolve recurring problems and deliver aircraft that meet technical, customer and applicable regulatory requirements.
 
 
We need a technically credible leader who can build practical, scalable systems, make sound decisions under schedule pressure and challenge senior stakeholders constructively while keeping execution moving.
 
 
**What You'll Do**

* Build quality into prototype and launch

+ Lead quality planning and execution for X-BAT prototype and development builds, establishing appropriate inspection, test evidence and build records as designs evolve.
+ Partner with Engineering and Manufacturing Engineering to identify product and process risks, define critical controls and build quality requirements into tooling, work instructions and test plans.
+ Establish configuration and traceability controls with Engineering and Production, ensuring each aircraft’s build status, deviations and nonconformances are understood and documented.
+ Capture lessons from build, integration and test issues, and drive their incorporation into design changes, manufacturing processes and future builds.
+ Define quality readiness criteria for pre-series builds and production launch, validating inspection methods, process controls, workforce competence and closure of significant risks.

**Establish the Seattle quality operation**

* Recruit, develop and lead the quality team, building the technical capability and frontline support needed as aircraft production grows.
* Establish and maintain a lean, effective QMS for X-Forge 3, aligned with Shield AI’s wider quality framework, AS9100, ISO 9001 and applicable customer requirements.
* Lead certification readiness and internal, customer and external audits, driving timely closure and sustained effectiveness of corrective actions.
* Set up receiving, in-process and final inspection capability, including measurement equipment, calibration, training and quality records, in partnership with relevant functions.

**Deliver quality at rate**

* Own production quality performance, using first-pass yield, defects, rework and escapes to focus action where it improves aircraft quality and production flow.
* Lead containment, root cause analysis and corrective action for manufacturing quality issues, with clear functional ownership and verification that fixes prevent recurrence.
* Own the nonconformance and MRB process, ensuring disposition decisions follow approved technical authority and that affected hardware remains controlled.
* Partner with Supply Chain and supplier quality teams to resolve incoming quality issues and improve supplier performance before defects disrupt aircraft builds.
* Work with Engineering and Production to define acceptance evidence and ensure aircraft meet approved requirements before release.
* Use digital quality tools and manufacturing data to strengthen traceability, expose trends and reduce manual administration as production scales.
* Give leadership a clear view of quality performance, product risks and readiness; escalate or stop affected work when requirements or product integrity cannot be assured.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, quality or a related technical field.
* 10+ years of leadership experience in quality, product assurance or reliability within aerospace, defense technology or high-reliability manufacturing.
* Demonstrated success leading quality through prototype or new product introduction and into sustained production.
* Proven ability to build and scale quality teams and systems while supporting fast-paced development and manufacturing operations.
* Deep expertise in containment, root cause analysis, MRB, corrective and preventive action, and continuous improvement.
* Strong working knowledge of AS9100 and ISO 9001, with practical implementation and audit leadership experience.
* Experience with complex assembly, inspection, configuration control, traceability and product acceptance.
* Ability to influence and challenge senior leaders constructively across Engineering, Production and Supply Chain.
* A hands-on leadership style and sound technical judgment, balancing timely execution with clear quality standards and accountability.

records.title: Plant Manager I
records.description:
This position leads all plant operations for a70+ employee, 2 shift, manufacturing site. This leader ensures day-to-day operations are delivered with the aligned objectives of safety-first mindset, customer satisfaction along with growing and developing the leaders within the facility. This position also plays a critical role in developing and executing capital project plans for the facility to enable continuous improvement and growth in market share.

This full-time position reports directly to region General Manager and is located at Liberty Packaging’s manufacturing plant in Houston, Texas

**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Directly lead and supervise a team of direct reports to deliver major site functions across manufacturing, shipping, maintenance, and scheduling.
* Own end-to-end performance for the facility to meet KPIs in the areas of Safety, Quality, Cost, and Delivery. Establish, measure, and monitor performance across facility and root cause performance issues. Develop and deploy plans to drive improvements in manufacturing processes to ensure superior product quality, reduced cycle times, lead times, and minimize overall manufacturing costs.
* Provide day-to-day leadership for manufacturing team decision-making in the areas of production, labor, material costs, design, and production scheduling.
* In partnership with Continuous Improvement function, guide leaders and front-line staff through the identification and deployment of continuous improvement initiatives with an impact on key performance indicators.
* Ensure the right talent and capabilities are in place to meet strategic objectives; accountable for establishing goals, managing performance, and developing teams to ensure short- and long-range objectives are achieved
* Establish a two-way communication & engagement culture to ensure all plant employees are clear on plant performance and connection to business performance, including KPIs.
* Lead key change initiatives across the plant in partnership with regional and functional support systems (e.g., continuous improvement, engineering, human resources, sales, etc.)
* Lead the successful identification, business case design, and execution of capital projects in partnership with functional teams and executive leadership. Ensure multi-year capital plans support market growth and customer delivery
* Ensure employee relations stay connected with open and continuous dialogue
* Develop and grow community engagement presence by representing plant locally in key activities and through execution of frequent employee and community engagement activities
* Own direct P&L responsibility for plant site
* Provide leadership by connecting and being visible to all three shifts daily
* Other duties, as assigned

**Required Education, Experience And Skills**

* Bachelors’ degree and 7+ years manufacturing experience OR 10+ years manufacturing industry experience in lieu of education
* 5+ years people leadership experience
* Experience analyzing downtime, production, and financial variance trends, and identifying actions to deliver expected performance
* Previous experience developing and managing a budget, forecasting, and monitoring results
* Experience with identifying and executing capital projects to drive improvement against KPIs
* Demonstrated experience with organizational effectiveness, operations management, and a proven track record of achieving results
* Experience developing and presenting information to multiple levels of the organization from front-line to executive leadership
* Superior time management, attention to detail, verbal and written communication skills, decision-making, and organization skills
* Excellent computer skills required, including Microsoft Word and Excel skills.
* Demonstrated entrepreneurial spirit

**Preferred Education, Experience And Skills**

* Previous experience with Amtech / CTI or Kiwi
* Previous experience with ERP systems
* Previous experience in corrugated or paper manufacturing
* Lean and / or Continuous Improvement certifications
* Bilingual English / Spanish

**Compensation & Benefits**

The starting base salary range for this position is $110,078 - $137,598 per year plus eligibility in annual bonus program. The compensation posted is the anticipated pay for the position at the time of the posting. We may pay above or below posted amount based on several factors, including, but not limited to education and/or certifications, skills, experience, or work location. Some positions may qualify for additional compensation in the form of bonuses or deferred compensation options.

At LDI, we are pleased to provide employees with a comprehensive benefits package including health/dental/vision insurance options; paid time off; 10 paid holidays; 401(k) plus company matching and annual discretionary profit sharing; flexible spending and health savings account options; life and disability insurance; tuition assistance; wellness and mental health resources, and financial advising services. Eligibility in benefit programs is based on hours worked per week.

**Physical Requirements**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Regular sitting, standing, and walking throughout the day to accomplish tasks
* Manual and finger dexterity used regularly with some repetitive finger motions
* Ability to work in front of a computer screen for long periods of time
* Specific vision abilities include close and distance vision; able to identify colors, small letters, and numbers; hand/eye coordination, depth perception and able to adjust focus
* Hearing and speaking
* Other conditions may include frequent reaching, stretching, pushing, pulling, pinching, grasping, and gripping.

**About Our Company**

Comprised of multiple companies with headquarters in New Hope, Minnesota, Liberty Diversified International (LDI) is a privately held company employing more than 1,900 individuals across our manufacturing facilities, production facilities and core business operations in Minnesota, Iowa, Nebraska, Illinois, Mississippi, Texas, Arizona, Virginia, California, and Mexico. With deep roots in the corrugated box manufacturing industry, we operate in the core markets of paper, packaging, workplace products, corrugated plastics and building products.

Since 1918, our values – Caring, Innovation, Trust and Excellence – have guided our day-to-day activities. We believe that when our employees are aligned with these values, we create superior service and solutions for our customers. The LDI family of companies includes Liberty Packaging, Liberty Paper, Liberty Plastics (Custom Solutions and Quarrix Building Products) and Safco.

Liberty Diversified International is an equal opportunity employer and makes all employment decisions without regard to race, color, sex, religion, age, creed, sexual orientation, national origin, marital status, disability, or any other protected class.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
Job ID: 529086
 
 
Ash Grove family of companies is one of North America's leading cement manufacturers, with a legacy of innovation and excellence dating back to 1882. The company operates 12 world-class cement plants and a vast network of 41 terminals across the United States and Canada. Renowned for its forward-thinking approach, Ash Grove combines technical expertise, robust safety standards, and empowered talent to deliver high performance and better serve our customers. At Ash Grove, we stand together to reinvent the way our world is built.
 
 
To learn more about us go to www.ashgrove.com
 
 
\*\*At Ash Grove Cement, people are our first priority. We offer a complete benefits package to include:\*\*
 
 

* \*\*Health Insurance\*\*
* \*\*Dental Insurance\*\*
* \*\*Vision Insurance\*\*
* \*\*Retirement Plan\*\*
* \*\*Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays\*\*
* \*\*Tuition Reimbursement\*\*
* \*\*Employee Assistance Program\*\*
* \*\*Disability Pay\*\*
* \*\*Life Insurance\*\*
* \*\*Growth Opportunities and more!\*\*

**Summary**
The Plant Manager plans, coordinates, and supervises the production operations, hazardous waste fuel program, maintenance activities, quality and safety programs, and other related functions involved in plant operations. This position incorporates directives provided by corporate management into policies and procedures to maintain standards and schedules. The position exercises direct or indirect supervision over a large number of employees.
 
 
**What You'll Be Contributing**

* Promote and follow all plant safety guidelines.
* Conducts meetings with plant staff personnel to communicate, coordinate and discuss plant operations.
* Monitors, inspects, and reviews all plant activities.
* Ensures production schedule corresponds with sales forecasts.
* Assists in investigating customer and quality problems and concerns.
* Meets with government agencies and community groups concerning plant activities to ensure compliance with environmental regulations, policies, and standards.
* Prepares regular reports regarding plant production operations.
* Attends Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) training for waste-derived fuel activities.
* Promotes effective job performance through motivation, goals, and providing feedback.
* Promotes the safety program, compliance with safety standards, and participates in safety meetings.
* Establishes plant standards, short-term goals, and long-term strategic plans for production, maintenance, and improvements.
* Discusses new products, equipment, and ideas with staff and vendors.
* Analyzes plant costs and explore methods to improve productivity cost-effectively.
* Uses technology to develop a continuous improvement plan for the plant.
* Troubleshoots various problems and performance barriers.
* Additional duties as assigned by supervisor.

**To Succeed In This Position, You Will Need**

* Ability to read, write, and understand warning labels, instructions, signs, etc.
* Minimum 4 Year - Bachelors Degree in engineering, chemistry, natural sciences, business administration, or closely related field.
* Professional Engineer (PE) preferred
* Ability to develop and deliver effective presentations
* Ability to make decisions and solve problems with high attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to make sound independent judgments regularly
* Ability to effectively coach and deliver constructive feedback
* Ability to inspire and develop staff
* Proficient in effective negotiation skills in business and construction contracts
* Proficient in Microsoft Office365
* Ability to effectively use computers for general word processing, spreadsheets, presentations, e-mail, internet, and customized company programs.
* Ability to communicate the company's vision into actionable goals and contributions for plant personnel.
* Ability to network with industry professionals, consultants, vendors, suppliers, regulators, and the community.
* Knowledge of safety and environmental health regulations.
* Knowledge of cement chemistry, physical testing, and concrete performance.
* Knowledge of various systems for cement manufacturing (crushing, grinding, pyro processing, chemistry).
* Ability to work from general policies and procedures.
* Ability to refer to supervisor when clarification or interpretation of the organizational policy
* What's next for you?\*\*

We provide stability and advancement opportunities across North America. Use our tuition reimbursement program to help you meet your career goals.
 
 
\_The above duties and responsibilities are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive. The physical demands, working environment, and other conditions of employment listed in this document are representative of but are not intended to provide an exhaustive list of the requirements for positions in this classification. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.\_
 
 
\*\*What CRH Offers You\*\*
 
 

* Highly competitive base pay
* Comprehensive medical, dental and disability benefits programs
* Group retirement savings program
* Health and wellness programs
* An inclusive culture that values opportunity for growth, development, and internal promotion

\*\*About CRH\*\*
 
 
CRH has a long and proud heritage. We are a collection of hundreds of family businesses, regional companies and large enterprises that together form the CRH family. CRH operates in a decentralized, diversified structure that allows you to work in a small company environment while having the career opportunities of a large international organization.
 
 
If you're up for a rewarding challenge, we invite you to take the first step and apply today! Once you click apply now, you will be brought to our official employment application. Please complete your online profile and it will be sent to the hiring manager. Our system allows you to view and track your status 24 hours a day. Thank you for your interest!
 
 
Ash Grove Cement, a CRH Company, is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer.
 
 
EOE/Vet/Disability
 
 
CRH is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.
 
 
AI tools may be used in certain stages of the employment lifecycle, such as candidate review; however, all final employment decisions will be made by a person.

records.description:
**About The Position**
****Plant Manager at FRC, a Clarience Technologies Company****
****Location: Nesconset, NY****
****﻿****
****﻿New York Annual Salary Range: $145,000 - $175,000 USD****
****﻿****
Position Summary
 
 
****FRC****
, a Clarience Technologies company, is a leading manufacturer and innovator of firefighting and emergency response technologies serving fire apparatus OEMs, dealers, and fire departments throughout North America. FRC develops industry-leading solutions including fire apparatus controls, pressure governors, instrumentation, LED scene lighting, electronic control systems, and FoamPro® foam injection and proportioning systems.
 
 
The
****Plant Manager****
leads a manufacturing operation of approximately 80 employees across 2 shifts and is responsible for Production, Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, and Facilities. This role is accountable for driving a world-class safety culture, delivering revenue and profitability objectives, achieving quality and operational performance targets, and leading continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.
 
 
As a key member of the leadership team, the Plant Manager will develop and execute operational strategies that support growth, innovation, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence.
 
 
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Safety Leadership
* Champion and drive a proactive safety culture.
* Ensure achievement of targeted safety metrics.
* Lead safety initiatives, investigations and corrective actions.
* Operational Leadership
* Lead Production, Manufacturing Engineering, Facilities and Quality functions.
* Provide weekly revenue forecasts and operational updates.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen and continuous improvement efforts.
* Support new product introductions and manufacturing readiness.
* Financial Management
* Manage labor, variable overhead and fixed overhead costs.
* Achieve gross margin objectives and operational budgets.
* Lead cost reduction and productivity improvement initiatives.
* Quality Management
* Develop and implement the Quality Management System.
* Drive quality metrics, corrective actions and continuous improvement.
* Ensure customer quality requirements are achieved.
* Leadership and Talent Development
* Lead supervisors and functional managers.
* Develop organizational capability and succession plans.
* Partner with HR on employee development and workforce planning.

**Managerial Responsibilities**

* Directly manages departmental supervisors and functional leaders within Production, Manufacturing Engineering, Facilities, and Quality. Procurement and Scheduling report directly to the President and are not part of this role’s reporting structure.

****Competencies****

* Leadership and team development
* Financial and business acumen
* Operational excellence mindset
* Strong communication and influence skills
* Data-driven decision making
* Problem solving and continuous improvement
* Integrity, accountability and results orientation

*****﻿*****
**\*We do not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, marital status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, disability, ancestry veteran status or any other status protected by law.**
**Requirements**
****Education and Experience****

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Manufacturing, Business or related field preferred.
* 7-10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* Experience managing revenue, labor, overhead and gross margin performance.
* Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement experience required.

**Computer Skills**

* ERP/MRP systems
* Microsoft Office Suite
* Manufacturing reporting tools
* Workforce/timekeeping systems

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
**Atlas Molded Products**
- a Division of
**Atlas Roofing Corporation**
- specializes in the development and manufacture of innovative, high-quality, HFC- and HCGC- free Expanded Polystyrene (EPS) insulation for construction, packaging, and original equipment management (OEM) products. Atlas EPS insulation is suitable for interior and exterior construction applications, various packaging uses and as part of manufactured systems, such as recreational vehicles, garage and pedestrian doors and sunroom panels.
 
 
**Atlas Roofing Corporation,**
a privately owned company established in 1982, is an international and multi-divisional manufacturer of roofing, sheathing, facer, and insulation product solutions.
 
 
**Atlas Molded Products is seeking a Plant Manager for the Murray, Utah Facility.**
**Plant Manager Primary Responsibilities**

* Responsible for all safety, product quality, company culture/values, operational performance, environmental health and safety compliance and all local, state, and federal standards.
* Coordinate all aspects of plant operations through plant leadership to ensure the site meets or exceeds the key performance indicators for safety, quality, and service while minimizing cost, inventory, and waste.
* Implement cost effective systems of control over capital, operating expenditures, manpower, wages, and salaries in line with corporate guidance.
* Serve as plant champion for safety and quality programs and initiatives. Ensure a safe work environment through strict adherence to Atlas’ safety policies and procedures with focus on developing a zero-injury culture.
* Achieve manufacturing profit objectives to meet quality and delivery requirements (Customer Service) at the lowest overall cost.
* Support Engineering with product improvements, new product development, and testing.
* Manage capital equipment selection, acquisition, and implementation, manufacturing budget and long-range planning, preparation, and facility maintenance and enhancements.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement within the workplace.
* Responsible for selection of development of direct reports and creating an atmosphere of career development within the facility.
* Establish and maintain clear and measurable expectations for each employee to build ownership within the team.
* Complete all administrative requirements (monthly reports, manufacturing reports and analysis, etc.)

**Plant Manager Experience**

* Ten years of progressive experience in manufacturing management experience required.
* 5+ years direct supervisory experience, including staff development and planning responsibility.
* 5+ years’ experience engaging employees and developing a strong safety culture.
* Experience with business financial statements, budgetary processes, and cost control.
* Proven track record of developing, leading, and maintaining a continuous improvement mindset.
* Experience in capital investment planning and program management.
* Experience with Environmental, Health and Safety regulatory compliance.

**Plant Manager Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* An ability to balance and achieve positive results in the areas of safety, quality, productivity, cost, and employee relations.
* A demonstrated ability to lead people and get results through others.
* Analytic skills to effectively evaluate business proposals and analyze process data.
* Ability to multi-task effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Proficient with MS Office and experienced with manufacturing ERP systems.
* Must have a flexible schedule and be able to work extended hours if needed per business needs.

**Plant Manager Education, Licenses & Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree (B.A. or B.S.) in related field preferred; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Plant Manager Additional Information**

* Must be able to tolerate industrial/manufacturing environment to include variations in temperature from extreme cold to extreme heat; wet and/or humid conditions; dust/fumes/chemical exposure; and noise intensity. Personal protective equipment required.

**Total Compensation**

* Atlas Molded Products offers a competitive compensation and vacation/holiday package as well as a comprehensive benefits program including Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Life/AD&D/LTD insurance, 401k and Medical & Dependent Care Spending Accounts.

**Atlas Roofing Corporation**
is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer
 
 
***No calls or agencies please.***

records.description:
Plant Manager – Manufacturing Operations
 
 
**Atlas Roofing Corporation | Ardmore, Oklahoma**
**Division:**
Roof Shingles & Underlayments
 
 
Position Overview
 
 
Atlas Roofing Corporation is seeking an experienced, results-driven
**Plant Manager**
to lead our manufacturing operations in Ardmore, Oklahoma.
 
 
The ideal candidate is a hands-on manufacturing leader with proven experience in
**plant turnarounds, continuous manufacturing operations, operational excellence, and financial management**
. This individual will be responsible for driving plant performance, developing high-performing teams, improving profitability, and maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, and operational efficiency.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 
 

* Plant Operations: Oversee all aspects of manufacturing operations, including production, maintenance, quality, inventory, and workforce performance.
* Operational Improvement: Lead plant turnaround initiatives, continuous improvement (CI) programs, and strategies to reduce downtime, increase productivity, and improve equipment reliability.
* Financial Management: Maintain plant-level P&L accountability, manage operating budgets and capital expenditures, and implement cost-reduction strategies.
* Safety & Compliance: Champion environmental, health, and safety (EHS) initiatives while ensuring compliance with OSHA, EPA, EEO, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Leadership & Labor Relations: Lead and develop plant management teams, oversee salaried and hourly employees, and manage labor relations within a unionized manufacturing environment.
* Quality & Performance: Drive improvements in product quality, inventory accuracy, production efficiency, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Strategic Planning: Support long-term plant planning, capital investments, equipment upgrades, and operational growth.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing and operations leadership experience, including plant-level management responsibilities.
* Proven success leading plant turnarounds, operational recovery, or significant performance improvement initiatives.
* Experience managing continuous manufacturing or continuous-process operations.
* Demonstrated P&L accountability, budgeting, financial analysis, capital planning, and cost-reduction experience.
* Experience managing production, quality, inventory, maintenance, and equipment downtime.
* Strong background in EHS accountability, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Experience managing labor relations and employee performance within a unionized manufacturing facility.
* Proven ability to develop leaders, improve operational KPIs, and drive measurable business results.
* Strong communication, decision-making, and analytical skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in roofing, building materials, asphalt-based products, or other capital-intensive manufacturing environments.
* Working knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, TPM, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).
* Experience leading equipment modernization, plant expansion, and major capital improvement projects.

Why Atlas Roofing Corporation?
 
 
At Atlas Roofing Corporation, you'll have the opportunity to lead a manufacturing facility, develop talented teams, and make a measurable impact on operational performance and business success.
 
 
We offer a competitive total compensation package, including paid vacation and holidays, 401(k), health and dental insurance, basic life insurance, and AD&D coverage.
 
 
**Travel:**
Frequent, based on business needs.
 
 
Join Our Team
 
 
If you're a proven manufacturing leader who thrives on improving operations, developing people, and delivering results, we encourage you to apply.
 
 
*Atlas Roofing Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.*
*No calls or agencies, please.*

records.title: Plant Manager
records.description:
Resource Label Group is seeking a
**Plant Manager**
for our Brooklyn Center, MN Operations team who will be responsible for leading and directing a variety of activities to ensure a successful achievement of day-to-day and growth goals. The ideal candidate will influence a positive work environment that drives a proactive culture of safety and employee engagement, while providing leadership to the overall operations of the Cypress Multigraphics facility.
 
 
**The Ideal Candidate Will**

* Manage the location’s budget by maintaining service levels to our customers while striving to improve safety, quality, efficiency, and productivity standards to drive a “Best in Class” culture.
* Forward thinker and action-oriented Manager, with the motivation to lead a team with a “Have Fun, Get It Done” attitude.
* Collaboratively engage with local leadership to analyze safety, quality, production, and maintenance metrics; determine causes of nonconformity to improve operational excellence and inspire change.

**Responsibilities**

* Work with your team to manage day-to-day operations to execute business plans that align with company goals and overall strategic vision.
* Oversee and drive improvements in production to meet short-term and long-term objectives to achieve optimum efficiency.
* Build a high performing team by establishing strong performance standards and continuously work to grow and develop team members.
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives tied to the strategic business direction; execute thoughtful change management.
* Build partnerships and effectively collaborate with commercial/sales business partners to identify facility growth opportunities and maintain relationships with key accounts.
* Work collaboratively with other cross-functional leaders to best serve the customer’s needs.
* Proactively build and maintain Continuous Improvement deck and Capital Expenditure plans.
* Identify and resolve problems in a timely manner, execute necessary solutions.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of progressive operations management experience in manufacturing setting with direct responsibility for safety, quality, reliability, production, and financial results; Label, Printing, or Packaging industry experience strongly preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or related fields. Master’s Degree preferred.
* Strong knowledge of business and management principles (budgeting, strategic planning, resource allocation and human resources).
* Proven experience in budget and financial management.
* Demonstrated track record of strong goal setting and ability to build, develop, lead, and motivate diverse teams through transformative change.
* Ability to respond quickly to changing demands, processes, and evolving information.
* Excellent communication skills with ability to adjust communication style based on audience

**Posted Pay Range:**
130,000 - 180,000 annually

records.title: Director of Manufacturing Process Engineering
records.description:
**Job Summary**
The Director of Manufacturing Process Engineering is a hands-on leadership role and the process authority for how Butcher Power Products’ switchboard and switchgear products are built. The person in this role must be the subject-matter expert who can also do the work — capable of designing and improving manufacturing processes and line layouts, building routings and process documentation, and personally leading process and PFMEA reviews — so they can teach and develop the manufacturing engineering team and set the standard for process quality. This role owns how products are built rather than what is designed; however, deep familiarity with the product and the production floor is essential. The Director must understand the design intent released by Product Engineering and the realities of the floor in order to engineer processes that are efficient, repeatable, and capable. This role works hand in hand with Product Engineering as the manufacturing voice in the design process, partners with Quality on process controls, and supports Production and Planning rather than owning them.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Hands-On Process Engineering: Personally design, document, and improve the manufacturing processes, routings, work instructions, and line layouts that build the product. This is a working role: the successful candidate stays actively engaged in process design and technical problem-solving alongside the team rather than delegating all hands-on work.
* Process Authority & Technical Review: Lead, critique, and approve the team’s process designs, routings, PFMEAs, and control plans; set and enforce the standard for process quality, capability, and engineering rigor through formal process reviews.
* Mentorship & Teaching: Coach, train, and develop manufacturing engineers and technicians in process design, tooling, DFM/DFA, Lean and Six Sigma, time studies, and structured problem-solving, raising the technical capability of the whole team.
* Leadership & Management: Lead and manage the manufacturing engineering team, including hiring, development, workload balancing, priorities, and performance.
* Process Strategy & Standardization: Own manufacturing process strategy and standardization across product lines, and define the tooling and capital equipment roadmap.
* Product Engineering Partnership (DFM): Work closely and continuously with Product Engineering as the manufacturing voice in the design process — provide manufacturability and assembly feedback at design reviews before release, jointly resolve producibility issues, and ensure released designs transition cleanly into production.
* Process Controls & Quality Partnership: Own the manufacturing side of PFMEAs and control plans in partnership with Quality Engineering; ensure processes are capable, controlled, and continuously monitored.
* Continuous Improvement: Drive Lean, Six Sigma, and Kaizen across the function to improve throughput, cycle time, yield, and cost.
* Capital, Tooling & Automation: Plan and justify capital equipment, tooling, and automation investments, and provide financial management of the manufacturing engineering capital and tooling budgets.
* New Product Introduction (NPI): Lead the process side of NPI — develop and validate the processes, tooling, and routings that bring newly released designs into production.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Production, Planning, Quality, Project Management, and Product Engineering on capacity, scheduling, and material flow, supporting these functions rather than owning them.
* Safety & Compliance: Ensure manufacturing processes across the function comply with safety, environmental, and regulatory standards, including UL 891, NEC, and ANSI.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Industrial, or Mechanical Engineering.
* 8+ years of progressive process engineering (or directly related) experience, including significant time spent personally developing and improving manufacturing processes.
* Hands-on proficiency in SolidWorks for process documentation, line layouts, and reviews; the ability to design tooling and fixtures in CAD is a plus.
* Strong proficiency developing routings, work instructions, process documentation, and process controls.
* Proven ability to lead formal process and PFMEA reviews and to mentor and train engineers and technicians.
* Experience hiring, developing, and managing a manufacturing engineering team.
* Strong working knowledge of PFMEA, control plans, SPC, and process capability (Cpk).
* Deep knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong understanding of the products being built and of how design intent translates into manufacturing process — sufficient product familiarity to engineer the right processes.
* Working knowledge of UL 891 and related standards (NEC, ANSI) as they affect manufacturing processes.
* Experience planning and justifying capital equipment and tooling investments, including financial management of budgets.
* Hands-on fabrication and machining experience is a plus.
* Automation experience is a plus.
* Experience with structured problem-solving methods such as 8D or A3 is a plus.
* Familiarity with ERP/MRP systems, particularly Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365).
* Excellent leadership, project management, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal abilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on manufacturing process design and improvement (CAD)
* Process authority and engineering quality standards
* Technical mentoring, teaching, and team development
* Close partnership with Product Engineering (DFM)
* Process strategy, standardization, and tooling roadmap
* Design-for-manufacturability partnership
* Process controls, PFMEA, and capability
* Continuous improvement and Lean/Six Sigma
* Capital planning, automation, and financial management
* New product introduction (process side)
* Cross-functional collaboration and communication

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on
**Director of Manufacturing Process Engineering**
to lead and develop a manufacturing engineering team within an established electrical equipment manufacturing operation in Rancho Cordova, California.

This is a
**working engineering leadership position**
requiring a strong combination of technical manufacturing expertise, process engineering experience, and team leadership.

The ideal candidate will have direct experience manufacturing
**low- and medium-voltage switchgear, switchboards, electrical power distribution equipment, or related electrical products**
.

This individual will take ownership of manufacturing processes, production efficiency, engineering standards, and continuous improvement initiatives while mentoring and developing a team of manufacturing engineers and technicians.

* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of manufacturing engineers and technicians.
* Personally develop, implement, and optimize manufacturing processes, production routings, work instructions, and facility layouts.
* Lead Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) reviews, control plans, and process capability improvements.
* Apply Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Statistical Process Control (SPC), and continuous improvement methodologies.

records.title: Director of Manufacturing Launch
records.description:
Job Type
 
 
Full-time
 
 
**Description**
BLOX designs, manufactures, and constructs buildings and delivers them as products across the country. DesignManufactureConstruct is the system we use. DMC moves complexity to the left: work the industry solves in the field, we move to the factory; work the factory struggles with, we eliminate at design. Manufacturing runs as a visually controlled, continuous-flow pull system, managed to takt with the minimal buffers required to stabilize flow. The BLOX system works, proven through multiple products and launches. Our next step is to encode that experience into a manufacturing launch system that is repeatable, teachable, and capable of supporting the scale ahead of us. That means converting what our best people know into standard work, tooling, interfaces, controls, and training. It also means knowing which parts of the system are load-bearing, where volume creates pressure, and having the judgment to strengthen or replace what no longer serves the work. Growth will test every system. Our job is to be ready first.
 
 
The Director of Manufacturing Launch owns manufacturing setup in Launch, from design and first-of-a-kind production through ramp to stabilization, until a building can be consistently produced as a Product. Launch runs as a horizontal through the verticals, and it has three leaders: design, manufacturing, and program management. You are manufacturing. You control line setup, standard work, tooling, takt, and training. You do not control product design, supply chain, construction, or the customer, but you work with and influence all. Each of the three launch leaders builds a team beneath them, all held to one goal. You build the manufacturing launch team, and you resolve manufacturability while the work is still in design. Then you document the baseline, train the operations team, transfer the role, and repeat. Nothing gets thrown over a wall. A line is not finished until the people running it can run it without you.
 
 
**Requirements**
We are completing the launch and stabilization of a major product, with a strong pipeline behind it. Current-line attainment and new-product launch are distinct jobs, and this role exists so both can be done well. Your mandate is to build on what BLOX has already learned and make launch repeatable. We are looking for:
 
 

* A manufacturing expert. Layout, flow, takt, tooling, line-side setup. Has built lines, not just improved them.
* A process expert. Standard work, first-pass yield, the discipline to prove a method before scaling it and to replace it when the evidence says you should.
* A systems thinker. Understands design, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and field installation, and resolves problems where they are best eliminated.
* A team builder. Hires, teaches, and promotes engineers who outgrow the org chart.
* A simplifier. Drives to the simple answer on the far side of the complex one, and does the work to get there.

Our team is strong. They built this system and accomplished more, faster, than most teams ever attempt, and they are accountable for attainment on the line running today. Our growth now supports separating manufacturing launch leadership from steady-state operational leadership.
 
 
We build like a startup and operate like a manufacturer: if you have only worked where the plant, the budget, and the org chart already existed, this will be uncomfortable. Five years out: a billion dollars, the same system running across multiple factories, DMC at meaningful scale, and a system capable of helping reshape the fastest-growing sector in building. DMC belongs to the industry, not to us, so what you encode here does not stay here. This is not a place to move a thousandth in a decade. Here, you matter.
 
 
The seat: Director of Manufacturing Launch, reporting to the COO in close partnership with the CEO. Based in Birmingham, Alabama, with occasional travel to launch sites.
 
 
**Benefits**
BLOX offers the full spectrum of comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision insurance. We also offer flexible spending accounts, paid time off, short term disability, long term disability, life insurance and a 401k plan.
 
 
It is the policy of BLOX LLC to use ability and willingness to contribute to our team effort as the criteria for making employment related decisions, regardless of an individual’s race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or other protected status. In addition, we strictly prohibit the harassment of any employee because of his/her race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation and gender identity), disability, or other protected status.

records.title: Sr. Manager, Optimus Operations
records.description:
**What To Expect**
The Senior Manager, Optimus Operations sets the vision and strategic path for Production, Maintenance, and Engineering within a major shop at Tesla’s new Optimus Factory in Austin, Texas. Openings span operations leadership across multiple shops—including Plastics, Machining, Actuators, and Assembly. Each role leads their shop teams and cross-functional partners to achieve Safety, People, Quality, Production/Delivery, and Cost KPI targets.
 
 
This role is responsible for production and resource planning; coaching, mentoring, and developing leaders; launching new Optimus manufacturing processes and programs successfully; and daily tactical planning and execution to achieve the build plan and meet safety, quality, rate, and cost targets. The person in this role must guide the team through complex issues, distill large volumes of data to solve problems, and drive day-over-day continuous improvement in a high-volume, high-precision factory environment.
 
 
This Senior Manager provides hands-on support, leadership, and direction on all operational, team morale, and equipment-related matters. The person in this role builds teams that work cohesively and perform at the highest level—keeping Tesla’s mission and the goals of the Optimus program in mind—while partnering closely with peer shop leaders and factory leadership across the Austin Optimus Factory.
 
 
**What You'll Do**- Set the vision and strategic path for Production and Maintenance in an assigned Optimus shop and lead the team to Safety, People, Quality, Production, and Cost KPI targets
- Drive tactical planning to hit the production build plan with the highest safety, quality, and yield, including identifying bottlenecks and addressing availability, efficiency, and yield constraints
- Launch new Optimus programs and lead production ramps and product/process design changes through resource planning, program management, and partnership with NPI, Manufacturing Engineering, Design Engineering, Quality, and Supply Chain
- Guide the team through root cause analysis, first-principles thinking, and data-driven problem solving while maintaining standardized work and quality/safety compliance
- Coach, mentor, and develop Production, Maintenance, and Engineering leaders, instill process standardization and training, and drive continuous improvement
- Lead the maintenance organization on equipment availability, preventive and predictive maintenance, spare parts strategy, and uptime improvements for shop-critical assets
- Build a high-performing team with clear goals and feedback, improve morale with HR, and collaborate with peer shop Senior Managers to share best practices
**What You'll Bring**- Degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Materials, or Industrial Engineering preferred, or equivalent experience
- 7–10 years of leadership and manufacturing experience, preferably in automotive, robotics, plastics, precision machining, electromechanical assembly/actuators, general assembly, or another highly technical manufacturing environment
- Analytical, detail-oriented, self-driven critical thinker who communicates proactively and works well in a fast-paced, multicultural factory environment
- Experience with process-improvement methodologies, DOE/statistical methods, lean and world-class manufacturing practices, and standing up or ramping new factories, shops, or production lines
- Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to work under pressure, juggle competing priorities, and meet tight deadlines
- Ability to use structured problem-solving methods such as 8D, fishbone diagrams, and 5-Why analysis to resolve production problems
- High-level leadership and decision-making skills with a strong sense of urgency in a greenfield/new-factory ramp, plus proficiency in MS Office, Visio, CAD, SPC, data-analysis tools, Jira, Tableau/BI dashboards, and project-management tools
**Benefits**
Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:
 
- Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
- Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
- Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
- Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
- Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
- 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
- Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
- Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
- Employee Assistance Program
- Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
- Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
- Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
- Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
- Tesla Babies program
- Commuter benefits
- Employee discounts and perks program
- Earned Wage Access: Real-time pay access paid daily, subject to eligibility and schedule (applicable for below Sr. Managers levels)
, Tesla

records.title: Sr Manager, Manufacturing - Electronics
records.description:
**About Advanced Energy**
Advanced Energy (Nasdaq: AEIS) is a global leader in the design and manufacturing of highly engineered, precision power conversion, measurement and control solutions for mission-critical applications and processes. AE’s power solutions enable customer innovation in complex applications for a wide range of industries including semiconductor equipment, industrial, manufacturing, telecommunications, data center computing and healthcare. Advanced Energy has devoted four decades to perfecting power for its global customers and is headquartered in Denver, Colorado.
 
 
Position Summary
 
 
The
**Senior Manager, Manufacturing**
is responsible for leading manufacturing operations across multiple AE locations, with a focus on
**complex electronic and electromechanical products and assemblies**
. This role ensures production efficiency, product quality, delivery performance, safety, and cost effectiveness while providing strategic and hands-on leadership to manufacturing supervisors and production teams.
 
 
Success in this role requires strong people leadership, strategic thinking, and significant practical experience in
**electronics, semiconductor, optics or high-tech manufacturing**
.
 
 
**Qualifications**
Required
 
 

* 8+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing operations, including at least 3 years in a manufacturing leadership role.
* Demonstrated manufacturing experience in electronics, electromechanical systems, semiconductor equipment, or other complex technical products.
* Practical knowledge of electronics manufacturing processes, such as PCB/PCBA assembly, electronic and electromechanical assembly, production testing, troubleshooting, inspection, and repair/rework.
* Experience managing manufacturing environments requiring disciplined process control, traceability, quality management, and configuration/change control.
* Demonstrated success applying Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, root-cause analysis, and structured continuous-improvement methods.
* Strong working knowledge of ERP/MRP systems and production-planning processes, including material requirements, capacity planning, scheduling, and inventory management.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop manufacturing supervisors and production teams.
* Experience partnering with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and Product/Program teams to resolve production issues and support new product introductions.

records.description:
**Standard Job Description**
This position is for a Chief Engineering Sr. Manager for the JASSM program in the Strike Systems program area. The successful candidate will report to the JASSM Program Chief Engineer programmatically and lead the Engineering & Technology (E&T) team supporting JASSM production. The candidate will work closely with the JASSM Chief Engineering staff to coordinate tasks and share lessons learned, and with other Strike Systems Chief Engineers to support cross-program collaboration.
 
 
**What You Will Be Doing**
As the JASSM Production Chief Engineer, you will be responsible for:
 
 

* Leading the E&T team supporting JASSM production, working with suppliers and factories to sustain production operations and meet program and corporate milestones.
* Providing Technical and Programmatic leadership/oversight on production rate increases in support of both USG and FMS customers.
* Providing leadership and oversight for transition to production of new JASSM variants and second source suppliers.
* Developing a productive partnership and trusting relationship with the JPO customer through effective communication and collaboration.
* Partnering with Program Management, Production Operations, Supply Chain, and Quality to communicate engineering assessments and align engineering priorities with program needs.
* Guiding Engineering team, IPT leads and cross-functional teams in program planning, scheduling, trade studies, design concepts, verification, and critical life cycle reviews.
* Ensuring program staffing is appropriate from an E&T perspective.
* Collaborating with Engineering Excellence management to ensure program milestones are successfully completed.
* Supporting and leading program technical reviews and participating in monthly E&T meetings, staff meetings, and other critical program activities.
* Sharing lessons learned and coordinating tasks with the entire Chief Engineer staff

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide technical leadership for production execution, transition to production, and supporting proposal activities.
* Protect system integrity and reliability while supporting opportunities to improve production efficiency and reduce cost.
* Develop and execute engineering plans, schedules, and trade study analyses that support production commitments.
* Lead or support customer briefings, weekly IPT status updates, Technical Interchange Meetings, Technical Readiness Reviews, and other critical program reviews.
* Lead technical investigations with urgency, communicate results to program leadership and the customer, and participate in Failure Review Boards, Risk Management, and Mission Success Reviews.
* Support technical reviews internally, with the customer, and external stakeholders, and at supplier locations.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Have a minimum of a bachelor’s degree in engineering from an accredited college or university, with existing professional experience.
* Experience and demonstrated skill set with missile systems design, development, and production support.
* Must possess ability to plan and lead the technical teams/efforts associated with Complex Missile Systems.
* Candidate will be required to communicate technical status and issues internally to program leadership, technical leadership and functional leadership as well as externally to the USG customer.
* Must be available for occasional domestic travel.
* Candidate must have a Secret clearance..

**Desired Skills**

* An advanced degree in engineering from an accredited college or university is desired.
* Prior experience at Lockheed Martin Missiles and Fire Control is highly desired.
* Candidate should have wide experience/familiarity in collaborating with the Engineering & Technology functional organization.
* Ability to interface with the USG Customer office and global supply base.
* Ability to support technical reviews internally, with the customer, and external stakeholders, and at supplier locations.
* Experience in leading Failure Analysis and Failure Review Boards.
* Experience leading technical teams through major proposal efforts.

**Pay Information**
Full-Time Salary Range: $182500.00 - $338900.00
 
 
At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.
 
 
The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.
 
 
**Benefits offered:**
Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.
 
 

* Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
* For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

records.description:
**About Us**
Centric Brands is a leading lifestyle brand collective that designs, sources, markets and sells high quality products in multiple segments, including women’s, men’s and kid’s apparel, accessories, entertainment and beauty. Centric Brands is focused on our customers and our brands that will drive the company’s future growth. We are defined by innovation as we seize new opportunities and thrive in an environment informed by creativity and thinking that is both analytical and outside the box. Centric Brands reflects a team built on respect, for others and for the ha rd work it takes to achieve our goals and build our bright future together.
 
 
**Product Development**
From sourcing raw material s to manufacturing, order placement, pricing, quality control and getting the finished product where it needs to be, our production/product development team is responsible for ensuring we keep our standards high and our business profitable at every step of the journey. If you are a focused, results-driven, tenacious and highly flexible team player, we’ll give you every opportunity to build a rewarding career with one of the world’s foremost major lifestyle brand collectives.
 
 
**Specific Responsibilities Would Include**
The Director, Sourcing and Product Development reports to the VP of Production for Robert Graham/Saks and will drive seasonal product initiatives by partnering with cross-functional teams, including Production, Design, Sales, and Overseas Offices, to develop and execute assigned product lines. The role primarily focuses on apparel development, with additional responsibility for trims and packaging across Robert Graham and Saks Fifth Avenue Private Label.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and manage all aspects of the product development process, from concept and inspiration through quality assurance of finished goods to the end customer.
* Establish shared qualities and fabrics between Robert Graham and Saks Fifth Avenue to ensure alignment across brands.
* Partner closely with overseas hubs and vendor teams to ensure understanding of departmental objectives and leverage vendor capabilities to drive initiatives that expand competencies as needed.
* Analyze product costs, identifying opportunities and collaborating cross-functionally to create solutions through product engineering that maximize product value while accounting for cost impact.
* Oversee cross-functional milestone performance; communicate risks, deadlines, and business impacts when deliverables are at risk.
* Lead vendor sourcing initiatives aligned with driving innovation and service within the overall sourcing strategy.
* Manage new vendor onboarding and ensure all internal partners are connected and prepared to support production needs.
* Facilitate vendor meetings to review in-season development, production, and delivery challenges, and drive solutions.
* Identify business risks and opportunities, escalate appropriately, and propose actionable recommendations for improvement.
* Collaborate closely with Design and Merchandising on product creation from concept to execution, utilizing budget and SKU plans.
* Create and maintain comprehensive material and product libraries with detailed product attributes and testing documentation.

**Our Best Fit Candidate Would Have**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook); advanced Adobe, Photoshop and Illustrator skills required
* SAP experience preferred
* Excellent organizational, written, and verbal communication skills
* Strong team orientation and ability to work cross-functionally
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
* High attention to detail and accuracy
* Knowledge of garment manufacturing, construction, and fabrication

Salary Range: $125,000 - $145,000
 
 
At Centric Brands, we believe our people are our greatest asset, and we seek to structure competitive compensation offers to ensure that we are able to attract and retain the best talent. Our job postings include an annual base salary range at the time of employment. The stated base salary range represents our good faith estimate as to what candidates are likely to expect, and we tailor our offers within the range based on several factors, including the selected candidate's educational and professional experience, industry knowledge, location, technical and communication skills, and other factors that may prove relevant during the selection process. Base salary is a part of a total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, annual bonus and other Centric Brands sponsored benefit programs.
 
 
**Be part of our growing community by getting involved with groups, teams and initiatives like Be Green, Be Giving, and Be Celebrated.**
**Centric Brands is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
Please note that Centric Brands will only reach out to interview, make an offer of employment or conduct onboarding activities for candidates who have applied through our careers site. When interviewing for a position, the candidate experience will include live interaction, such as a video conference or telephone call, with a Recruiter and/or company employee(s). We will never ask for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process. Be aware of suspicious recruitment activity. If you think you are a victim of an employment scam, you may contact your local law enforcement agency and/or visit the Federal Trade Commission website here: https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams .

records.title: Director, Continuous Improvement
records.description:
Work Model: This role can be performed remotely from an approved location, with flexibility based on business needs and applicable requirements.
 
 
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
 
 
Regal Rexnord Business System (“RBS”) plays a pivotal role in driving organizational change and process improvement to achieve our business objectives. The
**Linear Motion Division**
(“LMD”) within the AMC segment is seeking a
**Director of RBS**
. Reporting to the President of the Division, this position will drive the implementation, maturity, and cultural adoption of RBS and continuous process improvement across the division.
 
 
This leadership position is focused on the deployment of RBS across the Division to drive both short and long-term goals and will partner closely with LMD’s leadership team, as well as the AMC RBS team. The right candidate will drive operational excellence, develop CI capability, and ensure alignment to strategic priorities through Policy Deployment. This leader influences across manufacturing sites, functional teams, and the broader AMC organization to deliver year-over-year performance improvement. As a key member of the AMC RBS Team, this role will impact results and culture by establishing standards, institutionalizing management systems and ensuring effective problem-solving skills (& tool capability) across the organization.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 
 
**Continuous Improvement Leadership and Standard Work**

* Champion the Lean philosophy and its deployment across all functions and manufacturing sites.
* Support the organization in achieving SQDCG and financial objectives through effective application of the RBS tools and methodologies to achieve continuous improvement.
* Develop and drive the divisional CI Roadmap and ensure alignment to site-level plans.
* Lead, guide, and help create solutions for highly complex and multi-faceted problems requiring ingenuity, creativity, innovation, and strong analytical skills. Problems are unique and require a thorough understanding of operating unit policies and practices. Apply knowledge of different techniques and practices to achieve desired results
* Connect operational improvements (e.g., machine productivity, labor productivity, lead time/turnaround time, quality, backlog, capacity, OEE, etc.) to financial outcomes (Revenue/TVOS, Cost, Cash, Margin).
* Participate in the hiring, development and coaching of site continuous improvement leaders.
* Utilize a team-oriented structured problem-solving approach to analyze current conditions, diagnose problems, and identify improvement opportunities.

**Capability and Talent Development**

* Support Division and Site RBS leaders in maturing the Regal Rexnord Business System through the development of skills, capabilities, and engagement driving impact to the next level.
* Coach, mentor, and train Regal Rexnord associates on CI tools and Lean leadership.
* Develop RBS capability through formal training and “stop-and-teach” coaching at Gemba.
* Lead and coach multiple projects and Kaizen events simultaneously through both a hands-on and influential approach.
* Engage and influence teams at all levels to drive momentum toward the future state.
* Identify, coach, and develop talent; build a strong bench of RBS tool champions across the division to leverage RBS Continuous Improvement tools and methodologies to support their professional advancement and improve the business's operational performance.

**Policy Deployment**

* Lead the creation of annual X-Matrix and oversee the deployment plan via RBS charters, bowlers, and action plans.
* Manage charters, bowlers, action plans and monthly PD cadence.
* Support Division Annual Improvement Priorities through effective application of RBS tools and methodologies to support Policy Deployment initiatives.

**Qualifications**
**PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE/QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in a technical field; Advanced degree preferred (MS Engineering, MBA)
* 8-10 years relevant work experience across Continuous Improvement, Business Systems, or Operations (global and/or multi-site experience preferred)
* Familiarity with Policy Deployment, its facilitation and implementation.
* Technical background in continuous improvement methodology and framework
* Proven successful applications of multiple CI tools: 80/20, Lean Leadership, including Daily Management, KPI Leadership, Standard Work, Gemba Walks, Value Stream Mapping, 6S, Transactional Process Improvements, Kanban/replenishment systems, FMEA, Advanced Problem Solving, RCCMs
* Demonstrated ability to facilitate Kaizen-type events to produce measurable improvements (financial, service, quality, etc.)
* Skilled and experienced in decomposing a strategic vision into actionable strategies and tactics.
* Critical thinking skills to properly identify problem area & potential solutions
* Demonstrate the Regal Rexnord Values; Integrity, Responsibility, Diversity, Engagement & Inclusion, Customer Success, Innovation with Purpose, Continuous Improvement, Performance, Passion to Win, and Sense of Urgency
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
* Must be able to travel at least 50-75% of the time domestically and internationally as required

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Project and program management expertise (PMP, Prince II)
* Lean Six Sigma certification (e.g, Green Belt or Black Belt)
* Experience with High Mix / Low Volume and Low Mix / High Volume manufacturing

Physical Demand and Work Environment
 
 
**Physical Demands**
– while performing the duties in this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands; reach with hands and arms; and talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, and sit.
 
 
**Work Environment**
– the noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.
 
 
Restrictions imposed by federal export control laws may limit this job opportunity to candidates who are a "U.S. Person,' which includes U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, U.S. permanent residents, individuals granted asylum in the United States, and refugees in the United States.
 
 
Expected salary: $160,000 - $190,000 annually. The salary range provided is intended to display the value of the company's base pay compensation for all statewide locations across the United States. Salary is dependent on a multitude of factors, including but not limited to the physical worksite location, candidate's skill set, level of experience, education, and internal peer compensation comparisons.
 
 
**Benefits**

* Medical, Dental, Vision and Prescription Drug Coverage
* Spending accounts (HSA, Health Care FSA and Dependent Care FSA)
* Paid Time Off and Holidays
* 401k Retirement Plan with Matching Employer Contributions
* Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance
* Paid Leaves
* Tuition Assistance

**About Regal Rexnord**
Regal Rexnord is a publicly held global industrial manufacturer with 30,000 associates around the world who help create a better tomorrow by providing sustainable solutions that power, transmit and control motion. The Company’s electric motors and air moving subsystems provide the power to create motion. A portfolio of highly engineered power transmission components and subsystems efficiently transmits motion to power industrial applications. The Company’s automation offering, comprised of controls, actuators, drives, and precision motors, controls motion in applications ranging from factory automation to precision control in surgical tools.
 
 
The Company’s end markets benefit from meaningful secular demand tailwinds, and include factory automation, food & beverage, aerospace, medical, data center, warehouse, alternative energy, residential and commercial buildings, general industrial, construction, metals and mining, and agriculture.
 
 
Regal Rexnord is comprised of three operating segments: Industrial Powertrain Solutions, Power Efficiency Solutions, and Automation & Motion Control. Regal Rexnord has offices and manufacturing, sales and service facilities worldwide. For more information, including a copy of our Sustainability Report, visit RegalRexnord.com.
 
 
**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**
Regal Rexnord is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex/gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, ancestry, national origin, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status (unless required by the applicable law or government contract), disability or protected veteran status or any other status or characteristic protected by law. Regal Rexnord is committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce. We are committed to building a team that represents diverse and inclusive backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. If you’d like to view a copy of the company’s affirmative action plan for protected veterans/individuals with disabilities or policy statement, please email Recruiting@RegalRexnord.com. If you have a disability and you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to submit an online application, please e-mail Recruiting@RegalRexnord.com.
 
 
Equal Employment Opportunity Posters
 
 
**Notification to Agencies**
: Please note that Regal Rexnord Corporation and its affiliates and subsidiaries ("Regal Rexnord") do not accept unsolicited resumes or calls from third-party recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed Master Service Agreement or similar contract and approval from HR to submit resumes for a specific requisition, Regal Rexnord will not consider or approve payment to any third-parties for hires made.
