records.description:
**Job Description**
**Location:**
Mesa, Arizona / Hybrid as required
 
 
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
 
 
Position Summary
 
 
The Director of Manufacturing Excellence & Reliability is responsible for defining and executing the manufacturing excellence, quality, and reliability strategy for utility-scale power electronics products produced through contract manufacturing partners.
 
 
This role provides strategic and organizational leadership across
**Manufacturing Excellence, Quality & Supplier Excellence, and Reliability & Product Integrity**
, translating business objectives into functional strategies, operating plans, organizational priorities, and measurable results.
 
 
The Director will lead multidisciplinary engineering teams and partner closely with senior leaders across Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Product, Service, and other functions to ensure products consistently achieve safety, quality, performance, cost, manufacturability, and reliability objectives throughout the product lifecycle.
 
 
This leader will also serve as a senior representative of the organization with contract manufacturers, strategic suppliers, and customers, including executive business reviews, customer audits, factory acceptance activities, technical reviews, and other engagements involving matters of significance to the business.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 
 
Manufacturing Excellence Strategy & Leadership
 
 

* Define and execute the long-term Manufacturing Excellence and Reliability strategy aligned with company and business objectives.
* Translate broader business strategy into functional priorities, annual operating plans, objectives, and key results (OKRs).
* Establish organizational policies, standards, governance models, methods, and performance expectations across manufacturing excellence, quality, and reliability.
* Lead, develop, and mentor multidisciplinary engineering teams, building organizational capability and a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and technical excellence.
* Partner with senior management to establish priorities, resolve complex cross-functional issues, and drive decisions with significant operational and business impact.
* Establish and monitor executive-level KPIs to measure manufacturing performance, quality, reliability, supplier performance, and continuous improvement.

Manufacturing Readiness & Operational Excellence
 
 

* Establish manufacturing readiness requirements, governance, and evaluation criteria for new products, manufacturing processes, and production ramps.
* Provide functional approval and leadership oversight for production readiness and manufacturing risk.
* Ensure manufacturing processes demonstrate appropriate capability, control, scalability, and repeatability prior to and throughout production.
* Sponsor automation, process optimization, Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement initiatives across internal and contract manufacturing operations.
* Drive cross-functional resolution of complex manufacturing challenges involving Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, and contract manufacturing partners.
* Establish methods and standards that improve manufacturing performance, scalability, cost, and operational effectiveness.

Quality & Supplier Excellence
 
 

* Own the strategic direction and performance framework for supplier and contract manufacturer quality.
* Establish quality expectations, governance mechanisms, escalation processes, and performance standards for strategic manufacturing partners.
* Lead executive-level supplier and contract manufacturer business and quality reviews, including negotiation and resolution of significant quality and operational matters.
* Ensure robust quality management systems, corrective and preventive action (CAPA), root-cause analysis, and systemic corrective actions are implemented and sustained.
* Drive supplier capability improvement and ensure manufacturing partners consistently meet business, customer, and product requirements.
* Reconcile competing stakeholder priorities and drive decisions that protect product quality, customer commitments, and long-term business objectives.

Reliability & Product Integrity
 
 

* Define and lead the product reliability and product integrity strategy across the product lifecycle.
* Establish reliability objectives, qualification requirements, validation standards, and performance criteria in partnership with Engineering and Product organizations.
* Provide leadership oversight of product qualification programs and ensure reliability risks are identified, understood, and addressed prior to production release.
* Monitor field performance and translate product and warranty data into strategic reliability improvement priorities.
* Sponsor cross-functional initiatives to reduce warranty exposure, improve product performance, and address systemic reliability risks.
* Ensure lessons learned from manufacturing, field performance, and reliability analysis are incorporated into future product and process development.

Customer & Executive Engagement
 
 

* Own senior-level customer engagement for Manufacturing, Quality, and Reliability matters.
* Host and lead customer visits, quality audits, technical reviews, factory acceptance activities, and executive meetings.
* Represent the organization in discussions involving significant manufacturing, quality, reliability, or supplier matters.
* Communicate complex technical and operational issues clearly to executive, customer, and cross-functional audiences.
* Partner with senior leadership to develop resolution strategies for critical customer or operational issues.

Organizational & Financial Leadership
 
 

* Direct the activities and priorities of the Manufacturing Excellence & Reliability organization through engineering leaders and multidisciplinary teams.
* Develop organizational capability, succession plans, talent strategies, and technical leadership within the function.
* Own departmental budgets, resource planning, workforce priorities, and investment recommendations.
* Ensure functional budgets, programs, and schedules meet corporate requirements.
* Evaluate and prioritize investments in manufacturing technology, automation, quality, reliability, and engineering capability based on business impact and long-term strategy.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline; Master’s degree preferred.
* 12+ years of progressive experience in power electronics manufacturing, manufacturing engineering, quality, reliability, or related engineering disciplines.
* Significant experience supporting complex power electronics products and manufacturing environments; utility-scale inverter, energy, or similar high-power electrical product experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience developing and executing manufacturing, quality, and/or reliability strategies within a contract manufacturing environment.
* Proven leadership experience managing multidisciplinary engineering organizations and developing technical leaders and teams.
* Demonstrated experience working with contract manufacturers and strategic suppliers, including executive-level performance management and issue resolution.
* Strong working knowledge of APQP, FMEA/PFMEA, SPC, CAPA, Lean, Six Sigma, manufacturing process capability, and reliability engineering methodologies.
* Experience establishing manufacturing readiness, production qualification, and operational governance for new product introduction and production ramp.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business strategy into functional plans, organizational priorities, operating mechanisms, and measurable outcomes.
* Experience managing departmental budgets, resources, priorities, and complex programs with significant business impact.
* Strong executive presence with demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders, customers, suppliers, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Experience leading customer-facing quality, manufacturing, or reliability engagements, including audits, technical reviews, factory acceptance activities, and executive discussions.
* Ability to navigate complex, ambiguous issues, reconcile multiple stakeholder perspectives, and make decisions with significant long-term operational and business impact.

At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure.
 
 
Nextpower is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
 
 
**We are Nextpower**

**Job Description:**

**Who We Are:**

At Cart.com, we're **defining the future of commerce.**

Founded to solve the growing complexity of modern commerce, Cart.com helps businesses simplify how they sell, fulfill, and deliver products to their customers. We bring together technology, services, and logistics infrastructure into one connected platform, making it easier for organizations to grow, operate efficiently, and navigate an increasingly fragmented commerce landscape.

We work with brands, retailers, manufacturers, and public sector organizations to support every stage of the customer journey, from ecommerce and order management to fulfillment, distribution, and delivery. By combining software, expertise, and a nationwide logistics network into a unified solution, we help our customers move faster, operate smarter, and scale with confidence.

But what truly sets Cart.com apart is our people. We're builders, problem-solvers, and innovators who thrive on turning big challenges into meaningful outcomes for our customers. Every day, we're helping shape the future of commerce while creating opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact.

If you're energized by solving complex problems, collaborating with talented teammates, and helping build what's next, we'd love to hear from you.

**Cart.com Milestones**

* Founded in 2020 with a vision to build the first truly unified commerce platform.
* Achieved unicorn status with a valuation exceeding $1 billion.
* Raised more than $475 million to support continued growth and innovation
* Expanded a nationwide commerce and logistics network that helps organizations scale, fulfill, and grow across channels.
* Recognized by Inc.'s Power Partner Awards for helping businesses grow and scale.
* Recognized as an award-winning employer for four consecutive years, reflecting our commitment to building an environment where talented people can grow, innovate, and make an impact.

**Our values:** Cart.com is building a company that is committed to living out these 6 core values:

* **Be brand obsessed:** Our lives are shaped by the brands we interact with daily. We obsess over the brands we serve, and about the things they care about.
* **Think beyond the box:** “We’ve always done it that way” is not a phrase uttered often at our office. We create creative solutions to complex problems.

* **Don’t give up:** We learn from our challenges and see them for what they are; great building blocks to an amazing brand story.
* **Speak up:** We communicate clearly and directly because we care deeply. Communication is the bedrock of our community.
* **Work together:** We’ve built a team that prides itself on diversity of thought and background. Collaboration is better with contrast.
* **Remember to be human:** We work hard, but we leave room for the people, places and things that we love

**AI is part of how we work. It's not doing the hiring.** 
 
We'll use AI in parts of our process and we think you should feel free to use it too — for research, prep, whatever helps. But our interviews exist to meet *you*, not your best AI-assisted draft. Real people make every call here. Any questions about how this works, just ask.

**Remote:**

This position is fully remote and open to candidates in AZ, CA, CO, CT, DC, DE, FL, GA, HI, IL, IN, KY, LA, MA, MD, MI, MO, MS, NC, NJ, NY, NC, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA. The salary range for this role is $175,000-200,000 annually. Actual compensation may vary based on geographic location, experience and qualifications. This role is eligible for bonus, equity and benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), paid time off. Applications accepted through 1-31-2027. We comply with all applicable pay transparency laws in the states where we operate.

**The Role:**

The Director, Quality and Compliance leads the quality function for Cart.com’s federal pharmaceutical distribution business across four sites. This leader will standardize and strengthen an established quality program, develop site quality leaders, ensure consistent application of procedures, and serve as the primary quality point of contact for client reporting, audits and product-quality events.

This is approximately a 70% strategic leadership and 30% hands-on role. The Director will not build the program from the ground up, but will assess the current-state program, make targeted improvements, and ensure teams consistently execute against client, regulatory and network requirements. The role is remote with approximately 30% travel.

The role offers the opportunity to influence the quality standard for a growing federal business and help prepare the organization to support additional federal programs over time.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead and develop site quality leaders across Maryland, Goodyear, Temecula and Memphis, establishing clear accountability, delegation and follow-through.
* Standardize quality procedures and expectations across the network while refining the existing quality management system and closing identified gaps.
* Ensure sites remain prepared for client and regulatory audits; support audit planning, host or coordinate inspections, and oversee timely responses and corrective actions.
* Serve as the primary quality point of contact for pharmaceutical product excursions and related client reporting, ensuring submissions are accurate, complete and timely.
* Oversee quality processes supporting receiving, quarantine, release, disposition, returns, destruction, recalls, deviations, corrective and preventive actions, change control, training, complaints and document control.
* Guide quality decisions for controlled-temperature pharmaceutical products, including refrigerated, frozen and ultra-cold storage and distribution.
* Partner with site Operations leaders and Cart.com’s Compliance team to implement operational changes required to meet quality standards and client expectations.
* Use quality metrics, audit findings, client feedback and site observations to identify risk, prioritize improvements and report progress to senior leadership.
* Travel to sites for audit preparation, team development, quality reviews and issue resolution.

**Who You Are:**

 

* You are a strategic, hands-on quality leader who can set direction while stepping into audits, excursions and site-readiness work when needed.
* You lead through others, delegate clearly, establish checkpoints and hold site quality leaders accountable for follow-through.
* You put the client’s requirements first, ask the right questions and respond with accurate, timely information.
* You communicate with credibility and composure across clients, regulators, Operations, Compliance and senior leadership.
* You are highly organized and disciplined, ensuring commitments, documentation and escalations do not get lost.
* You build strong cross-functional partnerships and can influence operational changes without creating a separate quality silo.
* You adapt to changing federal-client requirements while maintaining consistent quality standards and sound judgment.
* You develop people, address performance gaps directly and create a culture of ownership across a distributed team.

**What You’ve Done:**

 

* 7+ years of progressive pharmaceutical quality experience, including work in a current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) facility and meaningful pharmaceutical distribution, logistics or 3PL quality exposure.
* 5+ years of people-leadership experience with demonstrated success delegating, developing leaders and holding teams accountable.
* Worked in pharmaceutical distribution, wholesale, logistics or third-party logistics (3PL). Manufacturing experience alone is not sufficient without meaningful distribution-quality exposure.
* Applied cGMP, Good Distribution Practice (GDP), controlled-document and standard operating procedure requirements in a regulated pharmaceutical environment.
* Prepared for or led audits involving the U.S. Food and Drug Administration or comparable regulators, including managing responses and follow-up actions.
* Supported pharmaceutical product release, disposition, holds, recalls or temperature-excursion decisions in a regulated distribution setting.
* Written, revised or implemented quality procedures and documentation, then ensured consistent execution across teams or sites.
* Led a distributed or multi-site team and built accountability through site leaders rather than personally owning every task.
* Managed a significant client, product-quality or regulatory issue requiring coordination across Quality, Operations and Compliance.
* Earned a bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, biology, chemistry or a related field, or bring an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
* Ability to travel up to 30%.

**Nice to Haves:**

 

* Background supporting federal health programs or agencies such as HHS, DLA, ASPR, BARDA, DoD or VA.
* Experience with pharmaceutical 3PLs, wholesalers, state licensing or NABP accreditation.
* Hands-on experience with vaccines or other cold-chain and ultra-cold pharmaceutical products.
* Knowledge of Drug Supply Chain Security Act requirements and suspect or illegitimate product processes.
* Relevant certifications such as ASQ Certified Quality Auditor, Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence, Certified Pharmaceutical GMP Professional or Lead Auditor.
* Master’s degree in a life-sciences or related discipline.
Direct leadership of quality teams 

 
 

**Physical Demands & Working Conditions:**

 

* Remote work environment with regular computer and video-conference use.
* Ability to travel by air or ground up to 30% and work onsite in warehouse, pharmaceutical distribution and temperature-controlled environments.
* Ability to move through operating areas and wear required personal protective equipment when visiting sites.
* Flexibility to support audits, client needs or quality events outside standard business hours when required.

Eligibility Requirement: This position is open only to U.S. citizens due to applicable federal requirements. By applying, you confirm that you are a U.S. citizen and can provide acceptable documentation verifying your status if selected. 
 
If you are not a U.S. citizen, please do not apply for this role.

Cart.com is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title** Quality Assurance, Operations Support Services & Service Delivery

**Corporate Title** Director

**Location** Santa Ana, CA

**Overview**

*As a Director within Document Custody Operations, you will lead quality assurance, operations support services, and service delivery to strengthen execution, protect client and organizational interests, and improve service outcomes. You will oversee quality control, training, operational risk and controls, continuous improvement, and sustained regulatory, agency, investor, and audit readiness. As a senior operational representative and Document Custody and agency subject matter expert, you will translate agency, investor, client, contractual, and internal requirements into practical operating standards. You will partner across Operations, Client Services, control functions, Technology, and delivery partners to resolve complex issues and balance client service, efficiency, and custodial obligations.*

**What We Offer You**

* A diverse and inclusive environment that embraces change, innovation, and collaboration
* A hybrid working model, allowing for in-office / work from home flexibility, generous vacation, personal and volunteer days
* Employee Resource Groups support an inclusive workplace for everyone and promote community engagement
* Competitive compensation packages including health and wellbeing benefits, retirement savings plans, parental leave, and family building benefits
Educational resources, matching gift and volunteer programs 

**What You’ll Do**

* Own the Document Custody quality assurance framework, operating standards, governance, and controls, including maker/checker reviews, segregation of duties, approvals, system validations, and evidence requirements
* Oversee independent, risk-based quality control testing, sampling, defect tracking, root-cause analysis, corrective and preventative action, and remediation validation; report quality performance and emerging risks to senior leadership
* Lead training and knowledge-management governance, including agency and document fundamentals, competency assessments, certification standards, cross-training, and targeted retraining informed by quality findings and audit observations
* Translate Federal National Mortgage Association (FNMA), Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (FHLMC), Government National Mortgage Association (GNMA), private investor, client, and custodial requirements into procedures and service expectations; guide collateral documentation, certification, endorsements, assignments, allonges, trailing documents, releases, reinstatements, exceptions, and inventory controls
* Lead operational support and client service delivery, including implementations, service levels, capacity planning, complex research, incidents, aging items, and escalations; balance responsiveness with contractual commitments, controls, cost, and risk appetite
Maintain audit and examination readiness, oversee findings and management action plans, and partner with Technology on workflow, automation, data, and reporting enhancements that deliver measurable improvements in quality, capacity, client outcomes, and resilience 

**How You’ll Lead**

* Lead and develop direct reports and matrixed teams across quality assurance, quality control, training, audit support, operational support, service delivery, and process improvement, establishing clear decision rights, accountability, and development objectives
* Partner with Operations, Client Services, and clients as a senior advisor and escalation point, ensuring service commitments are executable, controlled, and aligned with custodial obligations
Influence senior leadership, Audit, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Technology, vendors, and offshore partners to challenge risk decisions constructively, resolve cross-functional issues, and deliver sustainable remediation and transformation 

**Skills You’ll Need**

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Risk Management, Operations Management, Mortgage Banking, or a related discipline; equivalent directly relevant experience may be considered where permitted by organizational policy
* Extensive experience in document custody, mortgage banking, loan servicing, securities services, collateral management, quality assurance, operational risk, service delivery, or another highly controlled financial-services environment
* Demonstrated experience with Quality Assurance/Quality Control frameworks, control testing, issue management, root-cause analysis, corrective and preventative action, training governance, operational reporting, and client escalation management, including support for audits, client examinations, agency reviews, regulatory assessments, or formal control testing
* Knowledge of operational risk, controls, quality management, audit readiness, remediation, and service-delivery governance, with the ability to translate agency, investor, client, contractual, and internal requirements into operational standards
* Working proficiency with Microsoft 365 and experience using dashboards, workflow tools, quality trackers, case-management systems, or operational reporting platforms
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimize workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs 

**Skills That Will Help You Excel**

* Direct working knowledge of Document Custody and FNMA, FHLMC, GNMA, private investor, collateral, certification, release, and exception requirements
* Experience leading managers, professionals, programs, or complex cross-functional operating models, with the ability to influence across functions, locations, vendors, and onshore/offshore teams
* Executive presence and effective written and verbal communication with clients, auditors, senior management, control functions, and technical subject matter experts
* Analytical judgment to identify patterns, quantify operational impacts, challenge assumptions, and make risk-informed decisions
Disciplined prioritization and follow-through when managing multiple critical issues, with timely escalation of material concerns 

**Expectations**

It is the Bank’s expectation that employees hired into this role will work in the Santa Ana office in accordance with the Bank’s hybrid working model.

Deutsche Bank provides reasonable accommodations to candidates and employees with a substantiated need based on disability and/or religion.

The salary range for this position in California is $133,000 to $203,500. Actual salaries may be based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s skill set, experience, education, work location and other qualifications. Posted salary ranges do not include incentive compensation or any other type of remuneration.

**Deutsche Bank Benefits**

At Deutsche Bank, we recognize that our benefit programs have a profound impact on our colleagues. That’s why we are focused on providing benefits and perks that enable our colleagues to live authentically and be their whole selves, at every stage of life. We provide access to physical, emotional, and financial wellness benefits that allow our colleagues to stay financially secure and strike balance between work and home. Click here to learn more!

Learn more about your life at Deutsche Bank through the eyes of our current employees: https://careers.db.com/life

The California Consumer Privacy Act outlines how companies can use personal information. If you are interested in receiving a copy of Deutsche Bank’s California Privacy Notice please email HR.Direct@DB.com .

**#LI-HYBRID**

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. Click these links to view Deutsche Bank’s Equal Opportunity Policy Statement and the following notices: EEOC Know Your Rights ; Employee Rights and Responsibilities under the Family and Medical Leave Act ; and Employee Polygraph Protection Act .

records.title: IT Director of Quality Assurance
records.description:
**ABOUT ETHOS & THE OPPORTUNITY**

Ethos Risk Services is a leading insurance claims investigation and medical management company focused on delivering better data, technology, and insights that help our clients make better decisions. We are continuing to invest in our technology organization and are seeking an experienced engineering leader to help scale how software is built, tested, and delivered.

We are seeking a **full-time Director of Quality Assurance** to own software quality across Ethos, overseeing an outsourced QA team and the processes, tooling, environments, and metrics that prevent defects from reaching production. Our ideal candidate is an experienced, results-driven QA leader who will establish a consistent defect lifecycle, reduce defect aging, implement effective root cause analysis and preventive measures, and improve the reliability of test environments. Within their first year, they will standardize QA tools and processes, integrate AI-based solutions into daily QA operations and performance tracking, and establish a comprehensive KPI framework that drives measurable improvements in software quality, efficiency, and accountability.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Lead Outsourced QA Operations:** Direct the day-to-day activities of an outsourced QA team of 8 to10 resources, establishing priorities, performance expectations, and accountability for quality deliverables.
* **Manage Vendor Performance:** Oversee vendor agreements, SLAs, staffing, onboarding, and performance evaluations. Address performance gaps through corrective action and ensure effective knowledge transfer and documentation.
* **Drive Defect Management:** Establish and enforce standardized defect tracking, classification, prioritization, and resolution processes. Lead regular defect triage with engineering and product teams to manage backlogs and identify quality risks.
* **Prevent Production Issues:** Lead structured root cause analysis of production defects, identify recurring failure patterns, and implement preventive measures through improved test coverage, regression testing, and quality gates.
* **Oversee Test Environments:** Partner with DevOps to maintain stable, production-representative QA, staging, and UAT environments, including configuration standards, test data management, and environment availability.
* **Define QA Strategy & Standards:** Develop and continuously improve QA processes across manual, automated, regression, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing to strengthen quality and consistency.
* **Advance Test Automation:** Evaluate and implement QA tools and automation frameworks, integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to improve testing efficiency, coverage, and release reliability.
* **Leverage AI-Enabled QA Tools:** Apply AI-based solutions to test generation, defect classification, failure analysis, workload management, and performance monitoring. Evaluate emerging tools and implement solutions that deliver measurable improvements while maintaining appropriate security and accuracy controls.
* **Establish Quality KPIs:** Define and monitor performance metrics, including defect escape rates, resolution times, automation coverage, recurring production incidents, test effectiveness, and vendor SLA adherence.
* **Deliver Executive Reporting:** Produce monthly quality reports and quarterly reviews for the VP of Engineering and CTO, translating performance data into actionable insights, risks, trends, and recommendations.
* **Support Release Readiness:** Collaborate with engineering, DevOps, IT Delivery Leads, and Technical Product Owners to integrate QA into sprint and release planning, assess release quality, and recommend readiness for deployment.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience (required).

**Required Experience:**

* 8 to 10 years of progressively greater responsibility in software quality assurance.
* 3 to 4 years in a QA management role leading teams and managers.
* Proven expertise in defect lifecycle management, root cause analysis, and preventive quality practices.
* Hands-on experience establishing and maintaining test environments and test data management practices.
* Strong working knowledge of QA tooling, such as test management (e.g., Xray, Zephyr, TestRail), defect tracking (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps), and automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Cypress).
* Practical experience using AI-based tools in QA or team management, and enthusiasm for expanding their use.
* Experience defining QA KPIs and producing executive-level monthly and quarterly reporting.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated testing into delivery workflows.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Performance, security, or API testing, and a regulated-industry background.
* Certifications: ISTQB Advanced or Test Manager, CSQE, or similar.
* Experience with data visualization or dashboard tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau)

**WORKING AT ETHOS**

This is a 100% remote U.S.-based role, offering the flexibility to work from home while remaining closely connected to a collaborative leadership team. Our ideal candidate is available during EST standard business hours. Occasional travel may be required for quarterly or annual leadership meetings and company events.

**Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States and must not require current or future employment sponsorship.**

**Benefits include:** Paid Time Off and Sick Time **|** Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance **|** Short-Term + Long-Term Disability Insurance + Life Insurance **|** 401(k) Matching **|** Employee Referral Bonus Program

At Ethos, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, shape the future of our engineering organization, and help build the systems and processes that support our next stage of growth. **To learn more about Ethos, visit our website:** https://ethosrisk.com/about-us/

*Ethos Risk Services is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law.*

records.title: VP of Production
records.description:
**VP of Production**
--------------------

**Location:** Los Angeles, Detroit, or San Francisco 
**Employment:** Full time, in person 
**Base salary:** $200,000–$350,000 annually

American factories deserve a supply chain that moves as fast as they do. Nox Metals is building it, along with the tools that run it. We’re a technology company supplying raw metal to frontier American manufacturers. We use software and automation to supply metal to factories faster than the industry thought possible.

### **The role**

We’re hiring a VP of Production to lead manufacturing performance across Nox Metals’ facilities. You will own how work moves through our factories: production planning, daily execution, capacity, staffing, quality, productivity, and on-time delivery.

This is a hands-on manufacturing leadership role with real time on the factory floor. You will develop production leaders, resolve constraints, and create repeatable ways of working that help teams deliver as demand grows. Success means safe, reliable production and clear accountability from the daily schedule through completed customer orders.

### **You will**

* Lead production execution across facilities, with clear expectations for safety, quality, output, cost, and delivery.
* Translate demand into practical production, staffing, shift, and capacity plans.
* Develop plant and production leaders who take ownership of results and build strong teams.
* Establish daily operating reviews, shift handoffs, escalation paths, and performance measures that drive action.
* Identify bottlenecks, reduce downtime and rework, and improve material flow and labor productivity.
* Build consistent training, work instructions, and qualification standards while staying close to how work happens.
* Protect material traceability and quality throughout production.
* Partner with maintenance and engineering on equipment reliability, capacity improvements, and automation.
* Work with supply chain and commercial teams to align material availability, production commitments, and customer needs.
* Partner with finance on production economics and equipment investment decisions.
* Help new or expanded facilities establish reliable production and sustain performance as they ramp.

### **You are**

* A manufacturing leader with a record of improving factory performance and developing accountable leaders.
* Experienced managing production teams, schedules, equipment constraints, and competing priorities.
* Uncompromising about safety, quality, and traceability.
* Fluent in capacity, throughput, labor productivity, downtime, and delivery performance.
* Comfortable making decisions on the floor and following through until problems are resolved.
* Practical, direct, and interested in improving manufacturing with software and automation.

### **Nice to have**

Experience leading multiple facilities, scaling production through rapid growth, or working in metals, machining, aerospace, industrial distribution, or related environments.

Expect regular time at our manufacturing facilities and travel between sites as needed.

Nox Metals is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based on skill, attitude, and fit for the work, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, height, weight, marital status, or any other protected status under federal, state, or local law.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act.

Compensation Range: $200K - $350K

records.title: Head of Aircraft Production (R6147)
records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

### **About Shield AI:**

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense technology company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Our products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies.

### **Job Description:**

We’re looking for a hands-on manufacturing leader to take X-BAT from early prototype builds through production launch and into rate production.

You will lead prototype build execution and the manufacturing setup of our new Seattle-area facility, X-Forge 3. You’ll build the production team, establish the factory’s operating system and deliver the readiness needed to scale aircraft production safely, reliably and efficiently.

This role carries accountability across the full journey: turning lessons from development builds into a repeatable production system, then leading that operation against safety, quality, delivery and cost commitments. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain and Program Management to make that happen.

**What you'll do:**

* **Lead prototype builds and new product introduction**

 + Own the day-to-day execution of X-BAT prototype and development aircraft builds, including assembly, integration, rework and build support for testing.
 + Partner with Program Management to establish achievable build schedules, resource plans and milestones, making constraints and trade-offs visible early.
 + Work with Engineering and Manufacturing Engineering through build-test-learn cycles, ensuring build issues are captured, resolved and reflected in future designs and production processes.
 + Plan and execute pre-series builds to prove tooling, work instructions, material flow, process controls and workforce readiness before production ramp.
 + Maintain configuration discipline and aircraft traceability throughout development builds in partnership with Engineering and Quality.

 **Establish the Seattle production operation**

 + Lead manufacturing setup and operational readiness for X-Forge 3, working with Facilities and Manufacturing Engineering on factory layout, equipment installation, commissioning and production flow.
 + Recruit, develop and lead the production organization, building capable frontline leadership and a skilled aircraft assembly team.
 + Own production staffing, training and capacity plans, aligning investment and workforce growth with program demand.
 + Drive launch readiness across people, tooling, materials, processes and quality, with clear owners and closure plans for gaps.
 + Lead the transition from prototype operations into Seattle production, ensuring build knowledge and lessons learned transfer with the work.

 **Deliver and scale aircraft production**

 + Own production execution against safety, quality, delivery and cost targets as X-BAT moves through initial production and into sustained rate.
 + Establish daily operating routines, visual management and escalation processes that surface problems early and drive timely resolution.
 + Improve throughput, labor productivity, first-pass quality and schedule adherence through practical Lean methods and structured problem-solving.
 + Partner with Supply Chain and Planning to align material availability, supplier readiness and outsourced manufacturing with the production plan.
 + Work with Manufacturing Engineering and Quality to eliminate recurring build issues and embed permanent corrective actions.
 + Deploy digital manufacturing tools and appropriate automation to improve execution, traceability and scalability.
 + Give leadership a clear view of production performance, launch readiness, risks and the decisions needed to maintain progress.

**Required qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing or a related technical field.
* 10+ years of experience in aerospace or comparable advanced manufacturing, including at least 5 years leading production teams.
* Demonstrated experience leading prototype or new product introduction builds and carrying a product into sustained production.
* Proven ability to build and scale manufacturing operations, including workforce development, capacity planning and production systems.
* Experience leading complex assembly and integration operations with demanding quality, configuration and traceability requirements.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing readiness, tooling validation, material coordination and production launch.
* Track record of improving safety, quality, delivery and cost through Lean manufacturing and structured problem-solving.
* Ability to lead across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain and Program Management, resolving competing priorities and driving clear accountability.
* A hands-on leadership style, with the ability to move between long-term factory planning and detailed problem-solving on the floor.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Direct experience taking a new aircraft program from prototype through initial and rate production.
* Experience establishing a new manufacturing facility or transferring production between sites.
* Experience in aircraft final assembly, systems integration and production test.
* Familiarity with aerospace quality systems, including AS9100, and digital manufacturing and traceability tools.
* Experience managing production interfaces with outsourced manufacturing partners and complex supplier networks.
* Advanced degree or relevant training in manufacturing leadership, program management or production launch.

#LF

Full-time regular employee offer package:

Pay within range listed + Bonus + Benefits + Equity

Temporary employee offer package:

Pay within range listed above + temporary benefits package (applicable after 60 days of employment)

Salary compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, licenses and certifications, and specific work location. All offers are contingent on a cleared background and possible reference check. Military fellows and part-time employees are not eligible for benefits. Please speak to your talent acquisition representative for more information.

###

Shield AI is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

records.title: Sr. Manager, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering
records.description:
MicroAire Surgical Instruments LLC

As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best.

Leads Advanced Manufacturing initiatives across supply chain, sustaining engineering, manufacturing engineering, and process development for existing and new mechanical and electromechanical products. Serves as a technical advisor in researching and implementing manufacturing technology and is responsible for assigned elements of new product development under MicroAire Design Controls Procedures. Manages the technical and personnel aspects of facilities maintenance and provides technical leadership in areas critical to MicroAire’s success.

**+ Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Drives the planning and execution of critical Advanced Manufacturing projects for insourcing, automation, and continuous improvement, including cost savings, delivery, and quality.
* Leads or coaches critical continuous improvement, Lean, kaizen, and Blue Belt projects. Coordinates corporate CI tracking and planning, drives the site CI calendar, and tracks and reports savings.
* Supports Supply Chain in the technical aspects of insourcing, alternative sourcing, supplier quality, and supplier continuous improvement. Supports business initiatives such as repairs and service programs.
* Participates and makes recommendations regarding departmental quarterly plans and performs all essential duties and responsibilities within the company’s mission, vision and values.
* Develops career paths for direct reports.
* Provides guidance to manufacturing engineering for new highly critical products and oversees facilities maintenance activities within cross-functional teams consistent with departmental goals and objectives.
* Oversees Engineering activity around investigation and root cause analysis for failures observed in the field that needs Engineering support.
* Serves as the specialized technical expert resource for all project teams for manufacturing engineering projects.
* Provides leadership by taking initiative for existing product modifications.
* Provides guidance on Design For Manufacturing during New Product Development process.
* Interfaces with all departments within the company as well as consultants, vendors, surgeons, and others as required to ensure quality, efficacy, and timely completion of directed projects.
* Proactively works with team members to achieve established goals, budgets and timelines.
* Monitors department budgets closely and takes all necessary actions to ensure budget alignment. Identifies capital needs for production and facilities to provide CapEx recommendations.
* Collaborates with department heads to develop and update engineering standard operating procedures.
* Ensures project compliance with all applicable laws and regulations, especially U.S. FDA regulations and EU Medical Device Regulation supporting Regulatory group.
* Researches and analyzes facility requirements and manufacturing capabilities / capacities around potential acquisition opportunities.
* Provides technical training for engineering and operations personnel. Provides systems training to other functional areas as necessary.
* Identifies Advanced Manufacturing Engineering needs and communicates these needs to Senior Management.
* Manages facilities maintenance activities through prioritization of safety, health and production needs.
* Identifies safety issues in the immediate work environment and other work areas and recommends solutions for improvement.
* Ensures engineering and facilities maintenance activities are in compliance with Quality System requirements.
* Ensures facility maintenance activities are also in compliance with OSHA and other applicable health and safety standards.
* Performs other related duties as required.

Authority and supervision: Directly manages Facility Maintenance and mentors junior engineers. Reviews and approves project team work and exercises sound business judgment, recognizing that errors may significantly affect the company.

**+ Education and Experience**

Education Requirements: Bachelor’s in Mechanical Engineering or applicable degree.

Experience Requirements: 8-10 years of Engineering (Manufacturing & Design) experience supporting products in post market phases of product lifecycle. 3- 5 years of leadership experience. Five years in medical device industry desirable.

**Job knowledge skills and abilities**

* Proficiency in 2D drafting and 3D modeling, preferably AutoCAD and SolidWorks.
* Knowledge of ANSI Y14.5 drafting standards.
* Expertise in properties of various materials, such as stainless steel, aluminum and plastics.
* Expertise in part fabrication techniques, such as machining and injection molding.
* Expertise in the factors that affect the life of re-usable surgical instruments, such as corrosion, wear and thermal cycling.
* Thorough understanding of part tolerancing and tolerance stack-up analysis.
* Thorough understanding of mechanical stress analysis.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Project and other job associated software.
* In depth understanding of regulatory requirements for medical device design control and manufacturing.
* In depth understanding of various surgical techniques as related to surgical instruments.
* Ability to apply scientific reasoning and to develop test methodologies to resolve complex technical problems.

**+ Competencies**

**Advanced Manufacturing and Technical Leadership**

*Skills:* Automation, insourcing, manufacturing processes, design for manufacturing, mechanical analysis, and root cause investigation.

*Behaviors:* Leads manufacturing initiatives from planning through implementation; guides technical decisions and resolves complex product and process issues using evidence.

**Program Execution and Business Acumen**

*Skills:* Project planning, risk and milestone management, budget control, CapEx evaluation, and cost savings analysis.

*Behaviors:* Sets priorities, coordinates resources, anticipates risks, and delivers projects within agreed budgets and timelines; connects investment decisions to business results.

**People Leadership and Cross Functional Collaboration**

*Skills:* Coaching, delegation, career development, technical training, communication, and stakeholder alignment.

*Behaviors:* Sets clear expectations, develops direct reports and junior engineers, holds teams accountable, and aligns Operations, Supply Chain,

Quality, and Engineering around shared goals.

**Continuous Improvement and Lean Execution**

*Skills:* Lean tools, kaizen and Blue Belt project coaching, CI planning, savings tracking, and process improvement.

*Behaviors:* Leads and coaches improvement initiatives, maintains a prioritized CI calendar, and verifies measurable gains in cost, quality, and delivery.

**Quality Regulatory and Safety Stewardship**

*Skills:* FDA and EU MDR requirements, design controls, Quality Systems, OSHA standards, and facilities maintenance prioritization.

*Behaviors:* Embeds compliance in engineering and maintenance work, identifies and addresses safety and quality risks early, and prioritizes maintenance based on safety, health, and production needs.

**+ Work Environment, Physical Demands and Protective Equipment**

Minimal physical demands, primary work in an office or lab environment. May be required to do some travel, and to stand for periods of time during work or viewing surgeries.

Works primarily in an office or manufacturing environment, with periodic work in the engineering lab and prototype machine shop. Occasional travel may be required.

Follows protective equipment procedures for each department. Adheres to medical facility precautions during cadaver labs and surgical procedures. Hep B. vaccine series provided, documentation of vaccination or signed declination required.

Confidentiality: Access to the engineering CAD database, trade secrets, and information about new products requires maintaining confidentiality.

**+ Schedule, Travel Responsibility, Special Conditions or Requirements**

Occasional travel may be required, including visits to medical facilities, cadaver labs, or surgical procedures.

Training and certification requirements: See the individual training matrix in the Training Management System.

Pay Range: $125,000 - $155,000

Following receipt of a conditional offer of employment, candidates will be required to complete additional job-related screening processes as permitted or required by applicable law.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to their membership in any protected class. If you require any reasonable accommodation to complete your application or any part of the recruiting process, please email your request to careers@marmon.com, and please be sure to include the title and the location of the position for which you are applying.

records.title: Senior Manager of Customer Quality
records.description:
Since 2018, Elevate Aircraft Seating has been enhancing the passenger experience through innovative aircraft seat design and manufacturing. With locations in California, Washington, and Germany we are guided by creativity, collaboration, and a shared commitment to quality.

We are looking for a skilled Senior Customer Quality Manager to join our team in Charleston, South Carolina. This is an on-site position based in Charleston, South Carolina. We value teamwork, inclusivity, and continuous professional development, and we offer competitive benefits along with opportunities for growth.

**Export Control Requirements:**

**This position must meet U.S. export control compliance requirements. To meet U.S. export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. §120.62 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Senior Manager of Customer Quality serves as the primary quality liaison between Elevate Aircraft Seating's manufacturing locations, Onsite Support Services (OSS), Boeing, and airline customers, ensuring effective communication, timely resolution of quality issues, and alignment with customer and regulatory requirements. This highly visible, customer-facing position is responsible for leading defect investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action coordination while driving quality improvements back into manufacturing operations to prevent recurring issues and strengthen product conformity. The Senior Manager of Customer Quality partners cross-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and customer stakeholders to drive accountability, proactively address quality concerns, and strengthen customer relationships. This position also provides executive leadership with data-driven reporting on quality performance, emerging risks, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives to support informed decision-making and operational excellence.

**SUMMARY OF JOB DUTIES** - **Essential Functions****(Other duties and projects may be assigned or requested.)**

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential*

**Customer Quality Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary quality liaison between Elevate manufacturing locations, Onsite Support Services (OSS), Boeing, and airline customers, ensuring alignment on quality concerns, operational priorities, and resolution activities.
* Lead customer-facing quality discussions, providing technically accurate information, objective evidence, and clear communication regarding product conformity, nonconformances, and corrective actions.
* Establish and maintain structured communication cadences with internal and external stakeholders to ensure timely escalation, consistent messaging, and accountability for quality-related issues.
* Build and maintain strong customer relationships through proactive engagement, effective problem-solving, and timely resolution of quality concerns.

**Defect Management & Technical Quality Assurance**

* Lead the investigation, documentation, and resolution of product defects and nonconformances, identifying root causes, points of origin, and appropriate corrective actions across manufacturing, receiving inspection, and final assembly operations.
* Evaluate reported nonconformances against applicable Letters of Conformance (LOCs), approved craftsmanship documentation, engineering specifications, and customer requirements to ensure accurate defect classification and resolution.
* Partner with Boeing and internal Quality and Engineering teams on corrective action investigations, providing technical analysis, objective evidence, and recommendations to support effective resolution.
* Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of aircraft interior products, functionality, design requirements, and installation processes to effectively evaluate quality concerns and communicate technical findings.
* Coordinate appropriate inspection and acceptance testing support during aircraft installation activities, including verification of electrical connections, mechanical functionality, and applicable acceptance test procedures (ATP).

**Quality Management Systems & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure customer-facing quality activities align with applicable FAA/EASA regulations, AS9100 standards, customer specifications, and internal Quality Management System (QMS) requirements.
* Maintain accurate, traceable quality documentation and defect records through established systems, including SharePoint, ensuring appropriate stakeholders have access to current information and supporting evidence.
* Coordinate the communication and implementation of applicable service bulletins, engineering changes, and product effectivity requirements across manufacturing locations, OSS, Boeing, and customers.
* Support customer quality reviews, audits, and regulatory compliance activities by providing technical documentation, investigation findings, and corrective action evidence.

**Corrective Action & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive cross-functional corrective and preventive action initiatives to address customer quality concerns, eliminate recurring defects, and strengthen manufacturing process effectiveness.
* Translate customer quality feedback, defect trends, and investigation findings into actionable improvement opportunities for manufacturing, Engineering, and Quality teams.
* Apply root cause analysis, statistical methods, and structured problem-solving techniques to validate defect origins, assess corrective action effectiveness, and support sustainable improvements.
* Identify emerging quality risks and recurring issues, proactively escalating concerns and coordinating mitigation activities to minimize customer impact and prevent recurrence.

**Executive Reporting & Cross-Functional Quality Performance**

* Develop and present quality performance reports, defect trends, corrective action status, and emerging risks to executive leadership, providing data-driven insights and recommendations to support operational decision-making.
* Establish and monitor key quality performance indicators (KPIs) related to customer defects, resolution timelines, recurring issues, and corrective action effectiveness.
* Partner with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Program Management, and OSS teams to drive accountability, coordinate issue resolution, and ensure timely implementation of quality improvements across affected operations.
* Monitor customer quality deliverables, open issues, and corrective action commitments to ensure alignment with program milestones, customer expectations, and organizational quality objectives.

**Other**

* Maintain a safe, secure and legal work environment, adhering to all Company policies and procedures.
* Protect the confidentiality of the Company’s information and products.
* Contribute to team efforts by performing other job-related duties and projects as assigned or requested.

**GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS – Education, Knowledge, and Experience**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related technical field is required.

**Experience:**

* Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in quality assurance, quality engineering, or quality management within aerospace manufacturing or a related highly regulated industry.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and present quality performance metrics, defect trends, corrective action status, and risk assessments to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
* Proven track record of leading cross-functional quality improvement initiatives, influencing stakeholders without direct authority, and translating customer quality concerns into sustainable manufacturing improvements.
* Extensive background in defect investigations, root cause analysis, nonconformance management, and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) across manufacturing and customer operations.
* Demonstrated ability to serve as a primary quality interface with customers, including managing complex quality concerns, presenting technical findings, and driving issue resolution.
* Minimum of 5 years working with aerospace quality standards, FAA/EASA regulatory requirements, product conformity, and applicable customer quality requirements.

**Skills:**

* In-depth knowledge of AS9100 standards, FAA/EASA regulations, aerospace quality requirements, product conformity, and applicable airworthiness standards.
* Strong technical understanding of aircraft interior products, manufacturing processes, installation requirements, and quality documentation, including Letters of Conformance (LOCs) and approved craftsmanship standards.
* Advanced proficiency in nonconformance management, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and evidence-based defect investigation and resolution.
* Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills, with the ability to present complex technical findings, resolve customer concerns, and influence internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret quality data, identify trends, evaluate risks, and present actionable recommendations to executive leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, establish structured communication processes, drive accountability, and implement sustainable quality improvements without direct supervisory authority.

**Preferred Skills/Experience:**

records.title: Senior Manager, Quality – Development Programs (R5315)
records.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

### **Job Description:**

The Senior Manager of Quality is responsible for establishing and leading all quality activities for a complex aerospace development program from prototype through production readiness. This role serves as the primary quality leader embedded within the program team and partners closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Flight Test, and Program Management to ensure products are designed, developed, tested, and transitioned to production with quality, reliability, and mission success as foundational objectives.

The Senior Manager of Quality will build and lead a multidisciplinary quality team while implementing scalable quality systems, risk management processes, problem-solving disciplines, and development quality practices appropriate for a rapidly growing aerospace and defense technology organization.

This position requires balancing speed of development with disciplined engineering rigor to support aggressive program schedules while ensuring compliance with customer, regulatory, and company requirements.

**What you'll do:**

* **Development Quality Leadership**

* Serve as the quality leader for XBAT development.
* Establish quality strategy, objectives, and metrics aligned with program milestones.
* Integrate quality requirements into the product development lifecycle.
* Ensure quality considerations are incorporated during system architecture, design reviews, verification, validation, and qualification activities.
* Partner with Engineering leadership to identify and mitigate technical and programmatic risks.
* Drive a culture of proactive quality and continuous improvement throughout the program.

**Design & Configuration Quality**

* Ensure quality requirements are appropriately captured in product definitions, specifications, and design documentation.
* Participate in design reviews, change control boards, and configuration management activities.
* Ensure full configuration and traceability for all material installed into prototype aircraft.
* Evaluate engineering changes for quality and production readiness impacts.
* Support requirements verification and validation planning.
* Drive design-for-manufacturing, design-for-quality, and design-for-reliability initiatives.

**Risk Management & Reliability**

* Lead quality participation in program risk management activities.
* Establish and maintain FRACAS processes for development and flight test phases of the program.
* Facilitate root cause and corrective action investigations for design, manufacturing, supplier, and field failures.
* Support reliability growth planning and execution.
* Monitor defect trends, failure modes, and reliability metrics to identify systemic risks.

**Verification, Validation & Test Quality**

* Develop quality oversight strategies for laboratory, ground, and flight test activities.
* Ensure test results, anomalies, and nonconformances are appropriately documented and dispositioned.
* Support qualification and certification efforts.
* Establish processes for managing test escapes, failures, and corrective actions.

**Nonconformance & Corrective Action Management**

* Lead Material Review Board activities for development hardware.
* Establish scalable processes for nonconformance management.
* Drive root cause analysis using structured problem-solving methodologies.
* Ensure timely and effective corrective and preventive actions.
* Track effectiveness of corrective actions through closure.

**Production Readiness & Industrialization**

* Partner with Manufacturing and Supply Chain teams to transition products from prototype to production.
* Define quality requirements for production readiness reviews.
* Support development of inspection plans, acceptance criteria, and control strategies.
* Ensure lessons learned from development are incorporated into production processes.
* Lead quality planning activities supporting low-rate initial production and rate increases.

**Quality Management System**

* Develop and implement quality processes supporting aerospace development programs.
* Ensure compliance with AS9100, customer requirements, and internal procedures.
* Drive continuous improvement of development quality processes.
* Support internal and external audits as required.
* Establish scalable systems that support future production growth.

**Leadership & Team Development**

* Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing quality organization.
* Recruit and develop quality engineers, inspectors, and technicians.
* Establish clear objectives, priorities, and performance expectations.
* Promote a culture of accountability, technical excellence, and collaboration.
* Develop organizational capabilities to support future company growth.

**Required qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Aerospace Engineering, or related technical discipline.
* 10+ years of experience in aerospace, defense, aviation, space, or other highly regulated industries.
* 5+ years of leadership experience managing technical quality organizations.
* Experience supporting complex product development programs from concept through production transition.
* Strong knowledge of quality systems, engineering development processes, and aerospace manufacturing.
* Experience leading root cause investigations and corrective action programs.
* Experience with risk management, reliability engineering, and failure analysis.
* Working knowledge of AS9100 quality management systems.
* Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior leadership.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience supporting UAV, aerospace, defense, aviation, autonomous systems, or advanced technology programs.
* Experience leading quality organizations during rapid company growth.
* Background in systems engineering, reliability engineering, or development engineering.
* Experience with flight test programs and qualification testing.
* ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), or equivalent certification.
* Familiarity with government defense programs and customer quality requirements.

#LI-JM1

#LE

Full-time regular employee offer package:

Pay within range listed + Bonus + Benefits + Equity

Temporary employee offer package:

Pay within range listed above + temporary benefits package (applicable after 60 days of employment)

Salary compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, licenses and certifications, and specific work location. All offers are contingent on a cleared background and possible reference check. Military fellows and part-time employees are not eligible for benefits. Please speak to your talent acquisition representative for more information.

###

Shield AI is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

records.title: VP of Production
records.description:
**VP of Production**
--------------------

**Location:** Los Angeles, Detroit, or San Francisco 
**Employment:** Full time, in person 
**Base salary:** $200,000–$350,000 annually

American factories deserve a supply chain that moves as fast as they do. Nox Metals is building it, along with the tools that run it. We’re a technology company supplying raw metal to frontier American manufacturers. We use software and automation to supply metal to factories faster than the industry thought possible.

### **The role**

We’re hiring a VP of Production to lead manufacturing performance across Nox Metals’ facilities. You will own how work moves through our factories: production planning, daily execution, capacity, staffing, quality, productivity, and on-time delivery.

This is a hands-on manufacturing leadership role with real time on the factory floor. You will develop production leaders, resolve constraints, and create repeatable ways of working that help teams deliver as demand grows. Success means safe, reliable production and clear accountability from the daily schedule through completed customer orders.

### **You will**

* Lead production execution across facilities, with clear expectations for safety, quality, output, cost, and delivery.
* Translate demand into practical production, staffing, shift, and capacity plans.
* Develop plant and production leaders who take ownership of results and build strong teams.
* Establish daily operating reviews, shift handoffs, escalation paths, and performance measures that drive action.
* Identify bottlenecks, reduce downtime and rework, and improve material flow and labor productivity.
* Build consistent training, work instructions, and qualification standards while staying close to how work happens.
* Protect material traceability and quality throughout production.
* Partner with maintenance and engineering on equipment reliability, capacity improvements, and automation.
* Work with supply chain and commercial teams to align material availability, production commitments, and customer needs.
* Partner with finance on production economics and equipment investment decisions.
* Help new or expanded facilities establish reliable production and sustain performance as they ramp.

### **You are**

* A manufacturing leader with a record of improving factory performance and developing accountable leaders.
* Experienced managing production teams, schedules, equipment constraints, and competing priorities.
* Uncompromising about safety, quality, and traceability.
* Fluent in capacity, throughput, labor productivity, downtime, and delivery performance.
* Comfortable making decisions on the floor and following through until problems are resolved.
* Practical, direct, and interested in improving manufacturing with software and automation.

### **Nice to have**

Experience leading multiple facilities, scaling production through rapid growth, or working in metals, machining, aerospace, industrial distribution, or related environments.

Expect regular time at our manufacturing facilities and travel between sites as needed.

Nox Metals is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based on skill, attitude, and fit for the work, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, height, weight, marital status, or any other protected status under federal, state, or local law.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act.

Compensation Range: $200K - $350K
